 296: bool ARitualAltar::AreAllPlayersReady() const
 297: {
 298: 
 299: 	if (ParticipatingPlayers.Num() == 0 || ReadyPlayers.Num() == 0)
 300: 	{
 301: 		return false;
 302: 	}
 303: 
 304: 	for (ACharacter* Player : ParticipatingPlayers)
 305: 	{
 306: 		if (!ReadyPlayers.Contains(Player))
 307: 		{
 308: 			return false;
 309: 		}
 310: 	}
 311: 
 312: 	return true;
 313: }

 315: void ARitualAltar::StartRitualCountdown()
 316: {
 317: 	if (!HasAuthority())
 318: 	{
 319: 		return;
 320: 	}
 321: 
 322: 
 323: 	CurrentRitualState = EInteractionState::Preparing;
 324: 
 325: 	BroadcastRitualStateChanged();
 326: 
 327: 
 328: 	GenerateInputSequence();
 329: 
 330: 
 331: 	StartCountdown = 3;
 332: 
 333: 	BroadcastCountdownTick();
 334: 
 335: 
 336: 	GetWorldTimerManager().SetTimer(
 337: 		RitualStartCountdownHandle,
 338: 		this,
 339: 		&ARitualAltar::ProcessCountdownTick,
 340: 		1.0f,
 341: 		true
 342: 	);
 343: }

 345: void ARitualAltar::ProcessCountdownTick()
 346: {
 347: 	if (!HasAuthority())
 348: 	{
 349: 		return;
 350: 	}
 351: 
 352: 
 353: 	StartCountdown--;
 354: 
 355: 	BroadcastCountdownTick();
 356: 
 357: 	UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[DEBUG-RITUAL] Countdown: %d"), StartCountdown);
 358: 
 359: 	if (StartCountdown <= 0)
 360: 	{
 361: 		GetWorldTimerManager().ClearTimer(RitualStartCountdownHandle);
 362: 		ActivateRitual();
 363: 	}

 366: void ARitualAltar::ActivateRitual()
 367: {
 368: 	if (!HasAuthority())
 369: 	{
 370: 		return;
 371: 	}
 372: 
 373: 
 374: 	int32 RandomStartingPlayer = FMath::RandRange(0, ReadyPlayers.Num() - 1);
 375: 
 376: 
 377: 	CurrentActivePlayer = ParticipatingPlayers[RandomStartingPlayer];
 378: 	CurrentSequenceIndex = 0;
 379: 	CurrentRitualState = EInteractionState::Active;
 380: 
 381: 
 382: 	StartInputTimer();
 383: 
 384: 
 385: 	UpdateTurnData();
 386: 
 387:

 397: void ARitualAltar::GenerateInputSequence()
 398: {
 399: 	if (!HasAuthority())
 400: 	{
 401: 		return;
 402: 	}
 403: 
 404: 	InputSequence.Empty();
 405: 
 406: 
 407: 	int32 SequenceLength = FMath::Max(5, FMath::RoundToInt(5.0f * ParticipatingPlayers.Num() * DifficultyScalingMultiplier));
 408: 
 409: 
 410: 	const FWitchPTGameplayTags& WitchPtGameplayTags = FWitchPTGameplayTags::Get();
 411: 
 412: 	TArray<FGameplayTag> PossibleInputs;
 413: 	PossibleInputs.Add(WitchPtGameplayTags.Ritual_Input_Up);
 414: 	PossibleInputs.Add(WitchPtGameplayTags.Ritual_Input_Down);
 415: 	PossibleInputs.Add(WitchPtGameplayTags.Ritual_Input_Left);
 416: 	PossibleInputs.Add(WitchPtGameplayTags.Ritual_Input_Right);
 417: 
 418: 
 419: 	for (int32 i = 0; i < SequenceLength; ++i)
 420: 	{
 421: 		int32 RandomIndex = FMath::RandRange(0, PossibleInputs.Num() - 1);
 422: 		InputSequence.Add(PossibleInputs[RandomIndex]);
 423: 	}
 424: 
 425: 
 426: 
 427: 
 428: }
 429: 
 430: void ARitualAltar::HandlePlayerInput(ACharacter* Character, const FGameplayTag& InputTag)
 431: {
 432: 	if (!Character || !HasAuthority())
 433: 	{
 434: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("[DEBUG-RITUAL] Rejected input: no authority or invalid character"));
 435: 		return;
 436: 	}
 437: 
 438: 
 439: 	if (CurrentRitualState != EInteractionState::Active)
 440: 	{
 441: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("[DEBUG-RITUAL] Rejected input from %s: ritual not active (state=%d)"),
 442: 			*Character->GetName(), static_cast<int32>(CurrentRitualState));
 443: 		return;
 444: 	}
 445: 
 446: 
 447: 	if (Character != CurrentActivePlayer)
 448: 	{
 449: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("[DEBUG-RITUAL] Rejected input from %s: not their turn (current active=%s)"),
 450: 			*Character->GetName(), CurrentActivePlayer ? *CurrentActivePlayer->GetName() : TEXT("None"));
 451: 		return;
 452: 	}
 453: 
 454: 
 455: 	if (InputSequence.Num() == 0 || CurrentSequenceIndex >= InputSequence.Num())
 456: 	{
 457: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("[DEBUG-RITUAL] Input validation error: invalid sequence state (index=%d, sequence length=%d)"),
 458: 			CurrentSequenceIndex, InputSequence.Num());
 459: 		return;
 460: 	}
 461: 
 462: 
 463: 	FGameplayTag ExpectedInput = InputSequence[CurrentSequenceIndex];
 464: 
 465: 
 466: 
 467: 	if (InputTag == ExpectedInput)
 468: 	{
 469: 		HandleInputSuccess(Character);
 470: 	}
 471: 	else
 472: 	{
 473: 		HandleInputFailure(Character);
 474: 	}
 475: }
 476: 
 477: void ARitualAltar::Multicast_OnInputSuccess_Implementation(ACharacter* Character)
 478: {
 479: 
 480: 	if (Character)
 481: 	{
 482: 		UAbilitySystemComponent* ASC = UAbilitySystemBlueprintLibrary::GetAbilitySystemComponent(Character);
 483: 		if (ASC)
 484: 		{
 485: 			const FWitchPTGameplayTags& WitchPtGameplayTags = FWitchPTGameplayTags::Get();
 486: 			FGameplayEventData EventData;
 487: 			EventData.EventTag = WitchPtGameplayTags.Event_Ritual_InputSuccess;
 488: 			EventData.Instigator = this;
 489: 			EventData.Target = Character;
 490: 
 491: 
 492: 			FGameplayTag* PositionTag = nullptr;
 493: 			for (FPlayerPositionTagEntry& Entry : PlayerPositionTags)
 494: 			{
 495: 				if (Entry.Player == Character)
 496: 				{
 497: 					PositionTag = &Entry.PositionTag;
 498: 					break;
 499: 				}
 500: 			}
 501: 			if (PositionTag && PositionTag->MatchesTag(WitchPtGameplayTags.Get().Ritual_Position_1))
 502: 			{
 503: 				EventData.OptionalObject = PrimaryAnimMontage;
 504: 			} else
 505: 			{
 506: 				EventData.OptionalObject = SecondaryAnimMontage;
 507: 			}
 508: 
 509: 
 510: 			UAbilitySystemBlueprintLibrary::SendGameplayEventToActor(Character, WitchPtGameplayTags.Event_Ritual_InputSuccess, EventData);

 518: void ARitualAltar::HandleInputSuccess(ACharacter* Player)
 519: {
 520: 	if (!HasAuthority() || !Player)
 521: 	{
 522: 		return;
 523: 	}
 524: 
 525: 
 526: 	GetWorldTimerManager().ClearTimer(InputTimerHandle);
 527: 
 528: 
 529: 	CurrentSequenceIndex++;
 530: 
 531: 
 532: 	Multicast_OnInputSuccess(Player);
 533: 
 534: 
 535: 	if (CurrentSequenceIndex >= InputSequence.Num())
 536: 	{
 537: 
 538: 		CurrentRitualState = EInteractionState::Succeeded;
 539: 		bRitualCompleted = true;
 540: 		bRitualWasSuccessful = true;
 541: 
 542: 
 543: 		UpdateTurnData();
 544: 
 545: 
 546: 		BroadcastRitualStateChanged();
 547: 		BroadcastRitualCompleted();
 548: 
 549: 
 550: 		SpawnReward();
 551: 		Multicast_OnRitualSucceeded();
 552: 
 553: 
 554: 		CleanupRitual();
 555: 	}
 556: 	else
 557: 	{
 558: 
 559: 		AdvanceToNextPlayer();
 560: 
 561: 
 562: 		StartInputTimer();
 563: 
 564: 
 565: 		UpdateTurnData();
 566: 	}
 567: }
 568: 
 569: void ARitualAltar::HandleInputFailure(ACharacter* Player)
 570: {
 571: 	if (!HasAuthority() || !Player)
 572: 	{
 573: 		return;
 574: 	}
 575: 
 576: 
 577: 	GetWorldTimerManager().ClearTimer(InputTimerHandle);
 578: 
 579: 
 580: 	CorruptionAmount += CorruptionIncreasePerFail;
 581: 
 582: 	BroadcastCorruptionChanged();
 583: 
 584: 
 585: 
 586: 
 587: 
 588: 	ApplyAgePenalty(Player);
 589: 
 590: 
 591: 	Multicast_OnInputFailed(Player);
 592: 
 593: 
 594: 	if (CorruptionAmount >= MaxCorruption)
 595: 	{
 596: 
 597: 		CurrentRitualState = EInteractionState::FailedCatastrophically;
 598: 		bRitualCompleted = true;
 599: 		bRitualWasSuccessful = false;
 600: 
 601: 
 602: 		UpdateTurnData();
 603: 
 604: 
 605: 		BroadcastRitualStateChanged();
 606: 		BroadcastRitualCompleted();
 607: 
 608: 
 609: 		for (ACharacter* ParticipatingPlayer : ParticipatingPlayers)
 610: 		{
 611: 			if (ParticipatingPlayer)
 612: 			{
 613: 				ApplyAgePenalty(ParticipatingPlayer, true);
 614: 			}
 615: 		}
 616: 
 617: 
 618: 		SpawnDemon();
 619: 		Multicast_OnRitualCatastrophicFail();
 620: 
 621: 
 622: 		CleanupRitual();
 623: 	}
 624: 	else
 625: 	{
 626: 
 627: 		AdvanceToNextPlayer();
 628: 
 629: 
 630: 		StartInputTimer();
 631: 
 632: 
 633: 		UpdateTurnData();
 634: 	}
 635: }

 637: void ARitualAltar::StartInputTimer()
 638: {
 639: 	if (!HasAuthority())
 640: 	{
 641: 		return;
 642: 	}
 643: 
 644: 
 645: 	float ProgressDifficulty = FMath::Clamp(CurrentSequenceIndex / (float)InputSequence.Num(), 0.0f, 1.0f);
 646: 	float ScaledTimeWindow = BaseInputTimeWindow * (1.0f - (ProgressDifficulty * 0.5f));
 647: 
 648: 
 649: 	CurrentInputTimer = ScaledTimeWindow;
 650: 
 651: 
 652: 
 653: 	GetWorldTimerManager().SetTimer(
 654: 		InputTimerHandle,
 655: 		this,
 656: 		&ARitualAltar::OnInputTimerExpired,
 657: 		ScaledTimeWindow,
 658: 		false
 659: 	);
 660: 
 661: 	UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[DEBUG-RITUAL] Started input timer: %.2f seconds for player %s, input %d/%d"),
 662: 		ScaledTimeWindow, CurrentActivePlayer ? *CurrentActivePlayer->GetName() : TEXT("None"),
 663: 		CurrentSequenceIndex, InputSequence.Num()-1);
 664: 
 665: 
 666: 	if (InputSequence.IsValidIndex(CurrentSequenceIndex))
 667: 	{
 668: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[DEBUG-RITUAL] Current expected input: %s"),
 669: 			*InputSequence[CurrentSequenceIndex].ToString());
 670: 	}
 671: }

 673: void ARitualAltar::OnInputTimerExpired()
 674: {
 675: 	if (!HasAuthority() || CurrentRitualState != EInteractionState::Active)
 676: 	{
 677: 		return;
 678: 	}
 679: 
 680: 
 681: 	if (CurrentActivePlayer)
 682: 	{
 683: 		HandleInputFailure(CurrentActivePlayer);
 684: 	}
 685: 	else
 686: 	{
 687: 
 688: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("[RitualAltar] Timer expired but no active player!"));
 689: 		AdvanceToNextPlayer();
 690: 		StartInputTimer();
 691: 	}
 692: }

 694: void ARitualAltar::AdvanceToNextPlayer()
 695: {
 696: 	if (!HasAuthority() || ParticipatingPlayers.Num() == 0)
 697: 	{
 698: 		return;
 699: 	}
 700: 
 701: 
 702: 
 703: 	int32 CurrentPlayerIndex = ParticipatingPlayers.IndexOfByKey(CurrentActivePlayer);
 704: 
 705: 
 706: 	if (CurrentPlayerIndex == INDEX_NONE || CurrentPlayerIndex >= ParticipatingPlayers.Num() - 1)
 707: 	{
 708: 		CurrentPlayerIndex = 0;
 709: 	}
 710: 	else
 711: 	{
 712: 		CurrentPlayerIndex++;
 713: 	}
 714: 
 715: 
 716: 	int32 StartIndex = CurrentPlayerIndex;
 717: 	bool bFoundEligiblePlayer = false;
 718: 
 719: 
 720: 	do
 721: 	{
 722: 		ACharacter* NextPlayer = ParticipatingPlayers[CurrentPlayerIndex];
 723: 		if (NextPlayer && IsPlayerEligibleForTurn(NextPlayer))
 724: 		{
 725: 			CurrentActivePlayer = NextPlayer;
 726: 			bFoundEligiblePlayer = true;
 727: 			break;
 728: 		}
 729: 
 730: 
 731: 		CurrentPlayerIndex = (CurrentPlayerIndex + 1) % ParticipatingPlayers.Num();
 732: 	}
 733: 	while (CurrentPlayerIndex != StartIndex && !bFoundEligiblePlayer);
 734: 
 735: 
 736: 	if (!bFoundEligiblePlayer && ParticipatingPlayers.Num() > 0)
 737: 	{
 738: 		CurrentActivePlayer = ParticipatingPlayers[0];
 739: 	}
 740: }

 742: bool ARitualAltar::IsPlayerEligibleForTurn(ACharacter* Player) const
 743: {
 744: 	if (!Player)
 745: 	{
 746: 		return false;
 747: 	}
 748: 
 749: 
 750: 	bool bIsInPosition = false;
 751: 	for (const ABaseInteractionPosition* Position : InteractionPositions)
 752: 	{
 753: 		if (Position && Position->IsOccupied() && Position->GetOccupyingCharacter() == Player)
 754: 		{
 755: 			bIsInPosition = true;
 756: 			break;
 757: 		}
 758: 	}
 759: 
 760: 
 761: 	const FWitchPTGameplayTags& WitchPtGameplayTags = FWitchPTGameplayTags::Get();
 762: 	UAbilitySystemComponent* ASC = UAbilitySystemBlueprintLibrary::GetAbilitySystemComponent(Player);
 763: 	bool bHasPositionTag = ASC && ASC->HasMatchingGameplayTag(WitchPtGameplayTags.Character_State_Ritual_InPosition);
 764: 
 765: 	return bIsInPosition && bHasPositionTag;
 766: }

 944: 	if (Player->IsLocallyControlled())

 954: 	{
 955: 		return;

 958:

 960: 	{
 961:

 965: 
 966: 	bool bFound = false;
 967: 	for (FPlayerPositionTagEntry& Entry : PlayerPositionTags)
 968: 	{

 970: 		{
 971: 			Entry.PositionTag = Position->GetPositionTag();
 972: 			bFound = true;
 973: 			break;
 974: 		}
 975: 	}
 976: 	if (!bFound)
 977: 	{
 978: 		FPlayerPositionTagEntry NewEntry;
 979: 		NewEntry.Player = Player;
 980: 		NewEntry.PositionTag = Position->GetPositionTag();
 981: 		PlayerPositionTags.Add(NewEntry);
 982: 	}
 983: 
 984: 
 985: 	if (!ParticipatingPlayers.Contains(Player))
 986: 	{
 987: 		ParticipatingPlayers.Add(Player);
 988: 	}
 989: 	CurrentRitualState = EInteractionState::WaitingForPlayers;
 990: 
 991: 
 992: 	if (HasAuthority())
 993: 	{
 994: 		BroadcastRitualStateChanged();
 995: 	}
 996: 
 997: 
 998: 	UpdateReadyPlayersData();
 999: 
1000: 
1001: 	AWitchPTPlayerController* PC = Cast<AWitchPTPlayerController>(Player->GetController());
1002: 	if (PC)
1003: 	{
1004: 		if (Player->IsLocallyControlled())
1005: 		{
1006: 
1007: 
1008: 		}
1009: 		else
1010: 		{
1011: 
1012: 
1013: 
1014: 		}
1015: 
1016: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[RitualAltar] Showing ritual widget for player %s"), *Player->GetName());
1017: 	}
1018: }

 88: void AWitchPTPlayerController::Move(const FInputActionValue& InputActionValue)
 89: {
 90: 	const FVector2D InputAxisVector = InputActionValue.Get<FVector2D>();
 91: 	const FRotator Rotation = GetControlRotation();
 92: 	const FRotator YawRotation(0.f, Rotation.Yaw, 0.f);
 93: 
 94: 	const FVector ForwardDirection = FRotationMatrix(YawRotation).GetUnitAxis(EAxis::X);
 95: 	const FVector RightDirection = FRotationMatrix(YawRotation).GetUnitAxis(EAxis::Y);
 96: 
 97: 	if (APawn* ControlledPawn = GetPawn<APawn>())
 98: 	{
 99: 		ControlledPawn->AddMovementInput(ForwardDirection, InputAxisVector.Y);
100: 		ControlledPawn->AddMovementInput(RightDirection, InputAxisVector.X);
101: 	}
102: 
103: }
104: 
105: void AWitchPTPlayerController::Look(const FInputActionValue& Value)
106: {
107: 
108: 	FVector2D LookAxisVector = Value.Get<FVector2D>();
109: 
110: 	if (APawn* ControlledPawn = GetPawn<APawn>())
111: 	{
112: 
113: 		ControlledPawn->AddControllerYawInput(LookAxisVector.X);
114: 		ControlledPawn->AddControllerPitchInput(LookAxisVector.Y);
115: 	}
116: }

 87: void UUIManagerSubsystem::FocusModal(APlayerController* PlayerController, UUserWidget* WidgetToFocus, bool bShowCursor, bool bUIOnlyInput)
 88: {
 89: 	if (PlayerController)
 90: 	{
 91: 
 92: 		if (!IsValid(WidgetToFocus))
 93: 		{
 94: 			UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("FocusModal: WidgetToFocus is invalid or null"));
 95: 			return;
 96: 		}
 97: 
 98: 		if(bUIOnlyInput)
 99: 		{
100: 			FInputModeUIOnly InputMode;
101: 			InputMode.SetWidgetToFocus(WidgetToFocus->TakeWidget());
102: 			PlayerController->SetInputMode(InputMode);
103: 			bShowCursor ? PlayerController->bShowMouseCursor = true : PlayerController->bShowMouseCursor = false;
104: 		}
105: 		else
106: 		{
107: 			FInputModeGameAndUI InputMode;
108: 			InputMode.SetWidgetToFocus(WidgetToFocus->TakeWidget());
109: 			InputMode.SetLockMouseToViewportBehavior(EMouseLockMode::DoNotLock);
110: 			bShowCursor ? PlayerController->bShowMouseCursor = true : PlayerController->bShowMouseCursor = false;
111: 			PlayerController->SetInputMode(InputMode);
112: 		}
113: 	}
114: }

336: void ACauldronAltar::StartPlacementPreview(ACharacter* Character)
337: {
338:     if (!Character || Character != CarryingCharacter || !HasAuthority())
339:     {
340:         return;
341:     }
342: 
343: 
344:     DetachFromActor(FDetachmentTransformRules::KeepWorldTransform);
345: 
346: 
347:     CauldronPhysicState = ECauldronPhysicState::Previewing;
348: 
349: 
350:     UStaticMeshComponent* MeshComponent = FindComponentByClass<UStaticMeshComponent>();
351:     if (MeshComponent)
352:     {
353:         OriginalMaterials.Empty();
354:         for (int32 i = 0; i < MeshComponent->GetNumMaterials(); i++)
355:         {
356:             OriginalMaterials.Add(MeshComponent->GetMaterial(i));
357:         }
358:     }
359: 
360: 
361:     CurrentPlacementState = ECauldronPlacementState::Invalid;
362: 
363: 
364: 
365:     SetActorEnableCollision(false);
366: 
367: 
368:     FVector CharacterLocation = Character->GetActorLocation();
369:     FRotator CharacterRotation = Character->GetActorRotation();
370:     FVector PlacementOffset = CharacterRotation.RotateVector(DetachmentOffset);
371: 
372: 
373:     PreviewLocation = CharacterLocation + PlacementOffset;
374: 
375: 
376:     PreviewRotation.Pitch = 0;
377:     PreviewRotation.Roll = 0;
378:     PreviewRotation.Yaw = 0;
379: 
380:     SetActorLocation(PreviewLocation);
381:     SetActorRotation(PreviewRotation);
382: 
383: 
384:     Multicast_FinalizePlacement();
385: }

393: void ACauldronAltar::UpdatePlacementPreview(const FVector& HitLocation, const FVector& HitNormal)
394: {
395: 
396: 
397:     if (!IsInPlacementPreview())
398:     {
399:         return;
400:     }
401: 
402: 
403:     PreviewLocation = HitLocation;
404: 
405: 
406:     FRotator SurfaceAlignedRotation = HitNormal.Rotation();
407: 
408: 
409: 
410:     FRotator AdjustedRotation = FRotator(SurfaceAlignedRotation.Pitch, PreviewRotation.Yaw, SurfaceAlignedRotation.Roll);
411: 
412: 
413:     if (FMath::Abs(AdjustedRotation.Pitch) > 15.0f)
414:     {
415:         AdjustedRotation.Pitch = FMath::Clamp(AdjustedRotation.Pitch, 0.f, 0.f);
416:     }
417: 
418:     if (FMath::Abs(AdjustedRotation.Roll) > 15.0f)
419:     {
420:         AdjustedRotation.Roll = FMath::Clamp(AdjustedRotation.Roll, 0.f, 0.f);
421:     }
422: 
423:     PreviewRotation = AdjustedRotation;
424:     SetActorScale3D(FVector(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f));
425:     SetActorLocation(PreviewLocation);
426: 
427: 
428:     CurrentPlacementState = IsPlacementValid() ? ECauldronPlacementState::Valid : ECauldronPlacementState::Invalid;
429: }

549:         ValidPlacementMaterial : InvalidPlacementMaterial;
550:

564: void ACauldronAltar::RestoreOriginalMaterials()
565: {
566: 
567:     if (CauldronPhysicState != ECauldronPhysicState::Previewing)
568:     {
569:         UStaticMeshComponent* MeshComponent = FindComponentByClass<UStaticMeshComponent>();
570:         if (MeshComponent && OriginalMaterials.Num() > 0)
571:         {
572:             for (int32 i = 0; i < FMath::Min(MeshComponent->GetNumMaterials(), OriginalMaterials.Num()); i++)
573:             {
574:                 if (OriginalMaterials[i])
575:                 {
576:                     MeshComponent->SetMaterial(i, OriginalMaterials[i]);
577:                 }
578:             }
579:         }
580:     }
581: }

583: bool ACauldronAltar::IsPlacementValid() const
584: {
585:     if (!GetWorld())
586:     {
587:         return false;
588:     }
589: 
590: 
591:     TArray<FOverlapResult> Overlaps;
592:     FCollisionQueryParams QueryParams;
593:     QueryParams.AddIgnoredActor(this);
594: 
595:     if (CarryingCharacter)
596:     {
597:         QueryParams.AddIgnoredActor(CarryingCharacter);
598:     }
599: 
600:     bool bHasOverlaps = GetWorld()->OverlapMultiByObjectType(
601:         Overlaps,
602:         PreviewLocation,
603:         FQuat::Identity,
604:         FCollisionObjectQueryParams::AllObjects,
605:         FCollisionShape::MakeSphere(PlacementCollisionCheckRadius),
606:         QueryParams
607:     );
608: 
609:     if (bHasOverlaps)
610:     {
611: 
612:         for (const FOverlapResult& Overlap : Overlaps)
613:         {
614: 
615:             if (Overlap.GetActor() && Overlap.GetActor()->GetActorEnableCollision())
616:             {
617: 
618:                 return false;
619:             }
620:         }
621:     }
622: 
623: 
624: 
625:     FHitResult HitResult;
626:     FVector TraceStart = PreviewLocation;
627:     FVector TraceEnd = TraceStart - FVector(0, 0, MaxGroundAlignmentHeight * 2.0f);
628: 
629:     bool bHitGround = GetWorld()->LineTraceSingleByChannel(
630:         HitResult,
631:         TraceStart,
632:         TraceEnd,
633:         ECC_Visibility,
634:         QueryParams
635:     );
636: 
637:     if (!bHitGround)
638:     {
639: 
640:         return false;
641:     }
642: 
643: 
644:     float DistanceToGround = (HitResult.Location - TraceStart).Size();
645:     if (DistanceToGround > MaxGroundAlignmentHeight)
646:     {
647: 
648:         return false;
649:     }
650: 
651: 
652:     return true;
653: }

  258: UAT_WaitForPlacementLocation_SLT::UAT_WaitForPlacementLocation_SLT(const FObjectInitializer& ObjectInitializer)
  259: 	: Super(ObjectInitializer)
  260: {
  261: 	bTickingTask = true;
  262: 	TraceDistance = 500.0f;
  263: 	TraceRadius = 10.0f;
  264: 	bTraceComplex = false;
  265: 	bIgnoreBlockingHits = false;
  266: 	bShowDebug = false;
  267: 	LastHitLocation = FVector::ZeroVector;
  268: 	LastHitNormal = FVector::UpVector;
  269: }
  270: 
  271: UAT_WaitForPlacementLocation_SLT* UAT_WaitForPlacementLocation_SLT::WaitForPlacementLocation(
  272: 	UGameplayAbility* OwningAbility,
  273: 	float TraceDistance,
  274: 	float TraceRadius,
  275: 	bool TraceComplex,
  276: 	bool bIgnoreBlockingHits,
  277: 	bool bShowDebug)
  278: {
  279: 	UAT_WaitForPlacementLocation_SLT* MyObj = NewAbilityTask<UAT_WaitForPlacementLocation_SLT>(OwningAbility);
  280: 
  281: 	MyObj->TraceDistance = TraceDistance;
  282: 	MyObj->TraceRadius = TraceRadius;
  283: 	MyObj->bTraceComplex = TraceComplex;
  284: 	MyObj->bIgnoreBlockingHits = bIgnoreBlockingHits;
  285: 	MyObj->bShowDebug = bShowDebug;
  286: 
  287: 	return MyObj;
  288: }
  289: 
  290: void UAT_WaitForPlacementLocation_SLT::Activate()
  291: {
  292: 	Super::Activate();
  293: 
  294: 	// Configurar para ejecutar el trace en cada tick
  295: 	SetWaitingOnAvatar();
  296: 
  297: 	// Realizar un primer trace inmediatamente
  298: 	PerformTrace();
  299: }
  300: 
  301: void UAT_WaitForPlacementLocation_SLT::OnDestroy(bool bInOwnerFinished)
  302: {
  303: 	// Limpiar el temporizador si está activo
  304: 	UWorld* World = GetWorld();
  305: 	if (World)
  306: 	{
  307: 		World->GetTimerManager().ClearTimer(TraceTimerHandle);
  308: 	}
  309: 
  310: 	Super::OnDestroy(bInOwnerFinished);
  311: }
  312: 
  313: void UAT_WaitForPlacementLocation_SLT::TickTask(float DeltaTime)
  314: {
  315: 	Super::TickTask(DeltaTime);
  316: 
  317: 	// Realizar el trace en cada tick
  318: 	PerformTrace();
  319: }
  320: 
  321: void UAT_WaitForPlacementLocation_SLT::PerformTrace()
  322: {
  323: 	if (!Ability || !Ability->GetCurrentActorInfo())
  324: 	{
  325: 		return;
  326: 	}
  327: 
  328: 	// Obtener el controlador del jugador
  329: 	APlayerController* PC = Ability->GetCurrentActorInfo()->PlayerController.Get();
  330: 	if (!PC)
  331: 	{
  332: 		return;
  333: 	}
  334: 
  335: 	// Obtener el personaje del jugador (necesario para obtener la cámara)
  336: 	ACharacter* Character = Cast<ACharacter>(Ability->GetCurrentActorInfo()->AvatarActor.Get());
  337: 	if (!Character)
  338: 	{
  339: 		return;
  340: 	}
  341: 
  342: 	// Definir los puntos de inicio y fin del trace
  343: 	FVector TraceStart;
  344: 	FVector TraceDirection;
  345: 
  346: 	// Buscar un componente de cámara en el personaje
  347: 	UCameraComponent* CameraComponent = Character->FindComponentByClass<UCameraComponent>();
  348: 	if (CameraComponent)
  349: 	{
  350: 		// Usar la posición y dirección de la cámara para el trace
  351: 		TraceStart = CameraComponent->GetComponentLocation();
  352: 		TraceDirection = CameraComponent->GetForwardVector();
  353: 	}
  354: 	else
  355: 	{
  356: 		// Si no hay cámara, usar la rotación del controlador
  357: 		FRotator ControllerRotation = PC->GetControlRotation();
  358: 		PC->GetPlayerViewPoint(TraceStart, ControllerRotation);
  359: 		TraceDirection = ControllerRotation.Vector();
  360: 	}
  361: 
  362: 	FVector TraceEnd = TraceStart + TraceDirection * TraceDistance;
  363: 
  364: 	// Configurar parámetros del trace
  365: 	FCollisionQueryParams QueryParams(SCENE_QUERY_STAT(WaitForPlacementLocation), bTraceComplex);
  366: 	QueryParams.AddIgnoredActor(Character);
  367: 
  368: 	// Configurar qué tipos de objetos detectar
  369: 	ECollisionChannel TraceChannel = ECC_Visibility;
  370: 
  371: 	// Realizar el trace
  372: 	FHitResult HitResult;
  373: 	bool bHit = false;
  374: 
  375: 	// Realizar un sphere trace o line trace según el radio
  376: 	if (TraceRadius > 0.0f)
  377: 	{
  378: 		bHit = GetWorld()->SweepSingleByChannel(
  379: 			HitResult,
  380: 			TraceStart,
  381: 			TraceEnd,
  382: 			FQuat::Identity,
  383: 			TraceChannel,
  384: 			FCollisionShape::MakeSphere(TraceRadius),
  385: 			QueryParams
  386: 		);
  387: 	}
  388: 	else
  389: 	{
  390: 		bHit = GetWorld()->LineTraceSingleByChannel(
  391: 			HitResult,
  392: 			TraceStart,
  393: 			TraceEnd,
  394: 			TraceChannel,
  395: 			QueryParams
  396: 		);
  397: 	}
  398: 
  399: 	// Si encontramos un hit y es diferente al último que reportamos
  400: 	if (bHit && (HitResult.ImpactPoint != LastHitLocation || HitResult.ImpactNormal != LastHitNormal))
  401: 	{
  402: 		// Almacenar los nuevos valores
  403: 		LastHitLocation = HitResult.ImpactPoint;
  404: 		LastHitNormal = HitResult.ImpactNormal;
  405: 
  406: 		// Disparar el delegado con la información del hit
  407: 		if (ShouldBroadcastAbilityTaskDelegates())
  408: 		{
  409: 			OnLocationFound.Broadcast(LastHitLocation, LastHitNormal);
  410: 		}
  411: 	}
  412: 
  413: 	// Mostrar debug si está habilitado
  414: 	if (bShowDebug)
  415: 	{
  416: 		DrawDebugLine(GetWorld(), TraceStart, bHit ? HitResult.ImpactPoint : TraceEnd, FColor::Green, false, 0.0f, 0, 2.0f);
  417: 
  418: 		if (bHit)
  419: 		{
  420: 			// Dibujar una esfera en el punto de impacto
  421: 			DrawDebugSphere(GetWorld(), HitResult.ImpactPoint, 10.0f, 12, FColor::Red, false, 0.0f);
  422: 
  423: 			// Dibujar la normal
  424: 			DrawDebugLine(GetWorld(), HitResult.ImpactPoint, HitResult.ImpactPoint + HitResult.ImpactNormal * 50.0f, FColor::Blue, false, 0.0f, 0, 2.0f);
  425: 		}
  426: 	}
  427: }
  428: </file>

  439: UGA_CauldronPlace::UGA_CauldronPlace()
  440: {
  441:     // Configurar entradas para esta habilidad
  442: 
  443: 
  444:     // Definir la instanciación - esta habilidad puede ejecutarse en el servidor y cliente
  445:     InstancingPolicy = EGameplayAbilityInstancingPolicy::InstancedPerActor;
  446: 
  447:     // Flags de red
  448:     NetExecutionPolicy = EGameplayAbilityNetExecutionPolicy::LocalPredicted;
  449: 
  450:     // No se requiere confirmación para activar
  451:     bServerRespectsRemoteAbilityCancellation = true;
  452: }
  453: 
  454: void UGA_CauldronPlace::ActivateAbility(const FGameplayAbilitySpecHandle Handle, const FGameplayAbilityActorInfo* ActorInfo, const FGameplayAbilityActivationInfo ActivationInfo, const FGameplayEventData* TriggerEventData)
  455: {
  456:     // Llamar a la implementación base
  457:     if (!CommitAbility(Handle, ActorInfo, ActivationInfo))
  458:     {
  459:         EndAbility(Handle, ActorInfo, ActivationInfo, true, true);
  460:         return;
  461:     }
  462: 
  463:     // Buscar el caldero que está en modo previsualización
  464:     ACauldronAltar* CauldronAltar = FindPreviewingCauldron();
  465:     if (!CauldronAltar)
  466:     {
  467:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("GA_CauldronPlace: No se encontró un caldero en modo previsualización"));
  468:         EndAbility(Handle, ActorInfo, ActivationInfo, true, true);
  469:         return;
  470:     }
  471: 
  472:     // Intentar finalizar la colocación
  473:     // CauldronAltar->Server_FinalizePlacement();
  474: 
  475: 
  476: 
  477:     // Terminar la habilidad independientemente del resultado
  478:     EndAbility(Handle, ActorInfo, ActivationInfo, true, false);
  479: }
  480: 
  481: ACauldronAltar* UGA_CauldronPlace::FindPreviewingCauldron()
  482: {
  483:     // Obtener el personaje que está usando la habilidad
  484:     ACharacter* Character = Cast<ACharacter>(GetActorInfo().AvatarActor.Get());
  485:     if (!Character)
  486:     {
  487:         return nullptr;
  488:     }
  489: 
  490:     // Buscar todos los calderos en el mundo
  491:     TArray<AActor*> FoundCauldrons;
  492:     UGameplayStatics::GetAllActorsOfClass(GetWorld(), ACauldronAltar::StaticClass(), FoundCauldrons);
  493: 
  494:     // Buscar el caldero que está en modo previsualización para este personaje
  495:     for (AActor* Actor : FoundCauldrons)
  496:     {
  497:         ACauldronAltar* Cauldron = Cast<ACauldronAltar>(Actor);
  498:         if (Cauldron && Cauldron->IsInPlacementPreview() && Cauldron->GetCarryingCharacter() == Character)
  499:         {
  500:             return Cauldron;
  501:         }
  502:     }
  503: 
  504:     return nullptr;
  505: }
  506: </file>

  609: ACauldronAltar* UGA_CauldronPlacementPreview::FindCarriedCauldron()
  610: {
  611:     // Obtener el personaje que está usando la habilidad
  612:     ACharacter* Character = Cast<ACharacter>(GetActorInfo().AvatarActor.Get());
  613:     if (!Character)
  614:     {
  615:         return nullptr;
  616:     }
  617: 
  618:     // Buscar todos los calderos en el mundo
  619:     TArray<AActor*> FoundCauldrons;
  620:     UGameplayStatics::GetAllActorsOfClass(GetWorld(), ACauldronAltar::StaticClass(), FoundCauldrons);
  621: 
  622:     // Buscar el caldero que está siendo llevado por este personaje
  623:     for (AActor* Actor : FoundCauldrons)
  624:     {
  625:         ACauldronAltar* Cauldron = Cast<ACauldronAltar>(Actor);
  626:         if (Cauldron && Cauldron->IsBeingCarried() && Cauldron->GetCarryingCharacter() == Character)
  627:         {
  628:             return Cauldron;
  629:         }
  630:     }
  631: 
  632:     return nullptr;
  633: }

  800: void UAbilityTask_GrantNearbyInteraction::QueryInteractables()
  801: {
  802: 	UWorld* World = GetWorld();
  803: 	AActor* ActorOwner = GetAvatarActor();
  804: 
  805: 	if (World && ActorOwner)
  806: 	{
  807: 		FCollisionQueryParams Params(SCENE_QUERY_STAT(UAbilityTask_GrantNearbyInteraction), false);
  808: 
  809: 		TArray<FOverlapResult> OverlapResults;
  810: 		World->OverlapMultiByChannel(OUT OverlapResults, ActorOwner->GetActorLocation(), FQuat::Identity, WitchPT_TraceChannel_Interaction, FCollisionShape::MakeSphere(InteractionScanRange), Params);
  811: 
  812: 		if (OverlapResults.Num() > 0)
  813: 		{
  814: 			TArray<TScriptInterface<IInteractableTarget>> InteractableTargets;
  815: 			UInteractionStatics::AppendInteractableTargetsFromOverlapResults(OverlapResults, OUT InteractableTargets);
  816: 
  817: 			FInteractionQuery InteractionQuery;
  818: 			InteractionQuery.RequestingAvatar = ActorOwner;
  819: 			InteractionQuery.RequestingController = Cast<AController>(ActorOwner->GetOwner());
  820: 
  821: 			TArray<FInteractionOption> Options;
  822: 			for (TScriptInterface<IInteractableTarget>& InteractiveTarget : InteractableTargets)
  823: 			{
  824: 				FInteractionOptionBuilder InteractionBuilder(InteractiveTarget, Options);
  825: 				InteractiveTarget->GatherInteractionOptions(InteractionQuery, InteractionBuilder);
  826: 			}
  827: 
  828: 			// Check if any of the options need to grant the ability to the user before they can be used.
  829: 			for (FInteractionOption& Option : Options)
  830: 			{
  831: 				// Otorgar la habilidad de interacción regular
  832: 				if (Option.InteractionAbilityToGrant)
  833: 				{
  834: 					// Grant the ability to the GAS, otherwise it won't be able to do whatever the interaction is.
  835: 					FObjectKey ObjectKey(Option.InteractionAbilityToGrant);
  836: 					if (!InteractionAbilityCache.Find(ObjectKey))
  837: 					{
  838: 						FGameplayAbilitySpec Spec(Option.InteractionAbilityToGrant, 1, INDEX_NONE, this);
  839: 						UWitchPTGameplayAbility* AbilityBase = Cast<UWitchPTGameplayAbility>(Spec.Ability);
  840: 						Spec.GetDynamicSpecSourceTags().AddTag(AbilityBase->StartupInputTag);
  841: 						FGameplayAbilitySpecHandle Handle = AbilitySystemComponent->GiveAbility(Spec);
  842: 						InteractionAbilityCache.Add(ObjectKey, Handle);
  843: 					}
  844: 				}
  845: 
  846: 				// Otorgar la habilidad de interacción mantenida si está disponible y soportada
  847: 				if (Option.bSupportsHoldInteraction && Option.HoldInteractionAbilityToGrant)
  848: 				{
  849: 					FObjectKey ObjectKey(Option.HoldInteractionAbilityToGrant);
  850: 					if (!HoldInteractionAbilityCache.Find(ObjectKey))
  851: 					{
  852: 						FGameplayAbilitySpec Spec(Option.HoldInteractionAbilityToGrant, 1, INDEX_NONE, this);
  853: 						UWitchPTGameplayAbility* AbilityBase = Cast<UWitchPTGameplayAbility>(Spec.Ability);
  854: 						Spec.GetDynamicSpecSourceTags().AddTag(AbilityBase->StartupInputTag);
  855: 						FGameplayAbilitySpecHandle Handle = AbilitySystemComponent->GiveAbility(Spec);
  856: 						HoldInteractionAbilityCache.Add(ObjectKey, Handle);
  857: 					}
  858: 				}
  859: 			}
  860: 		}
  861: 	}
  862: }
  863: </file>

  881: void UAbilityTask_WaitForInteractable::LineTrace(FHitResult& OutHitResult, const UWorld* World, const FVector& Start, const FVector& End, ECollisionChannel CollisionChannel, const FCollisionQueryParams Params)
  882: {
  883: 	check(World);
  884: 
  885: 	OutHitResult = FHitResult();
  886: 	FHitResult HitResult;
  887: 	// World->LineTraceMultiByProfile(HitResults, Start, End, CollisionChannel, Params);
  888: 	World->LineTraceSingleByChannel(HitResult, Start, End, CollisionChannel);
  889: 	OutHitResult.TraceStart = Start;
  890: 	OutHitResult.TraceEnd = End;
  891: 
  892: 	OutHitResult = HitResult;
  893: }
  894: 
  895: void UAbilityTask_WaitForInteractable::AimWithPlayerController(const AActor* InSourceActor, FCollisionQueryParams Params, const FVector& TraceStart, float MaxRange, FVector& OutTraceEnd, bool bIgnorePitch) const
  896: {
  897: 	if (!Ability) // Server and launching client only
  898: 	{
  899: 		return;
  900: 	}
  901: 
  902: 	//@TODO: Bots?
  903: 	APlayerController* PC = Ability->GetCurrentActorInfo()->PlayerController.Get();
  904: 	check(PC);
  905: 
  906: 	FVector ViewStart;
  907: 	FRotator ViewRot;
  908: 	PC->GetPlayerViewPoint(ViewStart, ViewRot);
  909: 
  910: 	const FVector ViewDir = ViewRot.Vector();
  911: 	FVector ViewEnd = ViewStart + (ViewDir * MaxRange);
  912: 
  913: 	ClipCameraRayToAbilityRange(ViewStart, ViewDir, TraceStart, MaxRange, ViewEnd);
  914: 
  915: 	FHitResult HitResult;
  916: 	LineTrace(HitResult, InSourceActor->GetWorld(), ViewStart, ViewEnd, TraceProfile, Params);
  917: 
  918: 	const bool bUseTraceResult = HitResult.bBlockingHit && (FVector::DistSquared(TraceStart, HitResult.Location) <= (MaxRange * MaxRange));
  919: 
  920: 	const FVector AdjustedEnd = (bUseTraceResult) ? HitResult.Location : ViewEnd;
  921: 
  922: 	FVector AdjustedAimDir = (AdjustedEnd - TraceStart).GetSafeNormal();
  923: 	if (AdjustedAimDir.IsZero())
  924: 	{
  925: 		AdjustedAimDir = ViewDir;
  926: 	}
  927: 
  928: 	if (!bTraceAffectsAimPitch && bUseTraceResult)
  929: 	{
  930: 		FVector OriginalAimDir = (ViewEnd - TraceStart).GetSafeNormal();
  931: 
  932: 		if (!OriginalAimDir.IsZero())
  933: 		{
  934: 			// Convert to angles and use original pitch
  935: 			const FRotator OriginalAimRot = OriginalAimDir.Rotation();
  936: 
  937: 			FRotator AdjustedAimRot = AdjustedAimDir.Rotation();
  938: 			AdjustedAimRot.Pitch = OriginalAimRot.Pitch;
  939: 
  940: 			AdjustedAimDir = AdjustedAimRot.Vector();
  941: 		}
  942: 	}
  943: 
  944: 	OutTraceEnd = TraceStart + (AdjustedAimDir * MaxRange);
  945: }
  946: 
  947: bool UAbilityTask_WaitForInteractable::ClipCameraRayToAbilityRange(FVector CameraLocation, FVector CameraDirection, FVector AbilityCenter, float AbilityRange, FVector& ClippedPosition)
  948: {
  949: 	FVector CameraToCenter = AbilityCenter - CameraLocation;
  950: 	float DotToCenter = FVector::DotProduct(CameraToCenter, CameraDirection);
  951: 	if (DotToCenter >= 0)		//If this fails, we're pointed away from the center, but we might be inside the sphere and able to find a good exit point.
  952: 	{
  953: 		float DistanceSquared = CameraToCenter.SizeSquared() - (DotToCenter * DotToCenter);
  954: 		float RadiusSquared = (AbilityRange * AbilityRange);
  955: 		if (DistanceSquared <= RadiusSquared)
  956: 		{
  957: 			float DistanceFromCamera = FMath::Sqrt(RadiusSquared - DistanceSquared);
  958: 			float DistanceAlongRay = DotToCenter + DistanceFromCamera;						//Subtracting instead of adding will get the other intersection point
  959: 			ClippedPosition = CameraLocation + (DistanceAlongRay * CameraDirection);		//Cam aim point clipped to range sphere
  960: 			return true;
  961: 		}
  962: 	}
  963: 	return false;
  964: }
  965: 
  966: void UAbilityTask_WaitForInteractable::UpdateInteractableOptions(const FInteractionQuery& InteractQuery, const TArray<TScriptInterface<IInteractableTarget>>& InteractableTargets)
  967: {
  968: 	TArray<FInteractionOption> NewOptions;
  969: 
  970: 	for (const TScriptInterface<IInteractableTarget>& InteractiveTarget : InteractableTargets)
  971: 	{
  972: 		TArray<FInteractionOption> TempOptions;
  973: 		FInteractionOptionBuilder InteractionBuilder(InteractiveTarget, TempOptions);
  974: 		InteractiveTarget->GatherInteractionOptions(InteractQuery, InteractionBuilder);
  975: 
  976: 		for (FInteractionOption& Option : TempOptions)
  977: 		{
  978: 			FGameplayAbilitySpec* InteractionAbilitySpec = nullptr;
  979: 
  980: 			// if there is a handle an a target ability system, we're triggering the ability on the target.
  981: 			if (Option.TargetAbilitySystem && Option.TargetInteractionAbilityHandle.IsValid())
  982: 			{
  983: 				// Find the spec
  984: 				InteractionAbilitySpec = Option.TargetAbilitySystem->FindAbilitySpecFromHandle(Option.TargetInteractionAbilityHandle);
  985: 			}
  986: 			// If there's an interaction ability then we're activating it on ourselves.
  987: 			else if (Option.InteractionAbilityToGrant)
  988: 			{
  989: 				// Find the spec
  990: 				InteractionAbilitySpec = AbilitySystemComponent->FindAbilitySpecFromClass(Option.InteractionAbilityToGrant);
  991: 
  992: 				if (InteractionAbilitySpec)
  993: 				{
  994: 					// update the option
  995: 					Option.TargetAbilitySystem = AbilitySystemComponent.Get();
  996: 					Option.TargetInteractionAbilityHandle = InteractionAbilitySpec->Handle;
  997: 				}
  998: 			}
  999: 			if (Option.HoldInteractionAbilityToGrant)
 1000: 			{
 1001: 				// Find the spec
 1002: 				InteractionAbilitySpec = AbilitySystemComponent->FindAbilitySpecFromClass(Option.HoldInteractionAbilityToGrant);
 1003: 
 1004: 				if (InteractionAbilitySpec)
 1005: 				{
 1006: 					// update the option
 1007: 					Option.TargetAbilitySystem = AbilitySystemComponent.Get();
 1008: 					Option.TargetHoldInteractionAbilityHandle = InteractionAbilitySpec->Handle;
 1009: 				}
 1010: 			}
 1011: 			if (InteractionAbilitySpec)
 1012: 			{
 1013: 				// Filter any options that we can't activate right now for whatever reason.
 1014: 				if (InteractionAbilitySpec->Ability->CanActivateAbility(InteractionAbilitySpec->Handle, AbilitySystemComponent->AbilityActorInfo.Get()))
 1015: 				{
 1016: 					NewOptions.Add(Option);
 1017: 				}
 1018: 			}
 1019: 		}
 1020: 	}
 1021: 
 1022: 	bool bOptionsChanged = false;
 1023: 	if (NewOptions.Num() == CurrentOptions.Num())
 1024: 	{
 1025: 		NewOptions.Sort();
 1026: 
 1027: 		for (int OptionIndex = 0; OptionIndex < NewOptions.Num(); OptionIndex++)
 1028: 		{
 1029: 			const FInteractionOption& NewOption = NewOptions[OptionIndex];
 1030: 			const FInteractionOption& CurrentOption = CurrentOptions[OptionIndex];
 1031: 
 1032: 			if (NewOption != CurrentOption)
 1033: 			{
 1034: 				bOptionsChanged = true;
 1035: 				break;
 1036: 			}
 1037: 		}
 1038: 	}
 1039: 	else
 1040: 	{
 1041: 		bOptionsChanged = true;
 1042: 	}
 1043: 
 1044: 	if (bOptionsChanged)
 1045: 	{
 1046: 		CurrentOptions = NewOptions;
 1047: 		InteractableObjectsChanged.Broadcast(CurrentOptions);
 1048: 	}
 1049: }
 1050: </file>

 1099: void UAT_WaitForInteractable_SLT::PerformTrace()
 1100: {
 1101: 	AActor* AvatarActor = Ability->GetCurrentActorInfo()->AvatarActor.Get();
 1102: 
 1103: 	if (!AvatarActor)
 1104: 	{
 1105: 		return;
 1106: 	}
 1107: 
 1108: 	UWorld* World = GetWorld();
 1109: 
 1110: 	TArray<AActor*> ActorsToIgnore;
 1111: 	ActorsToIgnore.Add(AvatarActor);
 1112: 
 1113: 	const bool bTraceComplex = false;
 1114: 	FCollisionQueryParams Params(SCENE_QUERY_STAT(UAT_WaitForInteractable_SLT), bTraceComplex);
 1115: 	Params.AddIgnoredActors(ActorsToIgnore);
 1116: 	if (!IsValid(GEngine) || !IsValid(GEngine->GameViewport)) return;
 1117: 	FVector2D ViewportSize;
 1118: 	GEngine->GameViewport->GetViewportSize(ViewportSize);
 1119: 	const FVector2D ViewportCenter = ViewportSize / 2.f;
 1120: 	FVector TraceStart;
 1121: 	FVector Forward;
 1122: 	if (!UGameplayStatics::DeprojectScreenToWorld(Ability->GetCurrentActorInfo()->PlayerController.Get(), ViewportCenter, TraceStart, Forward)) return;
 1123: 
 1124: 
 1125: 	FVector TraceEnd;
 1126: 	AimWithPlayerController(AvatarActor, Params, TraceStart, InteractionScanRange, OUT TraceEnd);
 1127: 
 1128: 	FHitResult OutHitResult;
 1129: 	LineTrace(OutHitResult, World, TraceStart, TraceEnd, TraceProfile, Params);
 1130: 
 1131: 	TArray<TScriptInterface<IInteractableTarget>> InteractableTargets;
 1132: 	UInteractionStatics::AppendInteractableTargetsFromHitResult(OutHitResult, InteractableTargets);
 1133: 
 1134: 	UpdateInteractableOptions(InteractionQuery, InteractableTargets);
 1135: 
 1136: #if ENABLE_DRAW_DEBUG
 1137: 	if (bShowDebug)
 1138: 	{
 1139: 		FColor DebugColor = OutHitResult.bBlockingHit ? FColor::Red : FColor::Green;
 1140: 		if (OutHitResult.bBlockingHit)
 1141: 		{
 1142: 			DrawDebugLine(World, TraceStart, OutHitResult.Location, DebugColor, false, InteractionScanRate);
 1143: 			DrawDebugSphere(World, OutHitResult.Location, 5, 16, DebugColor, false, InteractionScanRate);
 1144: 		}
 1145: 		else
 1146: 		{
 1147: 			DrawDebugLine(World, TraceStart, TraceEnd, DebugColor, false, InteractionScanRate);
 1148: 		}
 1149: 	}
 1150: #endif // ENABLE_DRAW_DEBUG
 1151: }
 1152: </file>

 1196: void UGameplayAbility_Interact::UpdateInteractions(const TArray<FInteractionOption>& InteractiveOptions)
 1197: {
 1198: 
 1199: 	if (CurrentActorInfo && CurrentActorInfo->PlayerController.IsValid())
 1200: 	{
 1201: 
 1202: 
 1203: 		AWitchPTPlayerController* WitchPt = Cast<AWitchPTPlayerController>(CurrentActorInfo->PlayerController.Get());
 1204: 
 1205: 		CurrentOptions = InteractiveOptions;
 1206: 
 1207: 		for (const FInteractionOption& InteractionOption : InteractiveOptions)
 1208: 		{
 1209: 			AActor* InteractableTargetActor = UInteractionStatics::GetActorFromInteractableTarget(InteractionOption.InteractableTarget);
 1210: 
 1211: 			if (InteractableTargetActor)
 1212: 			{
 1213: 				FString ActorName = InteractableTargetActor->GetName();
 1214: 				WitchPt->HUDWidget->ShowPickupMessage(InteractionOption.Text.ToString());

 1222: 		}
 1223: 
 1224: 	}
 1225:

 1229: void UGameplayAbility_Interact::TriggerInteraction()
 1230: {
 1231: 	if (CurrentOptions.Num() == 0)
 1232: 	{
 1233: 		return;
 1234: 	}
 1235: 
 1236: 	UAbilitySystemComponent* AbilitySystem = GetAbilitySystemComponentFromActorInfo();
 1237: 	if (AbilitySystem)
 1238: 	{
 1239: 		const FInteractionOption& InteractionOption = CurrentOptions[0];
 1240: 
 1241: 		AActor* Instigator = GetAvatarActorFromActorInfo();
 1242: 		AActor* InteractableTargetActor = UInteractionStatics::GetActorFromInteractableTarget(InteractionOption.InteractableTarget);
 1243: 
 1244: 		// Allow the target to customize the event data we're about to pass in, in case the ability needs custom data
 1245: 		// that only the actor knows.
 1246: 		FGameplayEventData Payload;
 1247: 		Payload.EventTag = TAG_Ability_Interaction_Activate;
 1248: 		Payload.Instigator = Instigator;
 1249: 		Payload.Target = InteractableTargetActor;
 1250: 
 1251: 		// If needed we allow the interactable target to manipulate the event data so that for example, a button on the wall
 1252: 		// may want to specify a door actor to execute the ability on, so it might choose to override Target to be the
 1253: 		// door actor.
 1254: 		InteractionOption.InteractableTarget->CustomizeInteractionEventData(TAG_Ability_Interaction_Activate, Payload);
 1255: 
 1256: 
 1257: 		// Grab the target actor off the payload we're going to use it as the 'avatar' for the interaction, and the
 1258: 		// source InteractableTarget actor as the owner actor.
 1259: 		AActor* TargetActor = const_cast<AActor*>(ToRawPtr(Payload.Target));
 1260: 
 1261: 		// The actor info needed for the interaction.
 1262: 		FGameplayAbilityActorInfo ActorInfo;
 1263: 		ActorInfo.InitFromActor(InteractableTargetActor, TargetActor, InteractionOption.TargetAbilitySystem);
 1264: 
 1265: 		// Trigger the ability using event tag.
 1266: 
 1267: 		const bool bSuccess = InteractionOption.TargetAbilitySystem->TriggerAbilityFromGameplayEvent(
 1268: 			InteractionOption.TargetInteractionAbilityHandle,
 1269: 			&ActorInfo,
 1270: 			TAG_Ability_Interaction_Activate,
 1271: 			&Payload,
 1272: 			*InteractionOption.TargetAbilitySystem
 1273: 		);
 1274: 
 1275: 		// Notificar que se completó la interacción
 1276: 		OnInteractionComplete.Broadcast();
 1277: 	}
 1278: }
 1279: 
 1280: void UGameplayAbility_Interact::TriggerHoldInteraction()
 1281: {
 1282: 	if (CurrentOptions.Num() == 0)
 1283: 	{
 1284: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("TriggerHoldInteraction: No hay opciones de interacción disponibles"));
 1285: 		OnInteractionCancelled.Broadcast();
 1286: 		return;
 1287: 	}
 1288: 
 1289: 	UAbilitySystemComponent* AbilitySystem = GetAbilitySystemComponentFromActorInfo();
 1290: 	if (AbilitySystem)
 1291: 	{
 1292: 		const FInteractionOption& InteractionOption = CurrentOptions[0];
 1293: 
 1294: 		// Verificar si la opción de interacción soporta interacción mantenida
 1295: 		if (!InteractionOption.bSupportsHoldInteraction)
 1296: 		{
 1297: 			UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("TriggerHoldInteraction: El objeto no soporta interacción mantenida, usando interacción normal"));
 1298: 			// Si no soporta interacción mantenida, podemos usar la interacción normal en su lugar
 1299: 			TriggerInteraction();
 1300: 			return;
 1301: 		}
 1302: 
 1303: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("TriggerHoldInteraction: Activando interacción mantenida en objeto que la soporta"));
 1304: 
 1305: 		AActor* Instigator = GetAvatarActorFromActorInfo();
 1306: 		AActor* InteractableTargetActor = UInteractionStatics::GetActorFromInteractableTarget(InteractionOption.InteractableTarget);
 1307: 
 1308: 		// Configurar los datos del evento para la interacción mantenida
 1309: 		FGameplayEventData Payload;
 1310: 		Payload.EventTag = TAG_Ability_Interaction_Hold_Activate;
 1311: 		Payload.Instigator = Instigator;
 1312: 		Payload.Target = InteractableTargetActor;
 1313: 
 1314: 		// Permitir que el objetivo personalice los datos del evento
 1315: 		InteractionOption.InteractableTarget->CustomizeInteractionEventData(TAG_Ability_Interaction_Hold_Activate, Payload);
 1316: 
 1317: 		// Obtener el actor objetivo
 1318: 		AActor* TargetActor = const_cast<AActor*>(ToRawPtr(Payload.Target));
 1319: 
 1320: 		// La información del actor necesaria para la interacción
 1321: 		FGameplayAbilityActorInfo ActorInfo;
 1322: 		ActorInfo.InitFromActor(InteractableTargetActor, TargetActor, InteractionOption.TargetAbilitySystem);
 1323: 
 1324: 		// Usar el handle de habilidad específico para interacción mantenida, si está disponible
 1325: 		FGameplayAbilitySpecHandle AbilityHandle = InteractionOption.TargetHoldInteractionAbilityHandle;
 1326: 
 1327: 		// Si no hay un handle específico para interacción mantenida, usar el handle normal
 1328: 		if (!AbilityHandle.IsValid())
 1329: 		{
 1330: 			UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("TriggerHoldInteraction: No hay handle específico para interacción mantenida, usando el handle normal"));
 1331: 			AbilityHandle = InteractionOption.TargetInteractionAbilityHandle;
 1332: 		}
 1333: 		else
 1334: 		{
 1335: 			UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("TriggerHoldInteraction: Usando handle específico para interacción mantenida"));
 1336: 		}
 1337: 
 1338: 		// Activar la habilidad usando la etiqueta de evento de interacción mantenida
 1339: 		// UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("TriggerHoldInteraction: Intentando activar habilidad con tag %s"), *TAG_Ability_Interaction_Hold_Activate.ToString());
 1340: 		const bool bSuccess = InteractionOption.TargetAbilitySystem->TriggerAbilityFromGameplayEvent(
 1341: 			AbilityHandle,
 1342: 			&ActorInfo,
 1343: 			TAG_Ability_Interaction_Hold_Activate,
 1344: 			&Payload,
 1345: 			*InteractionOption.TargetAbilitySystem
 1346: 		);
 1347: 
 1348: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("TriggerHoldInteraction: Resultado de activación: %s"), bSuccess ? TEXT("Éxito") : TEXT("Fallido"));
 1349: 
 1350: 		// Notificar que se completó la interacción mantenida
 1351: 		OnHoldInteractionComplete.Broadcast();
 1352: 	}
 1353: }
 1354: 
 1355: void UGameplayAbility_Interact::OnInteractionButtonPressed()
 1356: {
 1357: 	if (CurrentOptions.Num() == 0)
 1358: 	{
 1359: 		// UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("GameplayAbility_Interact: No hay opciones de interacción disponibles"));
 1360: 		OnInteractionCancelled.Broadcast();
 1361: 		return;
 1362: 	}
 1363: 
 1364: 	// UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("GameplayAbility_Interact: Botón de interacción presionado"));
 1365: 	bIsInteractionButtonHeld = true;
 1366: 	bHoldInteractionFired = false; // Reiniciamos la bandera al comenzar una nueva interacción
 1367: 	InteractionStartTime = GetWorld()->GetTimeSeconds();
 1368: 
 1369: 	// Guardar el objetivo interactuable actual para validaciones posteriores
 1370: 	if (CurrentOptions.Num() > 0)
 1371: 	{
 1372: 		InitialInteractableTarget = CurrentOptions[0].InteractableTarget;
 1373: 		// UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("GameplayAbility_Interact: Guardando objetivo inicial de interacción"));
 1374: 	}
 1375: 
 1376: 	// Configurar un temporizador para detectar si el botón se mantiene presionado durante el tiempo requerido
 1377: 	GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().SetTimer(
 1378: 		HoldInteractionTimerHandle,
 1379: 		this,
 1380: 		&UGameplayAbility_Interact::OnHoldInteractionTimeElapsed,
 1381: 		HoldInteractionTime,
 1382: 		false
 1383: 	);
 1384: 
 1385: 	// Iniciar comprobación periódica de validez
 1386: 	GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().SetTimer(
 1387: 		ValidityCheckTimerHandle,
 1388: 		this,
 1389: 		&UGameplayAbility_Interact::CheckInteractionValidity,
 1390: 		ValidityCheckRate,
 1391: 		true // Repetitivo
 1392: 	);
 1393: 
 1394: 	// Configurar el temporizador de seguridad para forzar un reinicio después de un tiempo máximo
 1395: 	GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().SetTimer(
 1396: 		MaxInteractionTimeTimerHandle,
 1397: 		this,
 1398: 		&UGameplayAbility_Interact::OnMaxInteractionTimeElapsed,
 1399: 		MaxInteractionTime,
 1400: 		false // No repetitivo
 1401: 	);
 1402: 
 1403: 	// UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("GameplayAbility_Interact: Temporizadores configurados. Hold: %f segundos, Max: %f segundos"),
 1404: 	// 	HoldInteractionTime, MaxInteractionTime);
 1405: }
 1406: 
 1407: void UGameplayAbility_Interact::OnInteractionButtonReleased()
 1408: {
 1409: 	// UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("GameplayAbility_Interact: Botón de interacción liberado"));
 1410: 
 1411: 	if (!bIsInteractionButtonHeld)
 1412: 	{
 1413: 		// UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("GameplayAbility_Interact: El botón no estaba siendo mantenido, ignorando liberación"));
 1414: 		return;
 1415: 	}
 1416: 
 1417: 	bIsInteractionButtonHeld = false;
 1418: 
 1419: 	// Cancelar los temporizadores
 1420: 	if (GetWorld())
 1421: 	{
 1422: 		// Temporizador de validez
 1423: 		if (GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().IsTimerActive(ValidityCheckTimerHandle))
 1424: 		{
 1425: 			GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().ClearTimer(ValidityCheckTimerHandle);
 1426: 		}
 1427: 
 1428: 		// Temporizador de seguridad
 1429: 		if (GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().IsTimerActive(MaxInteractionTimeTimerHandle))
 1430: 		{
 1431: 			GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().ClearTimer(MaxInteractionTimeTimerHandle);
 1432: 		}
 1433: 
 1434: 		// Temporizador de interacción mantenida
 1435: 		if (GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().IsTimerActive(HoldInteractionTimerHandle))
 1436: 		{
 1437: 			// UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("GameplayAbility_Interact: Temporizador de hold cancelado"));
 1438: 			GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().ClearTimer(HoldInteractionTimerHandle);
 1439: 
 1440: 			// Verificamos si ya se lanzó una interacción mantenida
 1441: 			if (bHoldInteractionFired)
 1442: 			{
 1443: 				// UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("GameplayAbility_Interact: Ya se disparó una interacción mantenida, ignorando interacción rápida"));
 1444: 				return; // Si ya se disparó una interacción mantenida, no lanzamos la rápida
 1445: 			}
 1446: 
 1447: 			// Si el botón se soltó antes del tiempo de interacción mantenida, considerarlo como una pulsación rápida
 1448: 			float CurrentTime = GetWorld()->GetTimeSeconds();
 1449: 			float HoldTime = CurrentTime - InteractionStartTime;
 1450: 
 1451: 			// UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("GameplayAbility_Interact: Tiempo mantenido: %f / Requerido: %f"), HoldTime, HoldInteractionTime);
 1452: 
 1453: 			if (HoldTime < HoldInteractionTime)
 1454: 			{
 1455: 				// UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("GameplayAbility_Interact: Activando interacción rápida"));
 1456: 				// Llamar a la interacción de pulsación rápida
 1457: 				TriggerInteraction();
 1458: 
 1459: 				// Llamar a InteractPressScan después de la interacción para restaurar el estado
 1460: 				// y prepararse para la siguiente interacción
 1461: 				// Nota: Esto debe implementarse en el blueprint conectando la salida de este nodo
 1462: 				// a la entrada del nodo InteractPressScan
 1463: 			}
 1464: 		}
 1465: 		else
 1466: 		{
 1467: 			// UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("GameplayAbility_Interact: No había temporizador activo al liberar el botón"));
 1468: 		}
 1469: 	}
 1470: 
 1471: 	// Limpiar la referencia al objetivo inicial
 1472: 	InitialInteractableTarget = nullptr;
 1473: }
 1474: 
 1475: void UGameplayAbility_Interact::OnHoldInteractionTimeElapsed()
 1476: {
 1477: 	// UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("GameplayAbility_Interact: Tiempo de interacción mantenida alcanzado"));
 1478: 
 1479: 	if (bIsInteractionButtonHeld)
 1480: 	{
 1481: 		// UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("GameplayAbility_Interact: Activando interacción mantenida"));
 1482: 		// Marcamos que ya se disparó la interacción mantenida
 1483: 		bHoldInteractionFired = true;
 1484: 
 1485: 		// El botón se ha mantenido presionado durante el tiempo requerido
 1486: 		// Llamar a la interacción mantenida
 1487: 		TriggerHoldInteraction();
 1488: 
 1489: 		// Nota: Después de llamar a TriggerHoldInteraction,
 1490: 		// es necesario llamar a InteractPressScan en el blueprint
 1491: 		// para restaurar el estado y prepararse para la siguiente interacción
 1492: 		// Esto se logra escuchando al delegado OnHoldInteractionComplete
 1493: 	}
 1494: 	else
 1495: 	{
 1496: 		// UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("GameplayAbility_Interact: El botón ya no está presionado, no se activa interacción mantenida"));
 1497: 	}
 1498: }
 1499: 
 1500: void UGameplayAbility_Interact::CheckInteractionValidity()
 1501: {
 1502: 	// Si no estamos en un estado de interacción, no necesitamos verificar
 1503: 	if (!bIsInteractionButtonHeld || !InitialInteractableTarget.GetInterface())
 1504: 	{
 1505: 		return;
 1506: 	}
 1507: 
 1508: 	// Log adicional para verificar estado actual
 1509: 	UE_LOG(LogTemp, Verbose, TEXT("CheckInteractionValidity: Verificando validez de interacción. Opciones actuales: %d"), CurrentOptions.Num());
 1510: 
 1511: 	// Verificar si aún hay opciones de interacción disponibles
 1512: 	bool bHasValidInteraction = false;
 1513: 
 1514: 	if (CurrentOptions.Num() > 0)
 1515: 	{
 1516: 		// Buscar el objetivo inicial en cualquier posición del array
 1517: 		for (const FInteractionOption& Option : CurrentOptions)
 1518: 		{
 1519: 			if (Option.InteractableTarget == InitialInteractableTarget)
 1520: 			{
 1521: 				bHasValidInteraction = true;
 1522: 				break;
 1523: 			}
 1524: 		}
 1525: 
 1526: 		// Log detallado sobre la validación
 1527: 		if (bHasValidInteraction)
 1528: 		{
 1529: 			UE_LOG(LogTemp, Verbose, TEXT("CheckInteractionValidity: Objetivo de interacción aún es válido"));
 1530: 		}
 1531: 		else
 1532: 		{
 1533: 			// Intentar identificar qué cambió
 1534: 			AActor* InitialActor = UInteractionStatics::GetActorFromInteractableTarget(InitialInteractableTarget);
 1535: 			AActor* CurrentActor = CurrentOptions.Num() > 0 ?
 1536: 				UInteractionStatics::GetActorFromInteractableTarget(CurrentOptions[0].InteractableTarget) : nullptr;
 1537: 
 1538: 			UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("CheckInteractionValidity: Objetivo de interacción inválido. Inicial: %s, Actual: %s"),
 1539: 				InitialActor ? *InitialActor->GetName() : TEXT("Ninguno"),
 1540: 				CurrentActor ? *CurrentActor->GetName() : TEXT("Ninguno"));
 1541: 		}
 1542: 	}
 1543: 	else
 1544: 	{
 1545: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("CheckInteractionValidity: No hay opciones de interacción disponibles"));
 1546: 	}
 1547: 
 1548: 	// Si no hay una interacción válida, cancelar la interacción actual
 1549: 	if (!bHasValidInteraction)
 1550: 	{
 1551: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("CheckInteractionValidity: El objetivo de interacción ha cambiado o no es válido, cancelando interacción"));
 1552: 		CancelCurrentInteraction();
 1553: 	}
 1554: }
 1555: 
 1556: void UGameplayAbility_Interact::CancelCurrentInteraction()
 1557: {
 1558: 	// Si no estamos en un estado de interacción, no hay nada que cancelar
 1559: 	if (!bIsInteractionButtonHeld)
 1560: 	{
 1561: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Verbose, TEXT("CancelCurrentInteraction: No hay interacción activa para cancelar"));
 1562: 		return;
 1563: 	}
 1564: 
 1565: 	// Obtener información del objeto inicial para el log
 1566: 	FString InitialObjectName = TEXT("Desconocido");
 1567: 	if (InitialInteractableTarget.GetInterface())
 1568: 	{
 1569: 		AActor* InitialActor = UInteractionStatics::GetActorFromInteractableTarget(InitialInteractableTarget);
 1570: 		if (InitialActor)
 1571: 		{
 1572: 			InitialObjectName = InitialActor->GetName();
 1573: 		}
 1574: 	}
 1575: 
 1576: 	UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("GameplayAbility_Interact: Cancelando interacción actual con %s"), *InitialObjectName);
 1577: 
 1578: 	// Detener temporizadores
 1579: 	if (GetWorld())
 1580: 	{
 1581: 		if (GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().IsTimerActive(ValidityCheckTimerHandle))
 1582: 		{
 1583: 			GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().ClearTimer(ValidityCheckTimerHandle);
 1584: 			UE_LOG(LogTemp, Verbose, TEXT("CancelCurrentInteraction: Temporizador de validez detenido"));
 1585: 		}
 1586: 
 1587: 		if (GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().IsTimerActive(HoldInteractionTimerHandle))
 1588: 		{
 1589: 			GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().ClearTimer(HoldInteractionTimerHandle);
 1590: 			UE_LOG(LogTemp, Verbose, TEXT("CancelCurrentInteraction: Temporizador de interacción mantenida detenido"));
 1591: 		}
 1592: 
 1593: 		if (GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().IsTimerActive(MaxInteractionTimeTimerHandle))
 1594: 		{
 1595: 			GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().ClearTimer(MaxInteractionTimeTimerHandle);
 1596: 			UE_LOG(LogTemp, Verbose, TEXT("CancelCurrentInteraction: Temporizador de seguridad detenido"));
 1597: 		}
 1598: 	}
 1599: 
 1600: 	// Restablecer variables de estado
 1601: 	bIsInteractionButtonHeld = false;
 1602: 	bHoldInteractionFired = false;
 1603: 
 1604: 	// Hacer una copia de la referencia antes de limpiarla para poder notificar
 1605: 	TScriptInterface<IInteractableTarget> CanceledTarget = InitialInteractableTarget;
 1606: 	InitialInteractableTarget = nullptr;
 1607: 
 1608: 	// Log para confirmar que el estado ha sido restablecido
 1609: 	UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("GameplayAbility_Interact: Estado de interacción restablecido completamente"));
 1610: 
 1611: 	// Notificar la cancelación
 1612: 	OnInteractionCancelled.Broadcast();
 1613: }
 1614: 
 1615: void UGameplayAbility_Interact::OnMaxInteractionTimeElapsed()
 1616: {
 1617: 	// Si todavía estamos en un estado de interacción, forzar una cancelación
 1618: 	if (bIsInteractionButtonHeld)
 1619: 	{
 1620: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("GameplayAbility_Interact: ¡Tiempo máximo de interacción alcanzado! Forzando cancelación después de %f segundos"), MaxInteractionTime);
 1621: 		CancelCurrentInteraction();
 1622: 
 1623: 		// Forzar un reinicio del escaneo de interacciones
 1624: 		OnInteractionCancelled.Broadcast();
 1625: 	}
 1626: }
 1627: </file>

 1643: AActor* UInteractionStatics::GetActorFromInteractableTarget(TScriptInterface<IInteractableTarget> InteractableTarget)
 1644: {
 1645: 	if (UObject* Object = InteractableTarget.GetObject())
 1646: 	{
 1647: 		if (AActor* Actor = Cast<AActor>(Object))
 1648: 		{
 1649: 			return Actor;
 1650: 		} else if (UActorComponent* ActorComponent = Cast<UActorComponent>(Object))
 1651: 		{
 1652: 			AActor* ActorToReturn = ActorComponent->GetOwner();
 1653: 			return ActorToReturn;
 1654: 		} else
 1655: 		{
 1656: 			unimplemented()
 1657: 		}
 1658: 	}
 1659: 	return nullptr;
 1660: }

 1662: void UInteractionStatics::GetInteractableTargetsFromActor(AActor* Actor,
 1663: 	TArray<TScriptInterface<IInteractableTarget>>& OutInteractableTargets)
 1664: {
 1665: 	// If the actor is directly interactable, return that.
 1666: 	TScriptInterface<IInteractableTarget> InteractableActor(Actor);
 1667: 	if (InteractableActor)
 1668: 	{
 1669: 		OutInteractableTargets.Add(InteractableActor);
 1670: 	}
 1671: 
 1672: 	// If the actor isn't interactable, it might have a component that has a interactable interface.
 1673: 	TArray<UActorComponent*> InteractableComponents = Actor ? Actor->GetComponentsByInterface(UInteractableTarget::StaticClass()) : TArray<UActorComponent*>();
 1674: 	for (UActorComponent* InteractableComponent : InteractableComponents)
 1675: 	{
 1676: 		OutInteractableTargets.Add(TScriptInterface<IInteractableTarget>(InteractableComponent));
 1677: 	}
 1678: }

 1680: void UInteractionStatics::AppendInteractableTargetsFromOverlapResults(const TArray<FOverlapResult>& OverlapResults, TArray<TScriptInterface<IInteractableTarget>>& OutInteractableTargets)
 1681: {
 1682: 	for (const FOverlapResult& Overlap : OverlapResults)
 1683: 	{
 1684: 		TScriptInterface<IInteractableTarget> InteractableActor(Overlap.GetActor());
 1685: 		if (InteractableActor)
 1686: 		{
 1687: 			OutInteractableTargets.AddUnique(InteractableActor);
 1688: 		}
 1689: 
 1690: 		TScriptInterface<IInteractableTarget> InteractableComponent(Overlap.GetComponent());
 1691: 		if (InteractableComponent)
 1692: 		{
 1693: 			OutInteractableTargets.AddUnique(InteractableComponent);
 1694: 		}
 1695: 	}
 1696: }

 1722: 
 1723: void UWitchPTAbilitySystemComponent::GrantStartupAbilities(
 1724: 	const TArray<TSubclassOf<UGameplayAbility>>& AbilitiesToGrant)
 1725: {
 1726: 	if (!AbilitiesToGrant.IsEmpty())
 1727: 	{
 1728: 		for (const TSubclassOf<UGameplayAbility> AbilityClass: AbilitiesToGrant)
 1729: 		{
 1730: 			if (!AbilityClass)
 1731: 			{
 1732: 				continue;
 1733: 			}
 1734: 
 1735: 			// Obtener la clase de habilidad para acceder a la propiedad StartupInputTag
 1736: 			UWitchPTGameplayAbility* AbilityCDO = AbilityClass->GetDefaultObject<UWitchPTGameplayAbility>();
 1737: 			if (!AbilityCDO)
 1738: 			{
 1739: 				continue;
 1740: 			}
 1741: 
 1742: 			FGameplayAbilitySpec AbilitySpec = FGameplayAbilitySpec(AbilityClass, 1);
 1743: 			// Source of the ability is the ASC
 1744: 			AbilitySpec.SourceObject = this;
 1745: 			// Add the startup input tag to the ability spec
 1746: 			AbilitySpec.GetDynamicSpecSourceTags().AddTag(AbilityCDO->StartupInputTag);
 1747: 			// Give the ability to the ASC
 1748: 			FGameplayAbilitySpecHandle AbilitySpecHandle = GiveAbility(AbilitySpec);
 1749: 			// Store the handle of the ability
 1750: 			GrantedAbilities.Add(AbilitySpecHandle);
 1751: 		}
 1752: 	}
 1753: }
 1754: 
 1755: void UWitchPTAbilitySystemComponent::AbilityInputTagPressed(const FGameplayTag& InputTag)
 1756: {
 1757: 	if (InputTag.IsValid())
 1758: 	{
 1759: 
 1760: 		for (const FGameplayAbilitySpec& AbilitySpec : ActivatableAbilities.Items)
 1761: 		{
 1762: 			// print each ability
 1763: 
 1764: 			if (AbilitySpec.Ability && (AbilitySpec.GetDynamicSpecSourceTags().HasTagExact(InputTag)))
 1765: 			{
 1766: 				//GEngine->AddOnScreenDebugMessage(-1, 5.f, FColor::Blue, AbilitySpec.Ability->GetName());
 1767: 				InputPressedSpecHandles.AddUnique(AbilitySpec.Handle);
 1768: 				InputHeldSpecHandles.AddUnique(AbilitySpec.Handle);
 1769: 			}
 1770: 		}
 1771: 	}
 1772: }
 1773: 
 1774: void UWitchPTAbilitySystemComponent::AbilityInputTagHeld(const FGameplayTag& InputTag)
 1775: {
 1776: 	if (!InputTag.IsValid()) return;
 1777: 	for (FGameplayAbilitySpec& AbilitySpec: GetActivatableAbilities())
 1778: 	{
 1779: 		if (AbilitySpec.GetDynamicSpecSourceTags().HasTagExact(InputTag))
 1780: 		{
 1781: 			AbilitySpecInputPressed(AbilitySpec);
 1782: 			if (!AbilitySpec.IsActive())
 1783: 			{
 1784: 				TryActivateAbility(AbilitySpec.Handle);
 1785: 			}
 1786: 		}
 1787: 	}
 1788: }
 1789: 
 1790: void UWitchPTAbilitySystemComponent::AbilityInputTagReleased(const FGameplayTag& InputTag)
 1791: {
 1792: 	if (InputTag.IsValid())
 1793: 	{
 1794: 		for (const FGameplayAbilitySpec& AbilitySpec : ActivatableAbilities.Items)
 1795: 		{
 1796: 			if (AbilitySpec.Ability && (AbilitySpec.GetDynamicSpecSourceTags().HasTagExact(InputTag)))
 1797: 			{
 1798: 				InputReleasedSpecHandles.AddUnique(AbilitySpec.Handle);
 1799: 				InputHeldSpecHandles.Remove(AbilitySpec.Handle);
 1800: 			}
 1801: 		}
 1802: 	}
 1803: }

 1809: 
 1810: void UWitchPTAbilitySystemComponent::ProcessAbilityInput(float DeltaTime, bool bGamePaused)
 1811: {
 1812: 		static TArray<FGameplayAbilitySpecHandle> AbilitiesToActivate;
 1813: 	AbilitiesToActivate.Reset();
 1814: 	//
 1815: 	// Process all abilities that activate when the input is held.
 1816: 	//
 1817: 	for (const FGameplayAbilitySpecHandle& SpecHandle : InputHeldSpecHandles)
 1818: 	{
 1819: 
 1820: 
 1821: 		if (const FGameplayAbilitySpec* AbilitySpec = FindAbilitySpecFromHandle(SpecHandle))
 1822: 		{
 1823: 			if (AbilitySpec->Ability && !AbilitySpec->IsActive())
 1824: 			{
 1825: 				const UWitchPTGameplayAbility* PTAbilityBase = Cast<UWitchPTGameplayAbility>(AbilitySpec->Ability);
 1826: 				if (PTAbilityBase && PTAbilityBase->GetActivationPolicy() == EPrototypeAbilityActivationPolicy::WhileInputActive)
 1827: 				{
 1828: 					// --- MODIFICACION AQUI ---
 1829: 					// Solo añadir si la política es WhileInputActive y NO es la nueva On Triggered Event
 1830: 					if (PTAbilityBase && PTAbilityBase->GetActivationPolicy() == EPrototypeAbilityActivationPolicy::WhileInputActive)
 1831: 					{
 1832: 						AbilitiesToActivate.AddUnique(AbilitySpec->Handle);
 1833: 					}
 1834: 				}
 1835: 			}
 1836: 		}
 1837: 	}
 1838: 	//
 1839: 	// Process all abilities that had their input pressed this frame.
 1840: 	//
 1841: 	for (const FGameplayAbilitySpecHandle& SpecHandle : InputPressedSpecHandles)
 1842: 	{
 1843: 
 1844: 		if (FGameplayAbilitySpec* AbilitySpec = FindAbilitySpecFromHandle(SpecHandle))
 1845: 		{
 1846: 			if (AbilitySpec->Ability)
 1847: 			{
 1848: 				AbilitySpec->InputPressed = true;
 1849: 
 1850: 				if (AbilitySpec->IsActive())
 1851: 				{
 1852: 
 1853: 
 1854: 					// Ability is active so pass along the input event.
 1855: 					AbilitySpecInputPressed(*AbilitySpec);
 1856: 				}
 1857: 				else
 1858: 				{
 1859: 					const UWitchPTGameplayAbility* PTAbilityBase = Cast<UWitchPTGameplayAbility>(AbilitySpec->Ability);
 1860: 
 1861: 					if (PTAbilityBase && PTAbilityBase->GetActivationPolicy() == EPrototypeAbilityActivationPolicy::OnInputTriggered)
 1862: 					{
 1863: 						if (PTAbilityBase && PTAbilityBase->GetActivationPolicy() == EPrototypeAbilityActivationPolicy::OnInputTriggered)
 1864: 						{
 1865: 							AbilitiesToActivate.AddUnique(AbilitySpec->Handle);
 1866: 						}
 1867: 					}
 1868: 				}
 1869: 			}
 1870: 		}
 1871: 	}
 1872: 	//
 1873: 	// Try to activate all the abilities that are from presses and holds.
 1874: 	// We do it all at once so that held inputs don't activate the ability
 1875: 	// and then also send a input event to the ability because of the press.
 1876: 	//
 1877: 	for (const FGameplayAbilitySpecHandle& AbilitySpecHandle : AbilitiesToActivate)
 1878: 	{
 1879: 		TryActivateAbility(AbilitySpecHandle);
 1880: 	}
 1881: 	//
 1882: 	// Process all abilities that had their input released this frame.
 1883: 	//
 1884: 	for (const FGameplayAbilitySpecHandle& SpecHandle : InputReleasedSpecHandles)
 1885: 	{
 1886: 		if (FGameplayAbilitySpec* AbilitySpec = FindAbilitySpecFromHandle(SpecHandle))
 1887: 		{
 1888: 			if (AbilitySpec->Ability)
 1889: 			{
 1890: 				AbilitySpec->InputPressed = false;
 1891: 
 1892: 				if (AbilitySpec->IsActive())
 1893: 				{
 1894: 					// Ability is active so pass along the input event.
 1895: 					AbilitySpecInputReleased(*AbilitySpec);
 1896: 				}
 1897: 			}
 1898: 		}
 1899: 	}
 1900: 
 1901: 	//
 1902: 	// Clear the cached ability handles.
 1903: 	//
 1904: 	InputPressedSpecHandles.Reset();
 1905: 	InputReleasedSpecHandles.Reset();
 1906: 
 1907: }

 1909: void UWitchPTAbilitySystemComponent::AbilitySpecInputPressed(FGameplayAbilitySpec& Spec)
 1910: {
 1911: 	Super::AbilitySpecInputPressed(Spec);
 1912: 	// We don't support UGameplayAbility::bReplicateInputDirectly.
 1913: 	// Use replicated events instead so that the WaitInputPress ability task works.
 1914: 	if (Spec.IsActive())
 1915: 	{
 1916: 		PRAGMA_DISABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
 1917: 		const UGameplayAbility* Instance = Spec.GetPrimaryInstance();
 1918: 		FPredictionKey OriginalPredictionKey = Instance ? Instance->GetCurrentActivationInfo().GetActivationPredictionKey() : Spec.ActivationInfo.GetActivationPredictionKey();
 1919: 		PRAGMA_ENABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
 1920: 
 1921: 		// Invoke the InputPressed event. This is not replicated here. If someone is listening, they may replicate the InputPressed event to the server.
 1922: 		InvokeReplicatedEvent(EAbilityGenericReplicatedEvent::InputPressed, Spec.Handle, OriginalPredictionKey);
 1923: 	}
 1924: 
 1925: }
 1926: 
 1927: void UWitchPTAbilitySystemComponent::AbilitySpecInputReleased(FGameplayAbilitySpec& Spec)
 1928: {
 1929: 	Super::AbilitySpecInputReleased(Spec);
 1930: 	// We don't support UGameplayAbility::bReplicateInputDirectly.
 1931: 	// Use replicated events instead so that the WaitInputRelease ability task works.
 1932: 	if (Spec.IsActive())
 1933: 	{
 1934: 		PRAGMA_DISABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
 1935: 		const UGameplayAbility* Instance = Spec.GetPrimaryInstance();
 1936: 		FPredictionKey OriginalPredictionKey = Instance ? Instance->GetCurrentActivationInfo().GetActivationPredictionKey() : Spec.ActivationInfo.GetActivationPredictionKey();
 1937: 		PRAGMA_ENABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
 1938: 
 1939: 		// Invoke the InputReleased event. This is not replicated here. If someone is listening, they may replicate the InputReleased event to the server.
 1940: 		InvokeReplicatedEvent(EAbilityGenericReplicatedEvent::InputReleased, Spec.Handle, OriginalPredictionKey);
 1941: 	}
 1942: }

 2034: void UWitchPTAttributeSet::PostGameplayEffectExecute(const struct FGameplayEffectModCallbackData& Data)
 2035: {
 2036: 	Super::PostGameplayEffectExecute(Data);
 2037: 	if (Data.EvaluatedData.Attribute == GetMoveSpeedAttribute())
 2038: 	{
 2039: 		// SetMoveSpeed(FMath::Clamp(GetMoveSpeed(), 0.f, GetMaxMoveSpeed()));
 2040: 	}

 2142: float UWitchPTCharacterMovementComponent::GetMaxSpeed() const
 2143: {
 2144: 
 2145: 	AWitchPTCharacterBase* Owner = Cast<AWitchPTCharacterBase>(GetOwner());
 2146: 
 2147: 	if (!Owner)
 2148: 	{
 2149: 
 2150: 		return Super::GetMaxSpeed();
 2151: 	}
 2152: 
 2153: 
 2154: 
 2155: 	if (Owner->GetAbilitySystemComponent()->HasMatchingGameplayTag(FGameplayTag::RequestGameplayTag(FName("Character.State.Blocked"))))
 2156: 	{
 2157: 
 2158: 		return 0.0f;
 2159: 	}
 2160: 
 2161: 	float FinalSpeed = Owner->GetMoveSpeed();
 2162: 	if (RequestToStartSprinting)
 2163: 	{
 2164: 		FinalSpeed = Owner->GetMoveSpeed() * Owner->GetSpeedMultiplier();
 2165: 
 2166: 	}
 2167: 	// else if (RequestToStartCrouching)
 2168: 	// {
 2169: 	// 	// FinalSpeed = Owner->GetMoveSpeed() * CrouchSpeedMultiplier;
 2170: 	// 	// UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("Character %s is Crouching - Speed: %f"), *GetOwner()->GetName(), FinalSpeed);
 2171: 	// }
 2172: 
 2173: 
 2174: 	return FinalSpeed;
 2175: }

 2500: 
 2501:

 2518: void AWitchPTCharacter::InitAbilityActorInfo()
 2519: {
 2520: 	Super::InitAbilityActorInfo();
 2521: 	AWitchPTPlayerState* WitchPtPlayerState = GetPlayerState<AWitchPTPlayerState>();
 2522: 
 2523: 	if (!WitchPtPlayerState)
 2524: 	{
 2525: 		return;
 2526: 	}
 2527: 
 2528: 	WitchPtPlayerState->GetAbilitySystemComponent()->InitAbilityActorInfo(WitchPtPlayerState, this);
 2529: 
 2530: 	AbilitySystemComponent = Cast<UWitchPTAbilitySystemComponent>(WitchPtPlayerState->GetAbilitySystemComponent());
 2531: 	if (!AbilitySystemComponent)
 2532: 	{
 2533: 		return;
 2534: 	}
 2535: 
 2536: 	AbilitySystemComponent->AbilityActorInfoHaveBeenSet();
 2537: 	AttributeSet = Cast<UWitchPTAttributeSet>( WitchPtPlayerState->GetAttributeSet());
 2538: 
 2539: 
 2540: 
 2541: 	/*
 2542: 	* Here we initialize the Overlay because we have all the data we need: the player controller, player state, ability system component and attribute set.
 2543: 	* Also, the HUD is accessible from the player controller.
 2544: 	*/
 2545: 	if (AWitchPTPlayerController* WitchPT_PC = Cast<AWitchPTPlayerController>(GetController()))
 2546: 	{
 2547: 		if (AWitchPTHUD* WitchPT_HUD = Cast<AWitchPTHUD>(WitchPT_PC->GetHUD()))
 2548: 		{
 2549: 			// WitchPT_HUD->InitOverlay(WitchPT_PC, WitchPtPlayerState, AbilitySystemComponent, AttributeSet);
 2550: 			// WitchPT_HUD->InitRitualWidget(WitchPT_PC, WitchPtPlayerState, AbilitySystemComponent, AttributeSet);
 2551: 			// WitchPT_HUD->InitInventoryWidget(WitchPT_PC, WitchPtPlayerState, AbilitySystemComponent, AttributeSet);
 2552: 			// WitchPT_HUD->InitCauldronWidget(WitchPT_PC, WitchPtPlayerState, AbilitySystemComponent, AttributeSet);
 2553: 			// WitchPT_HUD->InitQuickBarWidget(WitchPT_PC, WitchPtPlayerState, AbilitySystemComponent, AttributeSet);
 2554: 			WitchPT_HUD->InitializeViewModels(WitchPT_PC, WitchPtPlayerState, AbilitySystemComponent, AttributeSet);
 2555: 
 2556: 		}
 2557: 	}
 2558: 	InitializeDefaultAttributes();
 2559: }
 2560: </file>

 2615: void AWitchPTCharacterBase::AddStartupEffects()
 2616: {
 2617: 	if (GetLocalRole() != ROLE_Authority || !IsValid(AbilitySystemComponent) || AbilitySystemComponent->bStartupEffectsApplied)
 2618: 	{
 2619: 		return;
 2620: 	}
 2621: 
 2622: 	FGameplayEffectContextHandle EffectContext = AbilitySystemComponent->MakeEffectContext();
 2623: 	EffectContext.AddSourceObject(this);
 2624: 
 2625: 	for (TSubclassOf<UGameplayEffect> GameplayEffect : StartupEffects)
 2626: 	{
 2627: 		FGameplayEffectSpecHandle NewHandle = AbilitySystemComponent->MakeOutgoingSpec(GameplayEffect, 1.f, EffectContext);
 2628: 		if (NewHandle.IsValid())
 2629: 		{
 2630: 			FActiveGameplayEffectHandle ActiveGEHandle = AbilitySystemComponent->ApplyGameplayEffectSpecToTarget(*NewHandle.Data.Get(), AbilitySystemComponent.Get());
 2631: 		}

 2830: void UWitchPTEquipmentInstance::SpawnEquipmentActors(const TArray<FWitchPTEquipmentActorToSpawn>& ActorsToSpawn)
 2831: {
 2832: 	if (APawn* OwningPawn = GetPawn())
 2833: 	{
 2834: 		USceneComponent* AttachTarget = OwningPawn->GetRootComponent();
 2835: 		if (ACharacter* Char = Cast<ACharacter>(OwningPawn))
 2836: 		{
 2837: 			AttachTarget = Char->GetMesh();
 2838: 		}
 2839: 
 2840: 		for (const FWitchPTEquipmentActorToSpawn& SpawnInfo : ActorsToSpawn)
 2841: 		{
 2842: 			AActor* NewActor = GetWorld()->SpawnActorDeferred<AActor>(SpawnInfo.ActorToSpawn, FTransform::Identity, OwningPawn);
 2843: 			NewActor->FinishSpawning(FTransform::Identity, /*bIsDefaultTransform=*/ true);
 2844: 			NewActor->SetActorRelativeTransform(SpawnInfo.AttachTransform);
 2845: 			NewActor->AttachToComponent(AttachTarget, FAttachmentTransformRules::KeepRelativeTransform, SpawnInfo.AttachSocket);
 2846: 
 2847: 			SpawnedActors.Add(NewActor);
 2848: 		}
 2849: 	}
 2850: }
 2851: 
 2852: void UWitchPTEquipmentInstance::DestroyEquipmentActors()
 2853: {
 2854: 	for (AActor* Actor : SpawnedActors)
 2855: 	{
 2856: 		if (Actor)
 2857: 		{
 2858: 			Actor->Destroy();
 2859: 		}
 2860: 	}
 2861: }

 2902: void FWitchPTEquipmentList::PreReplicatedRemove(const TArrayView<int32> RemovedIndices, int32 FinalSize)
 2903: {
 2904: 	UWitchPTEquipmentManagerComponent* EquipmentManager = Cast<UWitchPTEquipmentManagerComponent>(OwnerComponent);
 2905: 	if (!IsValid(EquipmentManager)) return;
 2906: 
 2907: 	for (int32 Index : RemovedIndices)
 2908: 	{
 2909: 		const FWitchPTEquipmentEntry& Entry = Entries[Index];
 2910: 		if (Entry.Instance != nullptr)
 2911: 		{
 2912: 			Entry.Instance->OnUnequipped();
 2913: 			EquipmentManager->OnItemUnequipped.Broadcast(Entry.Instance);
 2914: 		}
 2915: 	}
 2916: }

 2918: void FWitchPTEquipmentList::PostReplicatedAdd(const TArrayView<int32> AddedIndices, int32 FinalSize)
 2919: {

 2921: 	if (!IsValid(EquipmentManager)) return;
 2922: 
 2923: 	for (int32 Index : AddedIndices)
 2924: 	{
 2925: 		const FWitchPTEquipmentEntry& Entry = Entries[Index];
 2926: 		if (Entry.Instance != nullptr)
 2927: 		{
 2928: 			Entry.Instance->OnEquipped();

 2930: 		}
 2931: 	}
