 2938: UWitchPTEquipmentInstance* FWitchPTEquipmentList::AddEntry(TSubclassOf<UWitchPTEquipmentDefinition> EquipmentDefinition)
 2939: {
 2940: 	UWitchPTEquipmentInstance* Result = nullptr;
 2941: 
 2942: 	check(EquipmentDefinition != nullptr);
 2943: 	check(OwnerComponent);
 2944: 	check(OwnerComponent->GetOwner()->HasAuthority());
 2945: 
 2946: 	const UWitchPTEquipmentDefinition* EquipmentCDO = GetDefault<UWitchPTEquipmentDefinition>(EquipmentDefinition);
 2947: 
 2948: 	TSubclassOf<UWitchPTEquipmentInstance> InstanceType = EquipmentCDO->InstanceType;
 2949: 	if (InstanceType == nullptr)
 2950: 	{
 2951: 		InstanceType = UWitchPTEquipmentInstance::StaticClass();
 2952: 	}
 2953: 
 2954: 	FWitchPTEquipmentEntry& NewEntry = Entries.AddDefaulted_GetRef();
 2955: 	NewEntry.EquipmentDefinition = EquipmentDefinition;
 2956: 	NewEntry.Instance = NewObject<UWitchPTEquipmentInstance>(OwnerComponent->GetOwner(), InstanceType);
 2957: 	Result = NewEntry.Instance;
 2958: 
 2959: 	// Grant abilities
 2960: 	if (UAbilitySystemComponent* ASC = GetAbilitySystemComponent())
 2961: 	{
 2962: 		for (TSubclassOf<UGameplayAbility> AbilityClass : EquipmentCDO->AbilitiesToGrant)
 2963: 		{
 2964: 			if (AbilityClass)
 2965: 			{
 2966: 				FGameplayAbilitySpec AbilitySpec(AbilityClass, 1, INDEX_NONE, Result);
 2967: 				FGameplayAbilitySpecHandle Handle = ASC->GiveAbility(AbilitySpec);
 2968: 				NewEntry.AbilityHandles.GrantedHandles.Add(Handle);
 2969: 				UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("🎯 Granted ability: %s"), *AbilityClass->GetName());
 2970: 			}
 2971: 		}
 2972: 	}
 2973: 	Result->SpawnEquipmentActors(EquipmentCDO->ActorsToSpawn);
 2974: 
 2975: 	MarkItemDirty(NewEntry);
 2976: 	return Result;
 2977: }
 2978: 
 2979: void FWitchPTEquipmentList::RemoveEntry(UWitchPTEquipmentInstance* Instance)
 2980: {
 2981: 	for (auto EntryIt = Entries.CreateIterator(); EntryIt; ++EntryIt)
 2982: 	{
 2983: 		FWitchPTEquipmentEntry& Entry = *EntryIt;
 2984: 		if (Entry.Instance == Instance)
 2985: 		{
 2986: 			// Remove abilities
 2987: 			if (UAbilitySystemComponent* ASC = GetAbilitySystemComponent())
 2988: 			{
 2989: 				for (const FGameplayAbilitySpecHandle& Handle : Entry.AbilityHandles.GrantedHandles)
 2990: 				{
 2991: 					if (Handle.IsValid())
 2992: 					{
 2993: 						ASC->ClearAbility(Handle);
 2994: 						UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("🚫 Removed ability"));
 2995: 					}
 2996: 				}
 2997: 			}
 2998: 
 2999: 			EntryIt.RemoveCurrent();
 3000: 			Instance->DestroyEquipmentActors();
 3001: 			MarkArrayDirty();
 3002: 		}
 3003: 	}
 3004: }
 3005:

 3007: {

 3009: 	AActor* OwningActor = OwnerComponent->GetOwner();
 3010: 	return Cast<UAbilitySystemComponent>(UAbilitySystemGlobals::GetAbilitySystemComponentFromActor(OwningActor));
 3011: }

 3028: bool UWitchPTEquipmentManagerComponent::ReplicateSubobjects(class UActorChannel* Channel, class FOutBunch* Bunch,
 3029: 	FReplicationFlags* RepFlags)
 3030: {
 3031: 	bool WroteSomething = Super::ReplicateSubobjects(Channel, Bunch, RepFlags);
 3032: 
 3033: 	for (FWitchPTEquipmentEntry& Entry : EquipmentList.Entries)
 3034: 	{
 3035: 		UWitchPTEquipmentInstance* Instance = Entry.Instance;
 3036: 		if (IsValid(Instance))
 3037: 		{
 3038: 			WroteSomething |= Channel->ReplicateSubobject(Instance, *Bunch, *RepFlags);
 3039: 		}
 3040: 	}
 3041: 
 3042: 	return WroteSomething;
 3043: }

 3050: void UWitchPTEquipmentManagerComponent::UninitializeComponent()
 3051: {
 3052: 	TArray<UWitchPTEquipmentInstance*> AllEquipmentInstances;
 3053: 
 3054: 	// Gather all instances before removal to avoid side effects affecting the equipment list iterator
 3055: 	for (const FWitchPTEquipmentEntry& Entry : EquipmentList.Entries)
 3056: 	{
 3057: 		AllEquipmentInstances.Add(Entry.Instance);
 3058: 	}
 3059: 
 3060: 	for (UWitchPTEquipmentInstance* EquipInstance : AllEquipmentInstances)
 3061: 	{
 3062: 		UnequipItem(EquipInstance);
 3063: 	}
 3064: 
 3065: 	Super::UninitializeComponent();
 3066: }

 3068: void UWitchPTEquipmentManagerComponent::ReadyForReplication()
 3069: {

 3071: 	// Register existing equipment instances
 3072: 	if (IsUsingRegisteredSubObjectList())
 3073: 	{
 3074: 		for (const FWitchPTEquipmentEntry& Entry : EquipmentList.Entries)
 3075: 		{
 3076: 			UWitchPTEquipmentInstance* Instance = Entry.Instance;
 3077: 			if (IsValid(Instance))
 3078: 			{
 3079: 				AddReplicatedSubObject(Instance);
 3080: 			}
 3081: 		}
 3082: 	}
 3083: }

 3085: void UWitchPTEquipmentManagerComponent::EquipItem(TSubclassOf<UWitchPTEquipmentDefinition> EquipmentDefinition)
 3086: {
 3087: 	if (GetOwner()->GetLocalRole() < ROLE_Authority)
 3088: 	{
 3089: 		Server_EquipItem(EquipmentDefinition);
 3090: 	}
 3091: 	else
 3092: 	{
 3093: 		if (EquipmentDefinition != nullptr)
 3094: 		{
 3095: 			UWitchPTEquipmentInstance* NewInstance = EquipmentList.AddEntry(EquipmentDefinition);
 3096: 			if (NewInstance != nullptr)
 3097: 			{
 3098: 				NewInstance->OnEquipped();
 3099: 				OnItemEquipped.Broadcast(NewInstance);
 3100: 
 3101: 				if (IsUsingRegisteredSubObjectList())
 3102: 				{
 3103: 					AddReplicatedSubObject(NewInstance);
 3104: 				}
 3105: 			}
 3106: 		}
 3107: 	}
 3108: }

 3115: void UWitchPTEquipmentManagerComponent::UnequipItem(UWitchPTEquipmentInstance* ItemInstance)

 3118: 	{
 3119: 		Server_UnequipItem(ItemInstance);
 3120: 	}
 3121: 	else
 3122: 	{
 3123: 		if (ItemInstance != nullptr)
 3124: 		{
 3125: 			if (IsUsingRegisteredSubObjectList())
 3126: 			{
 3127: 				RemoveReplicatedSubObject(ItemInstance);
 3128: 			}
 3129: 
 3130: 			ItemInstance->OnUnequipped();

 3413: TScriptInterface<ICollectable> UCollectableStatics::GetFirstPickupableFromActor(AActor* Actor)
 3414: {
 3415: 	TScriptInterface<ICollectable> PickupableActor(Actor);
 3416: 	if (PickupableActor)
 3417: 	{
 3418: 		return PickupableActor;
 3419: 	}
 3420: 
 3421: 	TArray<UActorComponent*> PickupableComponents = Actor ? Actor->GetComponentsByInterface(UCollectable::StaticClass()) : TArray<UActorComponent*>();
 3422: 	if (PickupableComponents.Num() > 0)
 3423: 	{
 3424: 		return TScriptInterface<ICollectable>(PickupableComponents[0]);
 3425: 	}
 3426: 
 3427: 	return TScriptInterface<ICollectable>();
 3428: }

 3475: {

 3491: 	}

 3505: UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* FWitchPTInventoryList::AddEntry(TSubclassOf<UWitchPTInventoryItemDefinition> ItemDef)
 3506: {
 3507: 	UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* Result = nullptr;
 3508: 
 3509: 	check(ItemDef != nullptr);
 3510: 	check(OwnerComponent);
 3511: 
 3512: 	AActor* OwningActor = OwnerComponent->GetOwner();
 3513: 	check(OwningActor->HasAuthority());
 3514: 
 3515: 
 3516: 	FWitchPTInventoryEntry& NewEntry = Entries.AddDefaulted_GetRef();
 3517: 	NewEntry.Instance = NewObject<UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance>(OwnerComponent->GetOwner());
 3518: 	NewEntry.Instance->SetItemDef(ItemDef);
 3519: 	// ------ Stack stuff
 3520: 	const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment* BaseFragment = NewEntry.Instance->FindFragmentByClass(UWitchPTInventoryFragment_Stackable::StaticClass());
 3521: 	const UWitchPTInventoryFragment_Stackable* StackableFragment = Cast<UWitchPTInventoryFragment_Stackable>(BaseFragment);
 3522: 	if (IsValid(StackableFragment))
 3523: 	{
 3524: 		NewEntry.Instance->SetTotalStackCount(StackableFragment->GetStackCount());
 3525: 	}
 3526: 	for (UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment* Fragment : GetDefault<UWitchPTInventoryItemDefinition>(ItemDef)->Fragments)
 3527: 	{
 3528: 		if (Fragment != nullptr)
 3529: 		{
 3530: 			Fragment->OnInstanceCreated(NewEntry.Instance);
 3531: 		}
 3532: 	}
 3533: 
 3534: 	Result = NewEntry.Instance;
 3535: 
 3536: 
 3537: 	MarkItemDirty(NewEntry);
 3538: 
 3539: 	return Result;
 3540: }
 3541: 
 3542: void FWitchPTInventoryList::AddEntry(UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* Instance)
 3543: {
 3544: 	unimplemented();
 3545: }

 3547: void FWitchPTInventoryList::RemoveEntry(UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* Instance)
 3548: {
 3549: 	for (auto EntryIt = Entries.CreateIterator(); EntryIt; ++EntryIt)
 3550: 	{
 3551: 		FWitchPTInventoryEntry& Entry = *EntryIt;
 3552: 		if (Entry.Instance == Instance)
 3553: 		{
 3554: 			EntryIt.RemoveCurrent();
 3555: 			MarkArrayDirty();
 3556: 		}
 3557: 	}
 3558: }

 3560: {

 3562: 	Results.Reserve(Entries.Num());
 3563: 	for (const FWitchPTInventoryEntry& Entry : Entries)
 3564: 	{
 3565: 		if (Entry.Instance != nullptr) //@TODO: Would prefer to not deal with this here and hide it further?
 3566: 		{
 3567: 			Results.Add(Entry.Instance);
 3568: 		}
 3569: 	}
 3570: 	return Results;

 3621: bool UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_PotionProperties::IsValidPotion() const
 3622: {
 3623: 	// Basic validation: check if we have essential potion properties
 3624: 	return PotionEssenceTag.IsValid() &&
 3625: 		   FinalPotency > 0.0f &&
 3626: 		   FinalDuration > 0.0f &&
 3627: 		   FinalCharges > 0;
 3628: }
 3629: 
 3630: FString UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_PotionProperties::GetPotionDescription() const
 3631: {
 3632: 	if (!IsValidPotion())
 3633: 	{
 3634: 		return TEXT("Invalid Potion");
 3635: 	}
 3636: 
 3637: 	// Create a simple description string
 3638: 	FString Description = FString::Printf(
 3639: 		TEXT("%s Potion\nPotency: %.1f\nDuration: %.1fs\nCharges: %d"),
 3640: 		*PotionEssenceTag.GetTagName().ToString(),
 3641: 		FinalPotency,
 3642: 		FinalDuration,
 3643: 		FinalCharges
 3644: 	);
 3645: 
 3646: 	// Add tier information if available
 3647: 	if (PotionTierTag.IsValid())
 3648: 	{
 3649: 		Description += FString::Printf(TEXT("\nTier: %s"), *PotionTierTag.GetTagName().ToString());
 3650: 	}
 3651: 
 3652: 	// Add base liquid information if available
 3653: 	if (BaseLiquidTypeTag.IsValid())
 3654: 	{
 3655: 		Description += FString::Printf(TEXT("\nBase: %s"), *BaseLiquidTypeTag.GetTagName().ToString());
 3656: 	}
 3657: 
 3658: 	// Add effects count if present
 3659: 	if (GrantedEffectTags.Num() > 0)
 3660: 	{
 3661: 		Description += FString::Printf(TEXT("\nEffects: %d"), GrantedEffectTags.Num());
 3662: 	}
 3663: 
 3664: 	// Add properties count if present
 3665: 	if (GrantedPropertyTags.Num() > 0)
 3666: 	{
 3667: 		Description += FString::Printf(TEXT("\nProperties: %d"), GrantedPropertyTags.Num());
 3668: 	}
 3669: 
 3670: 	return Description;
 3671: }
 3672:

 3674: 	const FGameplayTag& InPotionEssence,
 3675: 	const FGameplayTag& InBaseLiquidType,
 3676: 	float InPotency,
 3677: 	float InDuration,
 3678: 	int32 InCharges,
 3679: 	const FGameplayTag& InTierTag,

 3683: 	PotionEssenceTag = InPotionEssence;

 3687: 	FinalCharges = InCharges;
 3688: 	PotionTierTag = InTierTag;

 3691: 
 3692: 	UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_PotionProperties::SetPotionProperties: Potion properties set - %s, Potency: %.2f, Duration: %.2f, Charges: %d"),
 3693: 		   *PotionEssenceTag.ToString(),

 3806: const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment* UWitchPTInventoryItemDefinition::FindFragmentByClass(

 3808: {
 3809: 	if (FragmentClass != nullptr)
 3810: 	{

 3812: 		{

 3915: void UWitchPTInventoryManagerComponent::Server_AddStacksToItem_Implementation(TSubclassOf<UWitchPTInventoryItemDefinition> ItemDef)
 3916: {
 3917: 	if(IsValid(ItemDef))
 3918: 	{
 3919: 		UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* FoundItem = FindFirstItemStackByDefinition(ItemDef);
 3920: 		const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment* BaseFragment = FoundItem->FindFragmentByClass(UWitchPTInventoryFragment_Stackable::StaticClass());
 3921: 		const UWitchPTInventoryFragment_Stackable* StackableFragment = Cast<UWitchPTInventoryFragment_Stackable>(BaseFragment);
 3922: 
 3923: 		int32 NewStackCount = FoundItem->GetTotalStackCount() + StackableFragment->GetStackCount();
 3924: 		Server_UpdateItemStackCount(FoundItem, NewStackCount);
 3925: 	}
 3926: }
 3927: 
 3928: void UWitchPTInventoryManagerComponent::Server_UpdateItemStackCount_Implementation(UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* ItemInstance, int32 NewCount)
 3929: {
 3930: 	if (IsValid(ItemInstance))
 3931: 	{
 3932: 		ItemInstance->SetTotalStackCount(NewCount);
 3933: 
 3934: 		// Marcar la entrada como sucia para la replicación
 3935: 		for (FWitchPTInventoryEntry& Entry : InventoryList.Entries)
 3936: 		{
 3937: 			if (Entry.Instance == ItemInstance)
 3938: 			{
 3939: 				InventoryList.MarkItemDirty(Entry);
 3940: 				break;
 3941: 			}
 3942: 		}
 3943: 
 3944: 		if (GetOwner()->GetNetMode() == NM_ListenServer || GetOwner()->GetNetMode() == NM_Standalone)
 3945: 		{
 3946: 			OnItemStackChanged.Broadcast(ItemInstance);
 3947: 		}
 3948: 	}
 3949: }
 3950: 
 3951: void UWitchPTInventoryManagerComponent::Server_RemoveItemInstance_Implementation(UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* ItemInstance)
 3952: {
 3953: 	if (IsValid(ItemInstance))
 3954: 	{
 3955: 		// Notificar antes de eliminar para que los listeners puedan usar la información del item
 3956: 		if (GetOwner()->GetNetMode() == NM_ListenServer || GetOwner()->GetNetMode() == NM_Standalone)
 3957: 		{
 3958: 			OnItemRemoved.Broadcast(ItemInstance);
 3959: 		}
 3960: 
 3961: 		// Eliminar el item de la lista de inventario
 3962: 		InventoryList.RemoveEntry(ItemInstance);
 3963: 
 3964: 		// Desregistrar el subobjeto para la replicación
 3965: 		if (IsUsingRegisteredSubObjectList())
 3966: 		{
 3967: 			RemoveReplicatedSubObject(ItemInstance);
 3968: 		}
 3969: 	}
 3970: }
 3971: 
 3972: void UWitchPTInventoryManagerComponent::Server_RemoveItemStacks_Implementation(UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* ItemInstance, int32 AmountToRemove)
 3973: {
 3974: 	if (IsValid(ItemInstance))
 3975: 	{
 3976: 		const int32 CurrentCount = ItemInstance->GetTotalStackCount();
 3977: 		const int32 NewCount = FMath::Max(0, CurrentCount - AmountToRemove);
 3978: 
 3979: 		// Si el nuevo conteo es cero, eliminar el item completamente
 3980: 		if (NewCount <= 0)
 3981: 		{
 3982: 			Server_RemoveItemInstance(ItemInstance);
 3983: 		}
 3984: 		else
 3985: 		{
 3986: 			// Actualizar el conteo de stacks
 3987: 			Server_UpdateItemStackCount(ItemInstance, NewCount);
 3988: 		}
 3989: 	}
 3990: }

 4005: 	if (FoundItem)

 4070: int32 UWitchPTInventoryManagerComponent::GetTotalItemCountByDefinition(
 4071: 	TSubclassOf<UWitchPTInventoryItemDefinition> ItemDef) const

 4074: 	for (const FWitchPTInventoryEntry& Entry : InventoryList.Entries)
 4075: 	{
 4076: 		UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* Instance = Entry.Instance;
 4077: 
 4078: 		if (IsValid(Instance))
 4079: 		{
 4080: 			if (Instance->GetItemDef() == ItemDef)
 4081: 			{

 4090: bool UWitchPTInventoryManagerComponent::ConsumeItemsByDefinition(TSubclassOf<UWitchPTInventoryItemDefinition> ItemDef,
 4091: 	int32 NumToConsume)
 4092: {
 4093: 	AActor* OwningActor = GetOwner();
 4094: 	if (!OwningActor || !OwningActor->HasAuthority())
 4095: 	{
 4096: 		return false;
 4097: 	}
 4098: 
 4099: 	//@TODO: N squared right now as there's no acceleration structure
 4100: 	int32 TotalConsumed = 0;
 4101: 	while (TotalConsumed < NumToConsume)
 4102: 	{
 4103: 		if (UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* Instance = UWitchPTInventoryManagerComponent::FindFirstItemStackByDefinition(ItemDef))
 4104: 		{
 4105: 			InventoryList.RemoveEntry(Instance);
 4106: 			++TotalConsumed;
 4107: 		}
 4108: 		else
 4109: 		{
 4110: 			return false;
 4111: 		}
 4112: 	}
 4113: 
 4114: 	return TotalConsumed == NumToConsume;
 4115: }

 4118: bool UWitchPTInventoryManagerComponent::ReplicateSubobjects(class UActorChannel* Channel, class FOutBunch* Bunch,
 4119:                                                             FReplicationFlags* RepFlags)
 4120: {
 4121: 	bool WroteSomething = Super::ReplicateSubobjects(Channel, Bunch, RepFlags);
 4122: 
 4123: 	for (FWitchPTInventoryEntry& Entry : InventoryList.Entries)
 4124: 	{
 4125: 		UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* Instance = Entry.Instance;
 4126: 
 4127: 		if (Instance && IsValid(Instance))
 4128: 		{
 4129: 			WroteSomething |= Channel->ReplicateSubobject(Instance, *Bunch, *RepFlags);
 4130: 		}
 4131: 	}
 4132: 
 4133: 	return WroteSomething;
 4134: }

 4145:

 4147: 			{
 4148: 				AddReplicatedSubObject(Instance);
 4149: 			}
 4150: 		}
 4151: 	}

 4225: void ABaseInteractableAltar::CreateAltarPositions()
 4226: {
 4227:     if (!HasAuthority() || !PositionClass)
 4228:     {
 4229:         return;
 4230:     }
 4231: 
 4232:     // Make sure we have no previous positions
 4233:     DestroyAltarPositions();
 4234: 
 4235:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("ACauldronAltar::CreateBrewingPositions: Creating %d brewing positions"), PositionTransforms.Num());
 4236:     int positionIndex = 0;
 4237:     // Spawn a CauldronPosition for each transform
 4238:     for (const FTransform& PosTransform : PositionTransforms)
 4239:     {
 4240:         // Transform relative to world space
 4241:         FTransform WorldTransform = PosTransform * GetActorTransform();
 4242: 
 4243:         // Get location and rotation from the transform
 4244:         FVector Location = WorldTransform.GetLocation();
 4245:         FRotator Rotation = WorldTransform.Rotator();
 4246: 
 4247:         // Spawn parameters
 4248:         FActorSpawnParameters SpawnParams;
 4249:         SpawnParams.Owner = this;
 4250:         SpawnParams.SpawnCollisionHandlingOverride = ESpawnActorCollisionHandlingMethod::AdjustIfPossibleButAlwaysSpawn;
 4251: 
 4252:         // Spawn the brewing position
 4253:         ABaseInteractionPosition* NewPosition = GetWorld()->SpawnActor<ABaseInteractionPosition>(
 4254:             PositionClass,
 4255:             Location,
 4256:             Rotation,
 4257:             SpawnParams);
 4258: 
 4259:         if (NewPosition)
 4260:         {
 4261:             // Initialize the position
 4262:             // Note: Implement this method in CauldronPosition if needed
 4263:             // NewPosition->SetCauldronAltar(this);
 4264:             NewPosition->SetPositionTag(TagsPositions[positionIndex]);
 4265:             ARitualPosition* RitualPosition = Cast<ARitualPosition>(NewPosition);
 4266:             if (RitualPosition)
 4267:             {
 4268:                 RitualPosition->SetRitualAltar(Cast<ARitualAltar>(this));
 4269:             }
 4270:             positionIndex++;
 4271: 
 4272: 
 4273:             // Add to our array
 4274:             InteractionPositions.Add(NewPosition);
 4275: 
 4276:             UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("ACauldronAltar::CreateBrewingPositions: Created position at %s"), *Location.ToString());
 4277:         }
 4278:     }
 4279: }
 4280: 
 4281: 
 4282: 
 4283: void ABaseInteractableAltar::DestroyAltarPositions()
 4284: {
 4285:     // Only destroy positions on the server
 4286:     if (!HasAuthority())
 4287:     {
 4288:         return;
 4289:     }
 4290: 
 4291:     // Destroy all brewing positions
 4292:     for (ABaseInteractionPosition* Position : InteractionPositions)
 4293:     {
 4294:         if (Position)
 4295:         {
 4296:             Position->Destroy();
 4297:         }
 4298:     }
 4299: 
 4300:     // Clear the array
 4301:     InteractionPositions.Empty();
 4302: 
 4303:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("Altar::DestroyAltarPositions: All altar positions destroyed"));
 4304: }

 4665: void ACauldronAltar::AttachToCharacter(ACharacter* Character)
 4666: {
 4667:     if (!Character || !HasAuthority())
 4668:     {
 4669:         return;
 4670:     }
 4671: 
 4672:     // First destroy any brewing positions
 4673:     DestroyAltarPositions();
 4674: 
 4675:     // Set the cauldron state to moving
 4676:     CauldronPhysicState = ECauldronPhysicState::Moving;
 4677:     CarryingCharacter = Character;
 4678: 
 4679:     // Attach the cauldron to the character's back
 4680:     FAttachmentTransformRules AttachRules(EAttachmentRule::SnapToTarget, EAttachmentRule::SnapToTarget,
 4681:                                           EAttachmentRule::KeepWorld, true);
 4682: 
 4683:     // Find the socket to attach to
 4684:     USkeletalMeshComponent* CharacterMesh = Character->GetMesh();
 4685:     if (CharacterMesh && CharacterMesh->DoesSocketExist(BackAttachSocketName))
 4686:     {
 4687:         // Attach to the socket
 4688:         AttachToComponent(CharacterMesh, AttachRules, BackAttachSocketName);
 4689: 
 4690:         // Disable collision
 4691:         SetActorEnableCollision(false);
 4692: 
 4693:         // Reduce de Scale of the Cauldron
 4694:         SetActorScale3D(FVector(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f));
 4695: 
 4696:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("ACauldronAltar::AttachToCharacter: Cauldron attached to %s"), *Character->GetName());
 4697:     }
 4698: }

 4700: void ACauldronAltar::DetachFromCharacter(ACharacter* Character)
 4701: {
 4702:     if (!Character || !HasAuthority() || Character != CarryingCharacter)
 4703:     {
 4704:         return;
 4705:     }
 4706: 
 4707:     // Detach from the character
 4708:     DetachFromActor(FDetachmentTransformRules::KeepWorldTransform);
 4709: 
 4710:     // Place the cauldron in front of the character
 4711:     FVector CharacterLocation = Character->GetActorLocation();
 4712:     FRotator CharacterRotation = Character->GetActorRotation();
 4713:     FVector PlacementOffset = CharacterRotation.RotateVector(DetachmentOffset);
 4714: 
 4715:     // Set the cauldron's location
 4716:     SetActorLocation(CharacterLocation + PlacementOffset);
 4717: 
 4718:     // Reset the cauldron state
 4719:     CauldronPhysicState = ECauldronPhysicState::Static;
 4720:     CarryingCharacter = nullptr;
 4721: 
 4722:     // Reset cauldron scale to normal
 4723:     SetActorScale3D(FVector(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f));
 4724: 
 4725:     // Enable collision
 4726:     SetActorEnableCollision(true);
 4727: 
 4728:     // Create brewing positions around the cauldron
 4729:     CreateAltarPositions();
 4730: 
 4731:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("ACauldronAltar::DetachFromCharacter: Cauldron detached from %s"), *Character->GetName());
 4732: 
 4733:     // Play placement sound or effects
 4734:     // PlayPlacementEffects();
 4735: }

 4781: ABaseInteractionPosition* ACauldronAltar::GetAvailableBrewingPosition(ACharacter* Character)

 4784:     if (InteractionPositions.Num() == 0)

 4787:         return nullptr;

 4789: 
 4790:     // Buscar la primera posición disponible
 4791:     for (ABaseInteractionPosition* Position : InteractionPositions)
 4792:     {

 4794:         {
 4795:             return Position;

 4800:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("ACauldronAltar::GetAvailableBrewingPosition: All positions are occupied"));

 4805: // --- Nueva implementación para colocación del caldero ---
 4806: 
 4807: void ACauldronAltar::StartPlacementPreview(ACharacter* Character)
 4808: {
 4809:     if (!Character || Character != CarryingCharacter || !HasAuthority())
 4810:     {
 4811:         return;
 4812:     }
 4813: 
 4814:     // Desacoplar el caldero del personaje
 4815:     DetachFromActor(FDetachmentTransformRules::KeepWorldTransform);
 4816: 
 4817:     // Establecer el estado de previsualización
 4818:     CauldronPhysicState = ECauldronPhysicState::Previewing;
 4819: 
 4820:     // Guardar los materiales originales para restaurarlos después
 4821:     UStaticMeshComponent* MeshComponent = FindComponentByClass<UStaticMeshComponent>();
 4822:     if (MeshComponent)
 4823:     {
 4824:         OriginalMaterials.Empty();
 4825:         for (int32 i = 0; i < MeshComponent->GetNumMaterials(); i++)
 4826:         {
 4827:             OriginalMaterials.Add(MeshComponent->GetMaterial(i));
 4828:         }
 4829:     }
 4830: 
 4831:     // Aplicar material de previsualización
 4832:     CurrentPlacementState = ECauldronPlacementState::Invalid; // Por defecto, inválido hasta que se verifique
 4833:     // ApplyPlacementPreviewMaterial();
 4834: 
 4835:     // Desactivar colisiones durante la previsualización
 4836:     SetActorEnableCollision(false);
 4837: 
 4838:     // Colocar inicialmente el caldero frente al personaje
 4839:     FVector CharacterLocation = Character->GetActorLocation();
 4840:     FRotator CharacterRotation = Character->GetActorRotation();
 4841:     FVector PlacementOffset = CharacterRotation.RotateVector(DetachmentOffset);
 4842: 
 4843:     // Guardar la posición inicial
 4844:     PreviewLocation = CharacterLocation + PlacementOffset;
 4845:     // PreviewRotation = CharacterRotation;
 4846:     // Reset z rotation
 4847:     PreviewRotation.Pitch = 0;
 4848:     PreviewRotation.Roll = 0;
 4849:     PreviewRotation.Yaw = 0;
 4850:     // Establecer la posición del caldero
 4851:     SetActorLocation(PreviewLocation);
 4852:     SetActorRotation(PreviewRotation);
 4853: 
 4854:     // Restablecer la escala normal
 4855:     Multicast_FinalizePlacement();
 4856: }

 4858: void ACauldronAltar::Client_UpdatePlacementPreview_Implementation(const FVector& HitLocation, const FVector& HitNormal)
 4859: {
 4860:     // Actualizar el material según el estado

 4862: }
 4863: 
 4864: void ACauldronAltar::UpdatePlacementPreview(const FVector& HitLocation, const FVector& HitNormal)
 4865: {
 4866:     // Llamar a la implementación del cliente para actualizar la previsualización
 4867:     // Client_UpdatePlacementPreview(HitLocation, HitNormal);
 4868:     if (!IsInPlacementPreview())
 4869:     {
 4870:         return;
 4871:     }
 4872: 
 4873:     // Guardar la nueva posición de previsualización
 4874:     PreviewLocation = HitLocation;
 4875: 
 4876:     // Calcular la rotación para alinear con la superficie
 4877:     FRotator SurfaceAlignedRotation = HitNormal.Rotation();
 4878: 
 4879:     // Ajustar la rotación para que el caldero se alinee con la superficie pero mantenga su orientación "hacia arriba"
 4880:     // Necesitamos solo el componente de inclinación de la superficie
 4881:     FRotator AdjustedRotation = FRotator(SurfaceAlignedRotation.Pitch, PreviewRotation.Yaw, SurfaceAlignedRotation.Roll);
 4882: 
 4883:     // Limitar la inclinación máxima
 4884:     if (FMath::Abs(AdjustedRotation.Pitch) > 15.0f)
 4885:     {
 4886:         AdjustedRotation.Pitch = FMath::Clamp(AdjustedRotation.Pitch, 0.f, 0.f);
 4887:     }
 4888: 
 4889:     if (FMath::Abs(AdjustedRotation.Roll) > 15.0f)
 4890:     {
 4891:         AdjustedRotation.Roll = FMath::Clamp(AdjustedRotation.Roll, 0.f, 0.f);
 4892:     }
 4893: 
 4894:     PreviewRotation = AdjustedRotation;
 4895:     SetActorScale3D(FVector(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f));
 4896:     SetActorLocation(PreviewLocation);
 4897: 
 4898:     // Verificar si la posición es válida
 4899:     CurrentPlacementState = IsPlacementValid() ? ECauldronPlacementState::Valid : ECauldronPlacementState::Invalid;
 4900: }
 4901: 
 4902: void ACauldronAltar::FinalizePlacement()
 4903: {
 4904:     if (!IsInPlacementPreview() || !HasAuthority())
 4905:     {
 4906:         return;
 4907:     }
 4908: 
 4909:     // Establecer la posición final
 4910:     SetActorScale3D(FVector(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f));
 4911:     SetActorLocation(PreviewLocation);
 4912:     SetActorRotation(PreviewRotation);
 4913: 
 4914:     // Restaurar los materiales originales
 4915:     RestoreOriginalMaterials();
 4916: 
 4917:     // Activar colisiones
 4918:     SetActorEnableCollision(true);
 4919: 
 4920:     // Cambiar el estado
 4921:     CauldronPhysicState = ECauldronPhysicState::Static;
 4922:     CarryingCharacter = nullptr;
 4923:     CurrentPlacementState = ECauldronPlacementState::None;
 4924: 
 4925:     OnECauldronPhysicStateChanged.Broadcast(ECauldronPhysicState::Static);
 4926: 
 4927:     // Crear posiciones de elaboración alrededor del caldero
 4928:     CreateAltarPositions();
 4929: 
 4930:     // Multicast finalizar placement
 4931:     Multicast_FinalizePlacement();
 4932: 
 4933:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("ACauldronAltar::FinalizePlacement: Cauldron placed successfully"));
 4934: }

 4936: void ACauldronAltar::CancelPlacement()
 4937: {
 4938:     if (!IsInPlacementPreview() || !HasAuthority())
 4939:     {
 4940:         return;
 4941:     }
 4942: 
 4943:     // Restaurar materiales originales
 4944:     RestoreOriginalMaterials();
 4945: 
 4946:     // Recolocar el caldero en el personaje
 4947:     ACharacter* Character = CarryingCharacter;
 4948: 
 4949:     // Reiniciar estado
 4950:     CauldronPhysicState = ECauldronPhysicState::Moving;
 4951:     CarryingCharacter = nullptr;
 4952:     CurrentPlacementState = ECauldronPlacementState::None;
 4953: 
 4954:     // Volver a adjuntar el caldero al personaje
 4955:     if (Character)
 4956:     {
 4957:         AttachToCharacter(Character);
 4958:     }
 4959: 
 4960:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("ACauldronAltar::CancelPlacement: Placement canceled"));
 4961: }

 5010: void ACauldronAltar::ApplyPlacementPreviewMaterial()
 5011: {
 5012:     UStaticMeshComponent* MeshComponent = FindComponentByClass<UStaticMeshComponent>();
 5013:     if (!MeshComponent)
 5014:     {
 5015:         return;
 5016:     }
 5017: 
 5018:     // Determinar qué material aplicar según el estado
 5019:     UMaterialInterface* MaterialToApply = CurrentPlacementState == ECauldronPlacementState::Valid ?
 5020:         ValidPlacementMaterial : InvalidPlacementMaterial;
 5021: 
 5022:     // Si no tenemos un material específico, no hacemos nada
 5023:     if (!MaterialToApply)
 5024:     {
 5025:         return;
 5026:     }
 5027: 
 5028:     // Aplicar el material a todos los elementos del mesh
 5029:     for (int32 i = 0; i < MeshComponent->GetNumMaterials(); i++)
 5030:     {
 5031:         MeshComponent->SetMaterial(i, MaterialToApply);
 5032:     }
 5033: }
 5034: 
 5035: void ACauldronAltar::RestoreOriginalMaterials()
 5036: {
 5037:     // Restaurar los materiales originales si estamos fuera del modo de previsualización
 5038:     if (CauldronPhysicState != ECauldronPhysicState::Previewing)
 5039:     {
 5040:         UStaticMeshComponent* MeshComponent = FindComponentByClass<UStaticMeshComponent>();
 5041:         if (MeshComponent && OriginalMaterials.Num() > 0)
 5042:         {
 5043:             for (int32 i = 0; i < FMath::Min(MeshComponent->GetNumMaterials(), OriginalMaterials.Num()); i++)
 5044:             {
 5045:                 if (OriginalMaterials[i])
 5046:                 {
 5047:                     MeshComponent->SetMaterial(i, OriginalMaterials[i]);
 5048:                 }
 5049:             }
 5050:         }
 5051:     }
 5052: }
 5053: 
 5054: bool ACauldronAltar::IsPlacementValid() const
 5055: {
 5056:     if (!GetWorld())
 5057:     {
 5058:         return false;
 5059:     }
 5060: 
 5061:     // 1. Comprobar si hay objetos en el radio de colisión
 5062:     TArray<FOverlapResult> Overlaps;
 5063:     FCollisionQueryParams QueryParams;
 5064:     QueryParams.AddIgnoredActor(this);
 5065: 
 5066:     if (CarryingCharacter)
 5067:     {
 5068:         QueryParams.AddIgnoredActor(CarryingCharacter);
 5069:     }
 5070: 
 5071:     bool bHasOverlaps = GetWorld()->OverlapMultiByObjectType(
 5072:         Overlaps,
 5073:         PreviewLocation,
 5074:         FQuat::Identity,
 5075:         FCollisionObjectQueryParams::AllObjects,
 5076:         FCollisionShape::MakeSphere(PlacementCollisionCheckRadius),
 5077:         QueryParams
 5078:     );
 5079: 
 5080:     if (bHasOverlaps)
 5081:     {
 5082:         // Encontramos solapamientos, verificar si son relevantes
 5083:         for (const FOverlapResult& Overlap : Overlaps)
 5084:         {
 5085:             // Ignorar actores que no tienen colisión (podrían ser efectos visuales, etc.)
 5086:             if (Overlap.GetActor() && Overlap.GetActor()->GetActorEnableCollision())
 5087:             {
 5088:                 // Si encontramos algún actor con colisión, la posición no es válida
 5089:                 return false;
 5090:             }
 5091:         }
 5092:     }
 5093: 
 5094:     // 2. Comprobar si el caldero está alineado con el suelo
 5095:     // Hacer un trazado hacia abajo para ver si hay suelo cerca
 5096:     FHitResult HitResult;
 5097:     FVector TraceStart = PreviewLocation;
 5098:     FVector TraceEnd = TraceStart - FVector(0, 0, MaxGroundAlignmentHeight * 2.0f);
 5099: 
 5100:     bool bHitGround = GetWorld()->LineTraceSingleByChannel(
 5101:         HitResult,
 5102:         TraceStart,
 5103:         TraceEnd,
 5104:         ECC_Visibility,
 5105:         QueryParams
 5106:     );
 5107: 
 5108:     if (!bHitGround)
 5109:     {
 5110:         // No encontramos suelo debajo del caldero
 5111:         return false;
 5112:     }
 5113: 
 5114:     // Comprobar la distancia al suelo
 5115:     float DistanceToGround = (HitResult.Location - TraceStart).Size();
 5116:     if (DistanceToGround > MaxGroundAlignmentHeight)
 5117:     {
 5118:         // El caldero está demasiado lejos del suelo
 5119:         return false;
 5120:     }
 5121: 
 5122:     // La posición es válida
 5123:     return true;
 5124: }

 5501: // ----------------------------------- CRAFTING VALIDATION FUNCTIONS ---------------------------------------------- //
 5502: 
 5503: bool UCauldronCraftComponent::CanCraftPotion() const
 5504: {
 5505:     const FPotionCraftingRecipe& Recipe = GetRequiredIngredients();
 5506: 
 5507:     // Check if required base ingredient is present
 5508:     if (Recipe.bRequiresBaseIngredient)
 5509:     {
 5510:         if (!BaseIngredient || !HasValidCraftingProperties(BaseIngredient))
 5511:         {
 5512:             UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CanCraftPotion: Base ingredient missing or invalid"));
 5513:             return false;
 5514:         }
 5515:     }
 5516: 
 5517:     // Check if required principal ingredient is present
 5518:     if (Recipe.bRequiresPrincipalIngredient)
 5519:     {
 5520:         if (!PrincipalIngredient || !HasValidCraftingProperties(PrincipalIngredient))
 5521:         {
 5522:             UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CanCraftPotion: Principal ingredient missing or invalid"));
 5523:             return false;
 5524:         }
 5525:     }
 5526: 
 5527:     // Check if required modifier ingredient is present (optional by default)
 5528:     if (Recipe.bRequiresModifierIngredient)
 5529:     {
 5530:         if (!ModifierIngredient || !HasValidCraftingProperties(ModifierIngredient))
 5531:         {
 5532:             UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CanCraftPotion: Modifier ingredient missing or invalid"));
 5533:             return false;
 5534:         }
 5535:     }
 5536: 
 5537:     // Validate ingredient combination compatibility
 5538:     if (!ValidateIngredientCombination())
 5539:     {
 5540:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CanCraftPotion: Ingredient combination is not valid"));
 5541:         return false;
 5542:     }
 5543: 
 5544:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CanCraftPotion: All requirements met, can craft potion"));
 5545:     return true;
 5546: }
 5547: 
 5548: FPotionCraftingRecipe UCauldronCraftComponent::GetRequiredIngredients() const
 5549: {
 5550:     // For now, return the default recipe
 5551:     // This could be expanded later to support different recipes based on context
 5552:     return DefaultCraftingRecipe;
 5553: }
 5554: 
 5555: bool UCauldronCraftComponent::ValidateIngredientCombination() const
 5556: {
 5557:     const FPotionCraftingRecipe& Recipe = GetRequiredIngredients();
 5558: 
 5559:     // If we don't have the minimum required ingredients, combination is invalid
 5560:     if (Recipe.bRequiresBaseIngredient && !BaseIngredient)
 5561:     {
 5562:         return false;
 5563:     }
 5564: 
 5565:     if (Recipe.bRequiresPrincipalIngredient && !PrincipalIngredient)
 5566:     {
 5567:         return false;
 5568:     }
 5569: 
 5570:     // Check base liquid type compatibility if specified in recipe
 5571:     if (BaseIngredient && Recipe.AllowedBaseLiquidTypes.Num() > 0)
 5572:     {
 5573:         const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties* BaseProps =
 5574:             Cast<UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties>(
 5575:                 BaseIngredient->FindFragmentByClass(UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties::StaticClass()));
 5576: 
 5577:         if (BaseProps && !Recipe.AllowedBaseLiquidTypes.HasTag(BaseProps->BaseIngredientData.BaseLiquidTypeTag))
 5578:         {
 5579:             UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::ValidateIngredientCombination: Base liquid type not allowed"));
 5580:             return false;
 5581:         }
 5582:     }
 5583: 
 5584:     // Check principal essence compatibility if specified in recipe
 5585:     if (PrincipalIngredient && Recipe.AllowedPrincipalEssences.Num() > 0)
 5586:     {
 5587:         const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties* PrincipalProps =
 5588:             Cast<UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties>(
 5589:                 PrincipalIngredient->FindFragmentByClass(UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties::StaticClass()));
 5590: 
 5591:         if (PrincipalProps && !Recipe.AllowedPrincipalEssences.HasTag(PrincipalProps->PrincipalIngredientData.PrincipalEssenceTag))
 5592:         {
 5593:             UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::ValidateIngredientCombination: Principal essence not allowed"));
 5594:             return false;
 5595:         }
 5596:     }
 5597: 
 5598:     // Check for incompatible combinations
 5599:     if (Recipe.IncompatibleCombinations.Num() > 0)
 5600:     {
 5601:         // Build current combination tags
 5602:         FGameplayTagContainer CurrentCombination;
 5603: 
 5604:         if (BaseIngredient)
 5605:         {
 5606:             const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties* BaseProps =
 5607:                 Cast<UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties>(
 5608:                     BaseIngredient->FindFragmentByClass(UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties::StaticClass()));
 5609:             if (BaseProps)
 5610:             {
 5611:                 CurrentCombination.AddTag(BaseProps->BaseIngredientData.BaseLiquidTypeTag);
 5612:                 CurrentCombination.AddTag(BaseProps->CategoryTag);
 5613:             }
 5614:         }
 5615: 
 5616:         if (PrincipalIngredient)
 5617:         {
 5618:             const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties* PrincipalProps =
 5619:                 Cast<UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties>(
 5620:                     PrincipalIngredient->FindFragmentByClass(UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties::StaticClass()));
 5621:             if (PrincipalProps)
 5622:             {
 5623:                 CurrentCombination.AddTag(PrincipalProps->PrincipalIngredientData.PrincipalEssenceTag);
 5624:                 CurrentCombination.AddTag(PrincipalProps->CategoryTag);
 5625:             }
 5626:         }
 5627: 
 5628:         if (ModifierIngredient)
 5629:         {
 5630:             const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties* ModifierProps =
 5631:                 Cast<UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties>(
 5632:                     ModifierIngredient->FindFragmentByClass(UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties::StaticClass()));
 5633:             if (ModifierProps)
 5634:             {
 5635:                 CurrentCombination.AppendTags(ModifierProps->ModifierIngredientData.ModifierEffectTags);
 5636:                 CurrentCombination.AddTag(ModifierProps->CategoryTag);
 5637:             }
 5638:         }
 5639: 
 5640:         // Check if any incompatible combination exists
 5641:         for (const FGameplayTag& IncompatibleTag : Recipe.IncompatibleCombinations)
 5642:         {
 5643:             if (CurrentCombination.HasTag(IncompatibleTag))
 5644:             {
 5645:                 UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::ValidateIngredientCombination: Found incompatible combination: %s"),
 5646:                        *IncompatibleTag.ToString());
 5647:                 return false;
 5648:             }
 5649:         }
 5650:     }
 5651: 
 5652:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::ValidateIngredientCombination: Ingredient combination is valid"));
 5653:     return true;
 5654: }

 5656: bool UCauldronCraftComponent::HasValidCraftingProperties(UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* Ingredient) const
 5657: {
 5658:     if (!Ingredient)
 5659:     {
 5660:         return false;
 5661:     }
 5662: 
 5663:     const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties* CraftingProps =
 5664:         Cast<UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties>(
 5665:             Ingredient->FindFragmentByClass(UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties::StaticClass()));
 5666: 
 5667:     return CraftingProps != nullptr;
 5668: }

 5699:     // Print Modifier Ingredient Data

 5710:     // Print Crafting Status

 5714: 
 5715:     // Print Current Crafted Potion Status

 5731: void UCauldronCraftComponent::PrintSpecificIngredientData(UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* Ingredient, const FString& SlotName) const
 5732: {
 5733:     if (!Ingredient)
 5734:     {
 5735:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("%s Ingredient: NULL"), *SlotName);
 5736:         return;
 5737:     }
 5738: 
 5739:     // Print basic ingredient info
 5740:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("%s Ingredient Definition: %s"),
 5741:            *SlotName,
 5742:            Ingredient->GetItemDef() ? *Ingredient->GetItemDef()->GetName() : TEXT("None"));
 5743:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("%s Stack Count: %d"), *SlotName, Ingredient->GetTotalStackCount());
 5744: 
 5745:     // Get the crafting properties fragment
 5746:     const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties* CraftingProps =
 5747:         Cast<UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties>(
 5748:             Ingredient->FindFragmentByClass(UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties::StaticClass()));
 5749: 
 5750:     if (!CraftingProps)
 5751:     {
 5752:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("%s Ingredient: NO CRAFTING PROPERTIES FRAGMENT FOUND!"), *SlotName);
 5753:         return;
 5754:     }
 5755: 
 5756:     // Print common crafting properties
 5757:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("%s Slot Usage Tag: %s"), *SlotName, *CraftingProps->SlotUsageTag.ToString());
 5758:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("%s Tier Tag: %s"), *SlotName, *CraftingProps->TierTag.ToString());
 5759:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("%s Category Tag: %s"), *SlotName, *CraftingProps->CategoryTag.ToString());
 5760: 
 5761:     // Print Base Ingredient specific data
 5762:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("%s Base Liquid Type: %s"),
 5763:            *SlotName, *CraftingProps->BaseIngredientData.BaseLiquidTypeTag.ToString());
 5764:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("%s Default Charges: %d"),
 5765:            *SlotName, CraftingProps->BaseIngredientData.DefaultChargesProvided);
 5766:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("%s Stability Modifier: %.3f"),
 5767:            *SlotName, CraftingProps->BaseIngredientData.StabilityModifier);
 5768: 
 5769:     // Print Principal Ingredient specific data
 5770:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("%s Principal Essence: %s"),
 5771:            *SlotName, *CraftingProps->PrincipalIngredientData.PrincipalEssenceTag.ToString());
 5772:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("%s Base Potency: %.3f"),
 5773:            *SlotName, CraftingProps->PrincipalIngredientData.BasePotency);
 5774:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("%s Base Duration: %.3f"),
 5775:            *SlotName, CraftingProps->PrincipalIngredientData.BaseDuration);
 5776:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("%s Is Ritual Essence: %s"),
 5777:            *SlotName, CraftingProps->PrincipalIngredientData.bIsRitualEssence ? TEXT("YES") : TEXT("NO"));
 5778: 
 5779:     // Print Modifier Ingredient specific data
 5780:     FString ModifierEffectTagsString;
 5781:     for (const FGameplayTag& Tag : CraftingProps->ModifierIngredientData.ModifierEffectTags)
 5782:     {
 5783:         if (!ModifierEffectTagsString.IsEmpty())
 5784:         {
 5785:             ModifierEffectTagsString += TEXT(", ");
 5786:         }
 5787:         ModifierEffectTagsString += Tag.ToString();
 5788:     }
 5789:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("%s Modifier Effect Tags: [%s]"), *SlotName, *ModifierEffectTagsString);
 5790:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("%s Potency Modification: %.3f"),
 5791:            *SlotName, CraftingProps->ModifierIngredientData.PotencyModificationValue);
 5792:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("%s Duration Modification: %.3f"),
 5793:            *SlotName, CraftingProps->ModifierIngredientData.DurationModificationValue);
 5794:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("%s Granted Property Tag: %s"),
 5795:            *SlotName, *CraftingProps->ModifierIngredientData.GrantedPropertyTag.ToString());
 5796:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("%s Added Effect Tag: %s"),
 5797:            *SlotName, *CraftingProps->ModifierIngredientData.AddedEffectTag.ToString());
 5798:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("%s Modifier Strength: %.3f"),
 5799:            *SlotName, CraftingProps->ModifierIngredientData.StrengthOfModifier);
 5800: }
 5801: 
 5802: void UCauldronCraftComponent::TrySetIngredientInSlot(const ACharacter* RequestingCharacter, const TSubclassOf<UWitchPTInventoryItemDefinition>& IngredientItemDef)
 5803: {
 5804:     if (!GetOwner()->HasAuthority())
 5805:     {
 5806:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::TrySetIngredientInSlot: Not authority"));
 5807:         return;
 5808:     }
 5809: 
 5810:     AWitchPTPlayerController* PC = Cast<AWitchPTPlayerController>(RequestingCharacter->GetController());
 5811:     if (!PC)
 5812:     {
 5813:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::TrySetIngredientInSlot: RequestingCharacter does not have a valid PlayerController."));
 5814:         return;
 5815:     }
 5816: 
 5817:     UWitchPTInventoryManagerComponent* InventoryManager = PC->GetInventoryManager();
 5818:     if (!InventoryManager)
 5819:     {
 5820:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::TrySetIngredientInSlot: Could not get InventoryManager from PlayerController."));
 5821:         return;
 5822:     }
 5823: 
 5824:     UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* InstanceFromInventory = InventoryManager->FindFirstItemStackByDefinition(IngredientItemDef);
 5825: 
 5826:     if (!InstanceFromInventory)
 5827:     {
 5828:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::TrySetIngredientInSlot: ItemDefinition %s not found in inventory for %s."), *IngredientItemDef->GetName(), *RequestingCharacter->GetName());
 5829:         return;
 5830:     }
 5831: 
 5832:     const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties* IngredientCraftingDetails = Cast<UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties>(InstanceFromInventory->FindFragmentByClass(UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties::StaticClass()));
 5833:     if (!IngredientCraftingDetails)
 5834:     {
 5835:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::TrySetIngredientInSlot: IngredientCraftingDetails is not valid for %s."), *RequestingCharacter->GetName());
 5836:         return;
 5837:     }
 5838: 
 5839:     // Determine ingredient type based on SlotUsageTag
 5840:     const FWitchPTGameplayTags& GameplayTags = FWitchPTGameplayTags::Get();
 5841:     bool bIsBaseIngredient = IngredientCraftingDetails->SlotUsageTag.MatchesTag(GameplayTags.Item_Consumable_Ingredient_CanBeUsedIn_BaseSlot);
 5842:     bool bIsPrincipalIngredient = IngredientCraftingDetails->SlotUsageTag.MatchesTag(GameplayTags.Item_Consumable_Ingredient_CanBeUsedIn_PrincipalSlot);
 5843:     bool bIsModifierIngredient = IngredientCraftingDetails->SlotUsageTag.MatchesTag(GameplayTags.Item_Consumable_Ingredient_CanBeUsedIn_ModifierSlot);
 5844: 
 5845:     // Check if the appropriate slot is already occupied
 5846:     if (bIsBaseIngredient && BaseIngredient != nullptr)
 5847:     {
 5848:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::TrySetIngredientInSlot: Base ingredient slot is already occupied"));
 5849:         return;
 5850:     }
 5851: 
 5852:     if (bIsPrincipalIngredient && PrincipalIngredient != nullptr)
 5853:     {
 5854:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::TrySetIngredientInSlot: Principal ingredient slot is already occupied"));
 5855:         return;
 5856:     }
 5857: 
 5858:     if (bIsModifierIngredient && ModifierIngredient != nullptr)
 5859:     {
 5860:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::TrySetIngredientInSlot: Modifier ingredient slot is already occupied"));
 5861:         return;
 5862:     }
 5863: 
 5864:     // If none of the slot usage tags match, this ingredient can't be used
 5865:     if (!bIsBaseIngredient && !bIsPrincipalIngredient && !bIsModifierIngredient)
 5866:     {
 5867:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::TrySetIngredientInSlot: Ingredient %s doesn't have a valid slot usage tag"), *IngredientItemDef->GetName());
 5868:         return;
 5869:     }
 5870: 
 5871:     bool bConsumedSuccessfully = false;
 5872:     int32 CurrentStackCount = InstanceFromInventory->GetTotalStackCount();
 5873: 
 5874:     if (CurrentStackCount > 0)
 5875:     {
 5876:         UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* IngredientToSet = nullptr;
 5877: 
 5878:         if (CurrentStackCount == 1)
 5879:         {
 5880:             IngredientToSet = InstanceFromInventory;
 5881:             InventoryManager->Server_RemoveItemInstance(InstanceFromInventory);
 5882:             bConsumedSuccessfully = true;
 5883:         }
 5884:         else
 5885:         {
 5886:             InventoryManager->Server_UpdateItemStackCount(InstanceFromInventory, CurrentStackCount - 1);
 5887:             IngredientToSet = InstanceFromInventory;
 5888:             bConsumedSuccessfully = true;
 5889:         }
 5890: 
 5891:         // Get UI fragment for icon
 5892:         const UWitchPTInventoryFragment_UIDetails* UIFragment = Cast<UWitchPTInventoryFragment_UIDetails>(InstanceFromInventory->FindFragmentByClass(UWitchPTInventoryFragment_UIDetails::StaticClass()));
 5893:         TSubclassOf<UUserWidget> IngredientIcon = nullptr;
 5894:         if (IsValid(UIFragment))
 5895:         {
 5896:             IngredientIcon = UIFragment->IconWidget;
 5897:         }
 5898: 
 5899:         // Set the ingredient in the appropriate slot
 5900:         if (bIsBaseIngredient)
 5901:         {
 5902:             BaseIngredient = IngredientToSet;
 5903:             BaseIngredientIcon = IngredientIcon;
 5904:             UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::TrySetIngredientInSlot: Base ingredient set successfully"));
 5905: 
 5906:             if (GetOwner()->HasAuthority())
 5907:             {
 5908:                 BroadcastBaseIngredientIconSet();
 5909:             }
 5910:         }
 5911:         else if (bIsPrincipalIngredient)
 5912:         {
 5913:             PrincipalIngredient = IngredientToSet;
 5914:             PrincipalIngredientIcon = IngredientIcon;
 5915:             UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::TrySetIngredientInSlot: Principal ingredient set successfully"));
 5916: 
 5917:             if (GetOwner()->HasAuthority())
 5918:             {
 5919:                 BroadcastPrincipalIngredientIconSet();
 5920:             }
 5921:         }
 5922:         else if (bIsModifierIngredient)
 5923:         {
 5924:             ModifierIngredient = IngredientToSet;
 5925:             ModifierIngredientIcon = IngredientIcon;
 5926:             UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::TrySetIngredientInSlot: Modifier ingredient set successfully"));
 5927: 
 5928:             if (GetOwner()->HasAuthority())
 5929:             {
 5930:                 BroadcastModifierIngredientIconSet();
 5931:             }
 5932:         }
 5933:     }
 5934: }

 6000: FExtractedBaseIngredientData UCauldronCraftComponent::ExtractBaseIngredientProperties() const
 6001: {
 6002:     FExtractedBaseIngredientData ExtractedData;
 6003: 
 6004:     if (!BaseIngredient)
 6005:     {
 6006:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::ExtractBaseIngredientProperties: No base ingredient found"));
 6007:         return ExtractedData; // bIsValid remains false
 6008:     }
 6009: 
 6010:     const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties* CraftingProps =
 6011:         Cast<UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties>(
 6012:             BaseIngredient->FindFragmentByClass(UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties::StaticClass()));
 6013: 
 6014:     if (!CraftingProps)
 6015:     {
 6016:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::ExtractBaseIngredientProperties: No crafting properties found"));
 6017:         return ExtractedData;
 6018:     }
 6019: 
 6020:     // Extract base ingredient data
 6021:     ExtractedData.BaseLiquidTypeTag = CraftingProps->BaseIngredientData.BaseLiquidTypeTag;
 6022:     ExtractedData.DefaultChargesProvided = CraftingProps->BaseIngredientData.DefaultChargesProvided;
 6023:     ExtractedData.StabilityModifier = CraftingProps->BaseIngredientData.StabilityModifier;
 6024:     ExtractedData.TierTag = CraftingProps->TierTag;
 6025:     ExtractedData.bIsValid = true;
 6026: 
 6027:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::ExtractBaseIngredientProperties: Successfully extracted - Liquid: %s, Charges: %d, Stability: %.3f"),
 6028:            *ExtractedData.BaseLiquidTypeTag.ToString(),
 6029:            ExtractedData.DefaultChargesProvided,
 6030:            ExtractedData.StabilityModifier);
 6031: 
 6032:     return ExtractedData;
 6033: }
 6034: 
 6035: FExtractedPrincipalIngredientData UCauldronCraftComponent::ExtractPrincipalIngredientProperties() const
 6036: {
 6037:     FExtractedPrincipalIngredientData ExtractedData;
 6038: 
 6039:     if (!PrincipalIngredient)
 6040:     {
 6041:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::ExtractPrincipalIngredientProperties: No principal ingredient found"));
 6042:         return ExtractedData; // bIsValid remains false
 6043:     }
 6044: 
 6045:     const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties* CraftingProps =
 6046:         Cast<UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties>(
 6047:             PrincipalIngredient->FindFragmentByClass(UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties::StaticClass()));
 6048: 
 6049:     if (!CraftingProps)
 6050:     {
 6051:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::ExtractPrincipalIngredientProperties: No crafting properties found"));
 6052:         return ExtractedData;
 6053:     }
 6054: 
 6055:     // Extract principal ingredient data
 6056:     ExtractedData.PrincipalEssenceTag = CraftingProps->PrincipalIngredientData.PrincipalEssenceTag;
 6057:     ExtractedData.BasePotency = CraftingProps->PrincipalIngredientData.BasePotency;
 6058:     ExtractedData.BaseDuration = CraftingProps->PrincipalIngredientData.BaseDuration;
 6059:     ExtractedData.bIsRitualEssence = CraftingProps->PrincipalIngredientData.bIsRitualEssence;
 6060:     ExtractedData.TierTag = CraftingProps->TierTag;
 6061:     ExtractedData.bIsValid = true;
 6062: 
 6063:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::ExtractPrincipalIngredientProperties: Successfully extracted - Essence: %s, Potency: %.3f, Duration: %.3f"),
 6064:            *ExtractedData.PrincipalEssenceTag.ToString(),
 6065:            ExtractedData.BasePotency,
 6066:            ExtractedData.BaseDuration);
 6067: 
 6068:     return ExtractedData;
 6069: }
 6070: 
 6071: FExtractedModifierIngredientData UCauldronCraftComponent::ExtractModifierIngredientProperties() const
 6072: {
 6073:     FExtractedModifierIngredientData ExtractedData;
 6074: 
 6075:     if (!ModifierIngredient)
 6076:     {
 6077:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::ExtractModifierIngredientProperties: No modifier ingredient found (this is optional)"));
 6078:         return ExtractedData; // bIsValid remains false, but this is acceptable for optional ingredients
 6079:     }
 6080: 
 6081:     const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties* CraftingProps =
 6082:         Cast<UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties>(
 6083:             ModifierIngredient->FindFragmentByClass(UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_IngredientCraftingProperties::StaticClass()));
 6084: 
 6085:     if (!CraftingProps)
 6086:     {
 6087:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::ExtractModifierIngredientProperties: No crafting properties found"));
 6088:         return ExtractedData;
 6089:     }
 6090: 
 6091:     // Extract modifier ingredient data
 6092:     ExtractedData.ModifierEffectTags = CraftingProps->ModifierIngredientData.ModifierEffectTags;
 6093:     ExtractedData.PotencyModificationValue = CraftingProps->ModifierIngredientData.PotencyModificationValue;
 6094:     ExtractedData.DurationModificationValue = CraftingProps->ModifierIngredientData.DurationModificationValue;
 6095:     ExtractedData.GrantedPropertyTag = CraftingProps->ModifierIngredientData.GrantedPropertyTag;
 6096:     ExtractedData.AddedEffectTag = CraftingProps->ModifierIngredientData.AddedEffectTag;
 6097:     ExtractedData.StrengthOfModifier = CraftingProps->ModifierIngredientData.StrengthOfModifier;
 6098:     ExtractedData.TierTag = CraftingProps->TierTag;
 6099:     ExtractedData.bIsValid = true;
 6100: 
 6101:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::ExtractModifierIngredientProperties: Successfully extracted - Effects: %d, Potency Mod: %.3f, Duration Mod: %.3f"),
 6102:            ExtractedData.ModifierEffectTags.Num(),
 6103:            ExtractedData.PotencyModificationValue,
 6104:            ExtractedData.DurationModificationValue);
 6105: 
 6106:     return ExtractedData;
 6107: }
 6108: 
 6109: // ----------------------------------- POTION CALCULATION FUNCTIONS ---------------------------------------------- //
 6110: 
 6111: FPotionResult UCauldronCraftComponent::CalculatePotionProperties() const
 6112: {
 6113:     FPotionResult PotionResult;
 6114: 
 6115:     // Check if we can craft a potion
 6116:     if (!CanCraftPotion())
 6117:     {
 6118:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CalculatePotionProperties: Cannot craft potion with current ingredients"));
 6119:         return PotionResult; // bIsValid remains false
 6120:     }
 6121: 
 6122:     // Extract ingredient data
 6123:     FExtractedBaseIngredientData BaseData = ExtractBaseIngredientProperties();
 6124:     FExtractedPrincipalIngredientData PrincipalData = ExtractPrincipalIngredientProperties();
 6125:     FExtractedModifierIngredientData ModifierData = ExtractModifierIngredientProperties();
 6126: 
 6127:     // Validate extracted data
 6128:     if (!BaseData.bIsValid || !PrincipalData.bIsValid)
 6129:     {
 6130:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CalculatePotionProperties: Required ingredient data is invalid"));
 6131:         return PotionResult;
 6132:     }
 6133: 
 6134:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CalculatePotionProperties: Starting potion calculation..."));
 6135: 
 6136:     // Step 1: Start with base liquid properties
 6137:     PotionResult.BaseLiquidTypeTag = BaseData.BaseLiquidTypeTag;
 6138:     PotionResult.FinalCharges = BaseData.DefaultChargesProvided;
 6139:     float StabilityFactor = BaseData.StabilityModifier;
 6140: 
 6141:     // Step 2: Apply principal ingredient effects
 6142:     PotionResult.PotionEssenceTag = PrincipalData.PrincipalEssenceTag;
 6143:     PotionResult.FinalPotency = PrincipalData.BasePotency;
 6144:     PotionResult.FinalDuration = PrincipalData.BaseDuration;
 6145: 
 6146:     // Add principal essence to granted effects
 6147:     if (PrincipalData.PrincipalEssenceTag.IsValid())
 6148:     {
 6149:         PotionResult.GrantedEffectTags.AddTag(PrincipalData.PrincipalEssenceTag);
 6150:     }
 6151: 
 6152:     // Step 3: Apply modifier ingredient effects (if present)
 6153:     if (ModifierData.bIsValid)
 6154:     {
 6155:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CalculatePotionProperties: Applying modifier effects..."));
 6156: 
 6157:         // Apply potency modification (multiplicative)
 6158:         PotionResult.FinalPotency *= ModifierData.PotencyModificationValue;
 6159: 
 6160:         // Apply duration modification (additive)
 6161:         PotionResult.FinalDuration += ModifierData.DurationModificationValue;
 6162: 
 6163:         // Add modifier effects to granted effects
 6164:         PotionResult.GrantedEffectTags.AppendTags(ModifierData.ModifierEffectTags);
 6165: 
 6166:         // Add granted property
 6167:         if (ModifierData.GrantedPropertyTag.IsValid())
 6168:         {
 6169:             PotionResult.GrantedPropertyTags.AddTag(ModifierData.GrantedPropertyTag);
 6170:         }
 6171: 
 6172:         // Add additional effect
 6173:         if (ModifierData.AddedEffectTag.IsValid())
 6174:         {
 6175:             PotionResult.GrantedEffectTags.AddTag(ModifierData.AddedEffectTag);
 6176:         }
 6177: 
 6178:         // Apply modifier strength to overall potency (additional multiplicative factor)
 6179:         PotionResult.FinalPotency *= ModifierData.StrengthOfModifier;
 6180:     }
 6181: 
 6182:     // Step 4: Apply stability modifier to final potency
 6183:     PotionResult.FinalPotency *= StabilityFactor;
 6184: 
 6185:     // Step 5: Calculate final potion tier
 6186:     PotionResult.PotionTierTag = CalculatePotionTier(BaseData, PrincipalData, ModifierData);
 6187: 
 6188:     // Step 6: Ensure minimum values
 6189:     PotionResult.FinalPotency = FMath::Max(PotionResult.FinalPotency, 0.1f); // Minimum potency
 6190:     PotionResult.FinalDuration = FMath::Max(PotionResult.FinalDuration, 1.0f); // Minimum duration
 6191:     PotionResult.FinalCharges = FMath::Max(PotionResult.FinalCharges, 1); // Minimum charges
 6192: 
 6193:     // Mark as valid
 6194:     PotionResult.bIsValid = true;
 6195: 
 6196:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CalculatePotionProperties: Potion calculation complete - Potency: %.2f, Duration: %.2f, Charges: %d"),
 6197:            PotionResult.FinalPotency,
 6198:            PotionResult.FinalDuration,
 6199:            PotionResult.FinalCharges);
 6200: 
 6201:     return PotionResult;
 6202: }
 6203: 
 6204: FGameplayTag UCauldronCraftComponent::CalculatePotionTier(const FExtractedBaseIngredientData& BaseData,
 6205:                                                          const FExtractedPrincipalIngredientData& PrincipalData,
 6206:                                                          const FExtractedModifierIngredientData& ModifierData) const
 6207: {
 6208:     // Simple tier calculation: use the highest tier among all ingredients
 6209:     // This could be expanded to use more complex logic later
 6210: 
 6211:     TArray<FGameplayTag> TierTags;
 6212: 
 6213:     if (BaseData.bIsValid && BaseData.TierTag.IsValid())
 6214:     {
 6215:         TierTags.Add(BaseData.TierTag);
 6216:     }
 6217: 
 6218:     if (PrincipalData.bIsValid && PrincipalData.TierTag.IsValid())
 6219:     {
 6220:         TierTags.Add(PrincipalData.TierTag);
 6221:     }
 6222: 
 6223:     if (ModifierData.bIsValid && ModifierData.TierTag.IsValid())
 6224:     {
 6225:         TierTags.Add(ModifierData.TierTag);
 6226:     }
 6227: 
 6228:     // For now, return the principal ingredient's tier as the base
 6229:     // This could be enhanced to compare tier values and return the highest
 6230:     if (PrincipalData.bIsValid && PrincipalData.TierTag.IsValid())
 6231:     {
 6232:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CalculatePotionTier: Using principal ingredient tier: %s"),
 6233:                *PrincipalData.TierTag.ToString());
 6234:         return PrincipalData.TierTag;
 6235:     }
 6236: 
 6237:     // Fallback to base ingredient tier
 6238:     if (BaseData.bIsValid && BaseData.TierTag.IsValid())
 6239:     {
 6240:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CalculatePotionTier: Using base ingredient tier: %s"),
 6241:                *BaseData.TierTag.ToString());
 6242:         return BaseData.TierTag;
 6243:     }
 6244: 
 6245:     // No valid tier found
 6246:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CalculatePotionTier: No valid tier tags found, returning empty tag"));
 6247:     return FGameplayTag();
 6248: }

 6276: UWitchPTInventoryItemDefinition* UCauldronCraftComponent::CreatePotionItemDefinitionInstance(const FPotionResult& PotionData) const
 6277: {
 6278:     if (!PotionData.bIsValid)
 6279:     {
 6280:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CreatePotionItemDefinitionInstance: Invalid potion data provided"));
 6281:         return nullptr;
 6282:     }
 6283: 
 6284:     TSubclassOf<UWitchPTInventoryItemDefinition> BasePotionItemDefinition = GetBasePotionItemDefinition();
 6285:     if (!BasePotionItemDefinition)
 6286:     {
 6287:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CreatePotionItemDefinitionInstance: BasePotionItemDefinition is not set"));
 6288:         return nullptr;
 6289:     }
 6290: 
 6291:     // Create a new instance of the base potion definition
 6292:     UWitchPTInventoryItemDefinition* PotionDefinition = NewObject<UWitchPTInventoryItemDefinition>(
 6293:         GetTransientPackage(),
 6294:         BasePotionItemDefinition
 6295:     );
 6296: 
 6297:     if (!PotionDefinition)
 6298:     {
 6299:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CreatePotionItemDefinitionInstance: Failed to create potion definition instance"));
 6300:         return nullptr;
 6301:     }
 6302: 
 6303:     // Find or create the potion properties fragment
 6304:     UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_PotionProperties* PotionPropsFragment = nullptr;
 6305: 
 6306:     // Check if base definition already has a potion properties fragment
 6307:     const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_PotionProperties* ExistingFragment =
 6308:         Cast<UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_PotionProperties>(
 6309:             PotionDefinition->FindFragmentByClass(UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_PotionProperties::StaticClass()));
 6310: 
 6311:     if (ExistingFragment)
 6312:     {
 6313:         // Create a new fragment based on the existing one
 6314:         PotionPropsFragment = NewObject<UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_PotionProperties>(PotionDefinition);
 6315: 
 6316:         // Copy any default values from the existing fragment if needed
 6317:         // For now, we'll just set the new properties
 6318:     }
 6319:     else
 6320:     {
 6321:         // Create a new potion properties fragment
 6322:         PotionPropsFragment = NewObject<UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_PotionProperties>(PotionDefinition);
 6323: 
 6324:         // Add the fragment to the definition's fragments array
 6325:         PotionDefinition->Fragments.Add(PotionPropsFragment);
 6326:     }
 6327: 
 6328:     // Set the potion properties from the crafting result
 6329:     if (PotionPropsFragment)
 6330:     {
 6331:         PotionPropsFragment->SetPotionProperties(
 6332:             PotionData.PotionEssenceTag,
 6333:             PotionData.BaseLiquidTypeTag,
 6334:             PotionData.FinalPotency,
 6335:             PotionData.FinalDuration,
 6336:             PotionData.FinalCharges,
 6337:             PotionData.PotionTierTag,
 6338:             PotionData.GrantedEffectTags,
 6339:             PotionData.GrantedPropertyTags
 6340:         );
 6341: 
 6342:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CreatePotionItemDefinitionInstance: Created potion definition with properties - %s"),
 6343:                *PotionData.PotionEssenceTag.ToString());
 6344:     }
 6345: 
 6346:     return PotionDefinition;
 6347: }

 6386: bool UCauldronCraftComponent::SpawnPotionInWorld(const FPotionResult& PotionData, const FVector& SpawnLocation) const
 6387: {
 6388:     if (!PotionData.bIsValid)
 6389:     {
 6390:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::SpawnPotionInWorld: Invalid potion data provided"));
 6391:         return false;
 6392:     }
 6393: 
 6394:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::SpawnPotionInWorld: Attempting to spawn at location: %s"), *SpawnLocation.ToString());
 6395:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::SpawnPotionInWorld: Cauldron owner location: %s"), *GetOwner()->GetActorLocation().ToString());
 6396: 
 6397:     // Create the potion definition instance with proper properties
 6398:     UWitchPTInventoryItemDefinition* PotionDefinition = CreatePotionItemDefinitionInstance(PotionData);
 6399:     if (!PotionDefinition)
 6400:     {
 6401:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::SpawnPotionInWorld: Failed to create potion definition"));
 6402:         return false;
 6403:     }
 6404: 
 6405:     // Get the world for spawning
 6406:     UWorld* World = GetWorld();
 6407:     if (!World)
 6408:     {
 6409:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::SpawnPotionInWorld: No valid world found"));
 6410:         return false;
 6411:     }
 6412: 
 6413:     // Spawn PotionBase actor at the specified location
 6414:     FActorSpawnParameters SpawnParams;
 6415:     SpawnParams.SpawnCollisionHandlingOverride = ESpawnActorCollisionHandlingMethod::AdjustIfPossibleButAlwaysSpawn;
 6416: 
 6417:     APotionBase* PotionActor = World->SpawnActor<APotionBase>(SpawnLocation, FRotator::ZeroRotator, SpawnParams);
 6418:     FItemManifest ItemManifest;
 6419:     ItemManifest.ItemDef = PotionDefinition->GetClass();
 6420:     PotionActor->StaticInventory = ItemManifest;
 6421:     if (!PotionActor)
 6422:     {
 6423:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::SpawnPotionInWorld: Failed to spawn PotionBase actor"));
 6424:         return false;
 6425:     }
 6426: 
 6427:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::SpawnPotionInWorld: Successfully spawned PotionBase at: %s"), *PotionActor->GetActorLocation().ToString());
 6428: 
 6429:     // Set up the static mesh from the world details fragment
 6430:     const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_WorldDetails* WorldDetails =
 6431:         Cast<UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_WorldDetails>(
 6432:             PotionDefinition->FindFragmentByClass(UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_WorldDetails::StaticClass()));
 6433: 
 6434:     if (WorldDetails && WorldDetails->HasValidWorldMesh())
 6435:     {
 6436:         // Get or create the static mesh component from PotionBase
 6437:         UStaticMeshComponent* MeshComponent = PotionActor->FindComponentByClass<UStaticMeshComponent>();
 6438: 
 6439:         if (!MeshComponent)
 6440:         {
 6441:             // Create a new StaticMeshComponent if one doesn't exist
 6442:             MeshComponent = NewObject<UStaticMeshComponent>(PotionActor);
 6443:             MeshComponent->SetupAttachment(PotionActor->GetRootComponent());
 6444:             MeshComponent->RegisterComponent();
 6445: 
 6446:             UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::SpawnPotionInWorld: Created new StaticMeshComponent for PotionBase"));
 6447:         }
 6448: 
 6449:         if (MeshComponent)
 6450:         {
 6451:             // Set the mesh from the world details fragment
 6452:             MeshComponent->SetStaticMesh(WorldDetails->WorldStaticMesh);
 6453: 
 6454:             // Apply scale if specified
 6455:             if (WorldDetails->WorldScale != FVector::OneVector)
 6456:             {
 6457:                 MeshComponent->SetWorldScale3D(WorldDetails->WorldScale);
 6458:             }
 6459: 
 6460:             // Apply material override if specified
 6461:             if (WorldDetails->WorldMaterial)
 6462:             {
 6463:                 MeshComponent->SetMaterial(0, WorldDetails->WorldMaterial);
 6464:             }
 6465: 
 6466:             // Set collision profile if specified
 6467:             if (!WorldDetails->CollisionProfileName.IsNone())
 6468:             {
 6469:                 MeshComponent->SetCollisionProfileName(WorldDetails->CollisionProfileName);
 6470:             }
 6471: 
 6472:             UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::SpawnPotionInWorld: Applied mesh '%s' from WorldDetails fragment"),
 6473:                    *WorldDetails->WorldStaticMesh->GetName());
 6474:         }
 6475:         else
 6476:         {
 6477:             UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::SpawnPotionInWorld: Failed to create or find StaticMeshComponent"));
 6478:         }
 6479:     }
 6480:     else
 6481:     {
 6482:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::SpawnPotionInWorld: No WorldDetails fragment or invalid mesh - using default appearance"));
 6483:     }
 6484: 
 6485:     // Set the item definition in the potion actor
 6486:     // Note: You may need to add a SetItemDefinition method to PotionBase if it doesn't exist
 6487:     // For now, we'll log that the potion was spawned successfully
 6488: 
 6489:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::SpawnPotionInWorld: Successfully spawned potion at location: %s"),
 6490:            *SpawnLocation.ToString());
 6491:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::SpawnPotionInWorld: Potion: %s with %d charges, %.2f potency"),
 6492:            *PotionData.PotionEssenceTag.ToString(),
 6493:            PotionData.FinalCharges,
 6494:            PotionData.FinalPotency);
 6495: 
 6496:     return true;
 6497: }
