 6545: // ----------------------------------- MAIN CRAFTING FUNCTION ---------------------------------------------- //
 6546: 
 6547: FPotionResult UCauldronCraftComponent::CraftPotion(bool bAddToInventory, ACharacter* TargetCharacter, const FVector& WorldSpawnLocation)
 6548: {
 6549:     FPotionResult EmptyResult;
 6550: 
 6551:     // Only allow crafting on the server
 6552:     if (!GetOwner()->HasAuthority())
 6553:     {
 6554:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CraftPotion: Not authority - crafting not allowed"));
 6555:         return EmptyResult;
 6556:     }
 6557: 
 6558:     // Check if we can perform crafting
 6559:     if (!CanPerformCrafting())
 6560:     {
 6561:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CraftPotion: Cannot perform crafting with current setup"));
 6562:         return EmptyResult;
 6563:     }
 6564: 
 6565:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CraftPotion: Starting potion crafting process..."));
 6566: 
 6567:     // Step 1: Calculate potion properties
 6568:     FPotionResult CraftingResult = CalculatePotionProperties();
 6569:     if (!CraftingResult.bIsValid)
 6570:     {
 6571:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CraftPotion: Failed to calculate valid potion properties"));
 6572:         return EmptyResult;
 6573:     }
 6574: 
 6575:     // Step 2: Create and spawn/add the potion
 6576:     bool bPotionCreatedSuccessfully = false;
 6577: 
 6578:     if (bAddToInventory)
 6579:     {
 6580:         // Determine target character
 6581:         ACharacter* Target = TargetCharacter;
 6582:         if (!Target)
 6583:         {
 6584:             // Try to get character from owner (if cauldron is owned by a character)
 6585:             Target = Cast<ACharacter>(GetOwner());
 6586:             if (!Target)
 6587:             {
 6588:                 // Try to get the closest player character (fallback)
 6589:                 UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CraftPotion: No target character specified for inventory addition"));
 6590:                 return EmptyResult;
 6591:             }
 6592:         }
 6593: 
 6594:         UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* CreatedInstance = AddPotionToInventory(CraftingResult, Target);
 6595:         bPotionCreatedSuccessfully = (CreatedInstance != nullptr);
 6596:     }
 6597:     else
 6598:     {
 6599:         // Calculate spawn location relative to cauldron's current position
 6600:         FVector CauldronLocation = GetOwner()->GetActorLocation();
 6601:         FVector SpawnLoc;
 6602: 
 6603:         if (WorldSpawnLocation != FVector::ZeroVector)
 6604:         {
 6605:             // Use specified location
 6606:             SpawnLoc = WorldSpawnLocation;
 6607:             UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CraftPotion: Using specified spawn location: %s"), *SpawnLoc.ToString());
 6608:         }
 6609:         else
 6610:         {
 6611:             // Calculate offset from cauldron position (spawn slightly in front and up)
 6612:             FRotator CauldronRotation = GetOwner()->GetActorRotation();
 6613:             FVector ForwardOffset = CauldronRotation.RotateVector(FVector(150.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f)); // 150cm forward
 6614:             FVector UpOffset = FVector(0.0f, 0.0f, 50.0f); // 50cm up
 6615:             SpawnLoc = CauldronLocation + ForwardOffset + UpOffset;
 6616: 
 6617:             UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CraftPotion: Cauldron location: %s"), *CauldronLocation.ToString());
 6618:             UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CraftPotion: Calculated spawn location: %s"), *SpawnLoc.ToString());
 6619:         }
 6620: 
 6621:         bPotionCreatedSuccessfully = SpawnPotionInWorld(CraftingResult, SpawnLoc);
 6622:     }
 6623: 
 6624:     if (!bPotionCreatedSuccessfully)
 6625:     {
 6626:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CraftPotion: Failed to create/spawn potion"));
 6627:         return EmptyResult;
 6628:     }
 6629: 
 6630:     // Step 3: Store the result and clear ingredients
 6631:     CraftedPotion = CraftingResult;
 6632:     ClearIngredientSlots();
 6633: 
 6634:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CraftPotion: Successfully crafted potion - %s with potency %.2f"),
 6635:            *CraftingResult.PotionEssenceTag.ToString(),
 6636:            CraftingResult.FinalPotency);
 6637: 
 6638:     return CraftingResult;
 6639: }
 6640: 
 6641: // ----------------------------------- CRAFTING HELPER FUNCTIONS ---------------------------------------------- //
 6642: 
 6643: bool UCauldronCraftComponent::CanPerformCrafting() const
 6644: {
 6645:     // Check basic crafting requirements
 6646:     if (!CanCraftPotion())
 6647:     {
 6648:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CanPerformCrafting: Basic crafting requirements not met"));
 6649:         return false;
 6650:     }
 6651: 
 6652:     // Check if we have a base potion definition set
 6653:     TSubclassOf<UWitchPTInventoryItemDefinition> BasePotionItemDefinition = GetBasePotionItemDefinition();
 6654:     if (!BasePotionItemDefinition)
 6655:     {
 6656:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::CanPerformCrafting: BasePotionItemDefinition is not set"));
 6657:         return false;
 6658:     }
 6659: 
 6660:     // Additional checks could be added here:
 6661:     // - Player permissions
 6662:     // - Cauldron state
 6663:     // - Resource requirements
 6664:     // - Cooldowns
 6665: 
 6666:     return true;
 6667: }
 6668: 
 6669: void UCauldronCraftComponent::ClearIngredientSlots()
 6670: {
 6671:     if (!GetOwner()->HasAuthority())
 6672:     {
 6673:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::ClearIngredientSlots: Not authority"));
 6674:         return;
 6675:     }
 6676: 
 6677:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::ClearIngredientSlots: Clearing all ingredient slots"));
 6678: 
 6679:     // Clear base ingredient
 6680:     if (BaseIngredient)
 6681:     {
 6682:         BaseIngredient = nullptr;
 6683:         BaseIngredientIcon = nullptr;
 6684:         BroadcastBaseIngredientIconSet();
 6685:     }
 6686: 
 6687:     // Clear principal ingredient
 6688:     if (PrincipalIngredient)
 6689:     {
 6690:         PrincipalIngredient = nullptr;
 6691:         PrincipalIngredientIcon = nullptr;
 6692:         BroadcastPrincipalIngredientIconSet();
 6693:     }
 6694: 
 6695:     // Clear modifier ingredient
 6696:     if (ModifierIngredient)
 6697:     {
 6698:         ModifierIngredient = nullptr;
 6699:         ModifierIngredientIcon = nullptr;
 6700:         BroadcastModifierIngredientIconSet();
 6701:     }
 6702: 
 6703:     // Clear crafted potion result
 6704:     CraftedPotion = FPotionResult();
 6705: 
 6706:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("UCauldronCraftComponent::ClearIngredientSlots: All ingredient slots cleared"));
 6707: }

 6709: // ----------------------------------- DEBUG/TESTING HELPER FUNCTIONS ---------------------------------------------- //
 6710: 
 6711: void UCauldronCraftComponent::DebugTestCrafting()
 6712: {
 6713:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("=== CAULDRON DEBUG TEST CRAFTING ==="));
 6714: 
 6715:     // Print current state
 6716:     PrintIngredientDebugData();
 6717: 
 6718:     // Test crafting calculations
 6719:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("--- TESTING CRAFTING CALCULATIONS ---"));
 6720:     FPotionResult TestResult = CalculatePotionProperties();
 6721: 
 6722:     if (TestResult.bIsValid)
 6723:     {
 6724:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("CALCULATION SUCCESS: %s Potion - Potency: %.2f, Duration: %.2f, Charges: %d"),
 6725:                *TestResult.PotionEssenceTag.ToString(),
 6726:                TestResult.FinalPotency,
 6727:                TestResult.FinalDuration,
 6728:                TestResult.FinalCharges);
 6729:     }
 6730:     else
 6731:     {
 6732:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("CALCULATION FAILED: Invalid potion result"));
 6733:     }
 6734: 
 6735:     // Test crafting validation
 6736:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("--- TESTING CRAFTING VALIDATION ---"));
 6737:     bool bCanCraft = CanCraftPotion();
 6738:     bool bCanPerform = CanPerformCrafting();
 6739: 
 6740:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("Can Craft Potion: %s"), bCanCraft ? TEXT("YES") : TEXT("NO"));
 6741:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("Can Perform Crafting: %s"), bCanPerform ? TEXT("YES") : TEXT("NO"));
 6742: 
 6743:     if (bCanPerform)
 6744:     {
 6745:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("--- ATTEMPTING WORLD SPAWN CRAFT ---"));
 6746:         // Use default location calculation (will be calculated relative to cauldron in CraftPotion)
 6747:         FPotionResult CraftResult = CraftPotion(false, nullptr, FVector::ZeroVector);
 6748: 
 6749:         if (CraftResult.bIsValid)
 6750:         {
 6751:             UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("CRAFTING SUCCESS: Potion created and spawned near cauldron"));
 6752:         }
 6753:         else
 6754:         {
 6755:             UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("CRAFTING FAILED: No valid result"));
 6756:         }
 6757:     }
 6758:     else
 6759:     {
 6760:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("CRAFTING VALIDATION FAILED: Cannot perform crafting"));
 6761:     }
 6762: 
 6763:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("=== END DEBUG TEST ==="));
 6764: }

 7125: // ----------------------------------- HELPER FUNCTIONS ---------------------------------------------- //
 7126: 
 7127: void ARitualAltar::UpdateTurnData()
 7128: {
 7129: 	// This function can be called on both server and clients
 7130: 	// On server: updates the replicated CurrentTurnData
 7131: 	// On clients: called from OnRep functions to update local UI data
 7132: 
 7133: 	FUIRitualData NewTurnData;
 7134: 	NewTurnData.RitualPercentageCompleted = GetCurrentSequenceProgress();
 7135: 	NewTurnData.CorruptionPercentage = GetCorruptionPercentage();
 7136: 	NewTurnData.CurrentInputTimeRemaining = CurrentInputTimer;
 7137: 
 7138: 	// Set expected input if we have valid data
 7139: 	if (CurrentActivePlayer && InputSequence.IsValidIndex(CurrentSequenceIndex))
 7140: 	{
 7141: 		NewTurnData.ExpectedInput = InputSequence[CurrentSequenceIndex];
 7142: 	}
 7143: 	else
 7144: 	{
 7145: 		NewTurnData.ExpectedInput = FGameplayTag::EmptyTag;
 7146: 	}
 7147: 
 7148: 	// Always set bIsMyTurn to false here - the widget controller will determine the correct value
 7149: 	NewTurnData.bIsMyTurn = false;
 7150: 
 7151: 	// On server, update the replicated data if it has changed
 7152: 	if (HasAuthority())
 7153: 	{
 7154: 		// Only update if data has changed to avoid unnecessary replication
 7155: 		if (!(CurrentTurnData.bIsMyTurn == NewTurnData.bIsMyTurn &&
 7156: 			  CurrentTurnData.ExpectedInput == NewTurnData.ExpectedInput &&
 7157: 			  FMath::IsNearlyEqual(CurrentTurnData.RitualPercentageCompleted, NewTurnData.RitualPercentageCompleted, 0.01f) &&
 7158: 			  FMath::IsNearlyEqual(CurrentTurnData.CorruptionPercentage, NewTurnData.CorruptionPercentage, 0.01f) &&
 7159: 			  FMath::IsNearlyEqual(CurrentTurnData.CurrentInputTimeRemaining, NewTurnData.CurrentInputTimeRemaining, 0.1f)))
 7160: 		{
 7161: 			CurrentTurnData = NewTurnData;
 7162: 			// Broadcast on server for local UI updates (OnRep will handle clients)
 7163: 			BroadcastTurnDataChanged();
 7164: 		}
 7165: 	}
 7166: 	else
 7167: 	{
 7168: 		// On clients, just update the local data and broadcast
 7169: 		CurrentTurnData = NewTurnData;
 7170: 		BroadcastTurnDataChanged();
 7171: 	}
 7172: }
 7173: 
 7174: void ARitualAltar::UpdateReadyPlayersData()
 7175: {
 7176: 	if (!HasAuthority())
 7177: 	{
 7178: 		return;
 7179: 	}
 7180: 
 7181: 	FRitualReadyPlayersData NewData;
 7182: 	NewData.TotalPlayers = ParticipatingPlayers.Num();
 7183: 	NewData.ReadyPlayers = ReadyPlayers.Num();
 7184: 
 7185: 	if (ReadyPlayersData != NewData)
 7186: 	{
 7187: 		ReadyPlayersData = NewData;
 7188: 		// Broadcast on server for local UI updates (OnRep will handle clients)
 7189: 		BroadcastReadyPlayersChanged();
 7190: 	}
 7191: }

 7201: void ARitualAltar::StartRitual(ACharacter* RequestingCharacter)
 7202: {
 7203: 	if (!HasAuthority() || !RequestingCharacter)
 7204: 	{
 7205: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("[DEBUG-RITUAL] Cannot start ritual: invalid player or no authority"));
 7206: 		return;
 7207: 	}
 7208: 
 7209: 	// Check if the ritual is in a valid state
 7210: 	if (CurrentRitualState != EInteractionState::Inactive &&
 7211: 	    CurrentRitualState != EInteractionState::WaitingForPlayers)
 7212: 	{
 7213: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("[DEBUG-RITUAL] Cannot start ritual: already in state %d"), static_cast<int32>(CurrentRitualState));
 7214: 		return;
 7215: 	}
 7216: 
 7217: 	// Process the ready request
 7218: 	ProcessRitualReadyRequest(RequestingCharacter);
 7219: }
 7220: 
 7221: void ARitualAltar::ProcessRitualReadyRequest(ACharacter* RequestingCharacter)
 7222: {
 7223: 	if (!HasAuthority() || !RequestingCharacter)
 7224: 	{
 7225: 		return;
 7226: 	}
 7227: 
 7228: 	// Check if player is already in the ready list
 7229: 	if (ReadyPlayers.Contains(RequestingCharacter))
 7230: 	{
 7231: 		// Player is already ready, could allow them to un-ready if desired
 7232: 		ReadyPlayers.Remove(RequestingCharacter);
 7233: 		UpdateReadyPlayersData();
 7234: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[DEBUG-RITUAL] Player %s canceled ready status"), *RequestingCharacter->GetName());
 7235: 		return;
 7236: 	}
 7237: 
 7238: 	// Add player to ready list
 7239: 	ReadyPlayers.Add(RequestingCharacter);
 7240: 	UpdateReadyPlayersData();
 7241: 	UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[DEBUG-RITUAL] Player %s is ready"), *RequestingCharacter->GetName());
 7242: 
 7243: 	// Check if all players are ready
 7244: 	if (AreAllPlayersReady())
 7245: 	{
 7246: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[DEBUG-RITUAL] All players are ready. Starting countdown!"));
 7247: 		StartRitualCountdown();
 7248: 	}
 7249: }

 7251: bool ARitualAltar::IsPlayerReady(ACharacter* Player) const
 7252: {

 7256: bool ARitualAltar::AreAllPlayersReady() const
 7257: {
 7258: 	// Check if all participating players are in the ready list
 7259: 	if (ParticipatingPlayers.Num() == 0 || ReadyPlayers.Num() == 0)
 7260: 	{
 7261: 		return false;
 7262: 	}
 7263: 
 7264: 	for (ACharacter* Player : ParticipatingPlayers)
 7265: 	{
 7266: 		if (!ReadyPlayers.Contains(Player))
 7267: 		{
 7268: 			return false;
 7269: 		}
 7270: 	}
 7271: 
 7272: 	return true;
 7273: }

 7275: void ARitualAltar::StartRitualCountdown()
 7276: {
 7277: 	if (!HasAuthority())
 7278: 	{
 7279: 		return;
 7280: 	}
 7281: 
 7282: 	// Set the state to preparing
 7283: 	CurrentRitualState = EInteractionState::Preparing;
 7284: 	// Broadcast on server for local UI updates (OnRep will handle clients)
 7285: 	BroadcastRitualStateChanged();
 7286: 
 7287: 	// Generate the ritual input sequence
 7288: 	GenerateInputSequence();
 7289: 
 7290: 	// Reset countdown value
 7291: 	StartCountdown = 3;
 7292: 	// Broadcast on server for local UI updates (OnRep will handle clients)
 7293: 	BroadcastCountdownTick();
 7294: 
 7295: 	// Start countdown timer
 7296: 	GetWorldTimerManager().SetTimer(
 7297: 		RitualStartCountdownHandle,
 7298: 		this,
 7299: 		&ARitualAltar::ProcessCountdownTick,
 7300: 		1.0f,  // Fire every second
 7301: 		true   // Looping
 7302: 	);
 7303: }
 7304: 
 7305: void ARitualAltar::ProcessCountdownTick()
 7306: {
 7307: 	if (!HasAuthority())
 7308: 	{
 7309: 		return;
 7310: 	}
 7311: 
 7312: 	// Decrease countdown
 7313: 	StartCountdown--;
 7314: 	// Broadcast on server for local UI updates (OnRep will handle clients)
 7315: 	BroadcastCountdownTick();
 7316: 
 7317: 	UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[DEBUG-RITUAL] Countdown: %d"), StartCountdown);
 7318: 
 7319: 	if (StartCountdown <= 0)
 7320: 	{
 7321: 		GetWorldTimerManager().ClearTimer(RitualStartCountdownHandle);
 7322: 		ActivateRitual();
 7323: 	}
 7324: }

 7326: void ARitualAltar::ActivateRitual()
 7327: {
 7328: 	if (!HasAuthority())
 7329: 	{
 7330: 		return;
 7331: 	}
 7332: 
 7333: 	// Set initial active player (from ready list)
 7334: 	int32 RandomStartingPlayer = FMath::RandRange(0, ReadyPlayers.Num() - 1);
 7335: 
 7336: 	// Fallback
 7337: 	CurrentActivePlayer = ParticipatingPlayers[RandomStartingPlayer];
 7338: 	CurrentSequenceIndex = 0;
 7339: 	CurrentRitualState = EInteractionState::Active;
 7340: 
 7341: 	// Start the input timer (this updates CurrentInputTimer)
 7342: 	StartInputTimer();
 7343: 
 7344: 	// Now update turn data with all the new values
 7345: 	UpdateTurnData();
 7346: 
 7347: 	// Broadcast state change on server for local UI updates (OnRep will handle clients)
 7348: 	BroadcastRitualStateChanged();
 7349: }

 7357: void ARitualAltar::GenerateInputSequence()
 7358: {
 7359: 	if (!HasAuthority())
 7360: 	{
 7361: 		return;
 7362: 	}
 7363: 
 7364: 	InputSequence.Empty();
 7365: 
 7366: 	// Number of inputs scales with the number of players and difficulty
 7367: 	int32 SequenceLength = FMath::Max(5, FMath::RoundToInt(5.0f * ParticipatingPlayers.Num() * DifficultyScalingMultiplier));
 7368: 
 7369: 	// Get gameplay tags from the native tag manager
 7370: 	const FWitchPTGameplayTags& WitchPtGameplayTags = FWitchPTGameplayTags::Get();
 7371: 
 7372: 	TArray<FGameplayTag> PossibleInputs;
 7373: 	PossibleInputs.Add(WitchPtGameplayTags.Ritual_Input_Up);
 7374: 	PossibleInputs.Add(WitchPtGameplayTags.Ritual_Input_Down);
 7375: 	PossibleInputs.Add(WitchPtGameplayTags.Ritual_Input_Left);
 7376: 	PossibleInputs.Add(WitchPtGameplayTags.Ritual_Input_Right);
 7377: 
 7378: 	// Generate random sequence
 7379: 	for (int32 i = 0; i < SequenceLength; ++i)
 7380: 	{
 7381: 		int32 RandomIndex = FMath::RandRange(0, PossibleInputs.Num() - 1);
 7382: 		InputSequence.Add(PossibleInputs[RandomIndex]);
 7383: 	}
 7384: 
 7385: 	// Reset sequence index
 7386: 
 7387: 
 7388: }

 7390: void ARitualAltar::HandlePlayerInput(ACharacter* Character, const FGameplayTag& InputTag)
 7391: {
 7392: 	if (!Character || !HasAuthority())
 7393: 	{
 7394: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("[DEBUG-RITUAL] Rejected input: no authority or invalid character"));
 7395: 		return;
 7396: 	}
 7397: 
 7398: 	// Check if the ritual is active
 7399: 	if (CurrentRitualState != EInteractionState::Active)
 7400: 	{
 7401: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("[DEBUG-RITUAL] Rejected input from %s: ritual not active (state=%d)"),
 7402: 			*Character->GetName(), static_cast<int32>(CurrentRitualState));
 7403: 		return;
 7404: 	}
 7405: 
 7406: 	// Check if it's this player's turn
 7407: 	if (Character != CurrentActivePlayer)
 7408: 	{
 7409: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("[DEBUG-RITUAL] Rejected input from %s: not their turn (current active=%s)"),
 7410: 			*Character->GetName(), CurrentActivePlayer ? *CurrentActivePlayer->GetName() : TEXT("None"));
 7411: 		return;
 7412: 	}
 7413: 
 7414: 	// Check if we have a valid input to match against
 7415: 	if (InputSequence.Num() == 0 || CurrentSequenceIndex >= InputSequence.Num())
 7416: 	{
 7417: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("[DEBUG-RITUAL] Input validation error: invalid sequence state (index=%d, sequence length=%d)"),
 7418: 			CurrentSequenceIndex, InputSequence.Num());
 7419: 		return;
 7420: 	}
 7421: 
 7422: 	// Get the expected input for the current step
 7423: 	FGameplayTag ExpectedInput = InputSequence[CurrentSequenceIndex];
 7424: 
 7425: 
 7426: 	// Check if the input matches
 7427: 	if (InputTag == ExpectedInput)
 7428: 	{
 7429: 		HandleInputSuccess(Character);
 7430: 	}
 7431: 	else
 7432: 	{
 7433: 		HandleInputFailure(Character);
 7434: 	}
 7435: }
 7436: 
 7437: void ARitualAltar::Multicast_OnInputSuccess_Implementation(ACharacter* Character)
 7438: {
 7439: 
 7440: 	if (Character)
 7441: 	{
 7442: 		UAbilitySystemComponent* ASC = UAbilitySystemBlueprintLibrary::GetAbilitySystemComponent(Character);
 7443: 		if (ASC)
 7444: 		{
 7445: 			const FWitchPTGameplayTags& WitchPtGameplayTags = FWitchPTGameplayTags::Get();
 7446: 			FGameplayEventData EventData;
 7447: 			EventData.EventTag = WitchPtGameplayTags.Event_Ritual_InputSuccess;
 7448: 			EventData.Instigator = this;
 7449: 			EventData.Target = Character;
 7450: 
 7451: 			// Buscar el tag de posición del jugador en el array
 7452: 			FGameplayTag* PositionTag = nullptr;
 7453: 			for (FPlayerPositionTagEntry& Entry : PlayerPositionTags)
 7454: 			{
 7455: 				if (Entry.Player == Character)
 7456: 				{
 7457: 					PositionTag = &Entry.PositionTag;
 7458: 					break;
 7459: 				}
 7460: 			}
 7461: 			if (PositionTag && PositionTag->MatchesTag(WitchPtGameplayTags.Get().Ritual_Position_1))
 7462: 			{
 7463: 				EventData.OptionalObject = PrimaryAnimMontage;
 7464: 			} else
 7465: 			{
 7466: 				EventData.OptionalObject = SecondaryAnimMontage;
 7467: 			}
 7468: 
 7469: 
 7470: 			UAbilitySystemBlueprintLibrary::SendGameplayEventToActor(Character, WitchPtGameplayTags.Event_Ritual_InputSuccess, EventData);
 7471: 		}
 7472: 
 7473: 
 7474: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[RitualAltar] Input success feedback for player %s"), *Character->GetName());
 7475: 	}
 7476: }
 7477: 
 7478: void ARitualAltar::HandleInputSuccess(ACharacter* Player)
 7479: {
 7480: 	if (!HasAuthority() || !Player)
 7481: 	{
 7482: 		return;
 7483: 	}
 7484: 
 7485: 	// Cancel the input timer
 7486: 	GetWorldTimerManager().ClearTimer(InputTimerHandle);
 7487: 
 7488: 	// Advance to the next input
 7489: 	CurrentSequenceIndex++;
 7490: 
 7491: 	// Send success feedback
 7492: 	Multicast_OnInputSuccess(Player);
 7493: 
 7494: 	// Check if the sequence is complete
 7495: 	if (CurrentSequenceIndex >= InputSequence.Num())
 7496: 	{
 7497: 		// Ritual succeeded
 7498: 		CurrentRitualState = EInteractionState::Succeeded;
 7499: 		bRitualCompleted = true;
 7500: 		bRitualWasSuccessful = true;
 7501: 
 7502: 		// Update turn data with final state
 7503: 		UpdateTurnData();
 7504: 
 7505: 		// Broadcast state and completion on server for local UI updates
 7506: 		BroadcastRitualStateChanged();
 7507: 		BroadcastRitualCompleted();
 7508: 
 7509: 		// Spawn reward and notify
 7510: 		SpawnReward();
 7511: 		Multicast_OnRitualSucceeded();
 7512: 
 7513: 		// Clean up
 7514: 		CleanupRitual();
 7515: 	}
 7516: 	else
 7517: 	{
 7518: 		// Move to the next player's turn (this updates CurrentActivePlayer)
 7519: 		AdvanceToNextPlayer();
 7520: 
 7521: 		// Start the input timer (this updates CurrentInputTimer)
 7522: 		StartInputTimer();
 7523: 
 7524: 		// Now update turn data with all the new values
 7525: 		UpdateTurnData();
 7526: 	}
 7527: }
 7528: 
 7529: void ARitualAltar::HandleInputFailure(ACharacter* Player)
 7530: {
 7531: 	if (!HasAuthority() || !Player)
 7532: 	{
 7533: 		return;
 7534: 	}
 7535: 
 7536: 	// Cancel the input timer
 7537: 	GetWorldTimerManager().ClearTimer(InputTimerHandle);
 7538: 
 7539: 	// Increase corruption
 7540: 	CorruptionAmount += CorruptionIncreasePerFail;
 7541: 	// Broadcast corruption change on server for local UI updates
 7542: 	BroadcastCorruptionChanged();
 7543: 
 7544: 	// DO NOT advance to the next input on failure - only on success
 7545: 	// CurrentSequenceIndex++; // REMOVED: Failed inputs should not advance the sequence
 7546: 
 7547: 	// Apply age penalty to the player
 7548: 	ApplyAgePenalty(Player);
 7549: 
 7550: 	// Send failure feedback
 7551: 	Multicast_OnInputFailed(Player);
 7552: 
 7553: 	// Check if corruption has reached the maximum
 7554: 	if (CorruptionAmount >= MaxCorruption)
 7555: 	{
 7556: 		// Ritual failed catastrophically
 7557: 		CurrentRitualState = EInteractionState::FailedCatastrophically;
 7558: 		bRitualCompleted = true;
 7559: 		bRitualWasSuccessful = false;
 7560: 
 7561: 		// Update turn data with final state
 7562: 		UpdateTurnData();
 7563: 
 7564: 		// Broadcast state and completion on server for local UI updates
 7565: 		BroadcastRitualStateChanged();
 7566: 		BroadcastRitualCompleted();
 7567: 
 7568: 		// Apply catastrophic penalties to all players
 7569: 		for (ACharacter* ParticipatingPlayer : ParticipatingPlayers)
 7570: 		{
 7571: 			if (ParticipatingPlayer)
 7572: 			{
 7573: 				ApplyAgePenalty(ParticipatingPlayer, true);
 7574: 			}
 7575: 		}
 7576: 
 7577: 		// Spawn demon and notify
 7578: 		SpawnDemon();
 7579: 		Multicast_OnRitualCatastrophicFail();
 7580: 
 7581: 		// Clean up
 7582: 		CleanupRitual();
 7583: 	}
 7584: 	else
 7585: 	{
 7586: 		// Move to the next player's turn (this updates CurrentActivePlayer)
 7587: 		AdvanceToNextPlayer();
 7588: 
 7589: 		// Start the input timer (this updates CurrentInputTimer)
 7590: 		StartInputTimer();
 7591: 
 7592: 		// Now update turn data with all the new values
 7593: 		UpdateTurnData();
 7594: 	}
 7595: }
 7596: 
 7597: void ARitualAltar::StartInputTimer()
 7598: {
 7599: 	if (!HasAuthority())
 7600: 	{
 7601: 		return;
 7602: 	}
 7603: 
 7604: 	// Calculate the time window for this input, possibly scaling down as the sequence progresses
 7605: 	float ProgressDifficulty = FMath::Clamp(CurrentSequenceIndex / (float)InputSequence.Num(), 0.0f, 1.0f);
 7606: 	float ScaledTimeWindow = BaseInputTimeWindow * (1.0f - (ProgressDifficulty * 0.5f)); // Up to 50% shorter at the end
 7607: 
 7608: 	// Set the timer value for client display
 7609: 	CurrentInputTimer = ScaledTimeWindow;
 7610: 
 7611: 
 7612: 	// Start the timer
 7613: 	GetWorldTimerManager().SetTimer(
 7614: 		InputTimerHandle,
 7615: 		this,
 7616: 		&ARitualAltar::OnInputTimerExpired,
 7617: 		ScaledTimeWindow,
 7618: 		false
 7619: 	);
 7620: 
 7621: 	UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[DEBUG-RITUAL] Started input timer: %.2f seconds for player %s, input %d/%d"),
 7622: 		ScaledTimeWindow, CurrentActivePlayer ? *CurrentActivePlayer->GetName() : TEXT("None"),
 7623: 		CurrentSequenceIndex, InputSequence.Num()-1);
 7624: 
 7625: 	// Log the expected input
 7626: 	if (InputSequence.IsValidIndex(CurrentSequenceIndex))
 7627: 	{
 7628: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[DEBUG-RITUAL] Current expected input: %s"),
 7629: 			*InputSequence[CurrentSequenceIndex].ToString());
 7630: 	}
 7631: }
 7632: 
 7633: void ARitualAltar::OnInputTimerExpired()
 7634: {
 7635: 	if (!HasAuthority() || CurrentRitualState != EInteractionState::Active)
 7636: 	{
 7637: 		return;
 7638: 	}
 7639: 
 7640: 	// If we get here, the player failed to input in time
 7641: 	if (CurrentActivePlayer)
 7642: 	{
 7643: 		HandleInputFailure(CurrentActivePlayer);
 7644: 	}
 7645: 	else
 7646: 	{
 7647: 		// Fallback in case CurrentActivePlayer is null
 7648: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("[RitualAltar] Timer expired but no active player!"));
 7649: 		AdvanceToNextPlayer();
 7650: 		StartInputTimer();
 7651: 	}
 7652: }
 7653: 
 7654: void ARitualAltar::AdvanceToNextPlayer()
 7655: {
 7656: 	if (!HasAuthority() || ParticipatingPlayers.Num() == 0)
 7657: 	{
 7658: 		return;
 7659: 	}
 7660: 
 7661: 
 7662: 	// Find the index of the current active player
 7663: 	int32 CurrentPlayerIndex = ParticipatingPlayers.IndexOfByKey(CurrentActivePlayer);
 7664: 
 7665: 	// If not found or at the end, wrap around to the first player
 7666: 	if (CurrentPlayerIndex == INDEX_NONE || CurrentPlayerIndex >= ParticipatingPlayers.Num() - 1)
 7667: 	{
 7668: 		CurrentPlayerIndex = 0;
 7669: 	}
 7670: 	else
 7671: 	{
 7672: 		CurrentPlayerIndex++;
 7673: 	}
 7674: 
 7675: 	// Safety check for eligible players
 7676: 	int32 StartIndex = CurrentPlayerIndex;
 7677: 	bool bFoundEligiblePlayer = false;
 7678: 
 7679: 	// Loop through players starting from CurrentPlayerIndex until we find an eligible one
 7680: 	do
 7681: 	{
 7682: 		ACharacter* NextPlayer = ParticipatingPlayers[CurrentPlayerIndex];
 7683: 		if (NextPlayer && IsPlayerEligibleForTurn(NextPlayer))
 7684: 		{
 7685: 			CurrentActivePlayer = NextPlayer;
 7686: 			bFoundEligiblePlayer = true;
 7687: 			break;
 7688: 		}
 7689: 
 7690: 		// Move to next player
 7691: 		CurrentPlayerIndex = (CurrentPlayerIndex + 1) % ParticipatingPlayers.Num();
 7692: 	}
 7693: 	while (CurrentPlayerIndex != StartIndex && !bFoundEligiblePlayer);
 7694: 
 7695: 	// If we couldn't find an eligible player, just use the first one as fallback
 7696: 	if (!bFoundEligiblePlayer && ParticipatingPlayers.Num() > 0)
 7697: 	{
 7698: 		CurrentActivePlayer = ParticipatingPlayers[0];
 7699: 	}
 7700: }
 7701: 
 7702: bool ARitualAltar::IsPlayerEligibleForTurn(ACharacter* Player) const
 7703: {
 7704: 	if (!Player)
 7705: 	{
 7706: 		return false;
 7707: 	}
 7708: 
 7709: 	// Check if the player is still in a ritual position
 7710: 	bool bIsInPosition = false;
 7711: 	for (const ABaseInteractionPosition* Position : InteractionPositions)
 7712: 	{
 7713: 		if (Position && Position->IsOccupied() && Position->GetOccupyingCharacter() == Player)
 7714: 		{
 7715: 			bIsInPosition = true;
 7716: 			break;
 7717: 		}
 7718: 	}
 7719: 
 7720: 	// Check if the player has the OccupyingPosition tag
 7721: 	const FWitchPTGameplayTags& WitchPtGameplayTags = FWitchPTGameplayTags::Get();
 7722: 	UAbilitySystemComponent* ASC = UAbilitySystemBlueprintLibrary::GetAbilitySystemComponent(Player);
 7723: 	bool bHasPositionTag = ASC && ASC->HasMatchingGameplayTag(WitchPtGameplayTags.Character_State_Ritual_InPosition);
 7724: 
 7725: 	return bIsInPosition && bHasPositionTag;
 7726: }

 7787: void ARitualAltar::CleanupRitual()
 7788: {

 7790: 	{
 7791: 		return;

 7795: 	GetWorldTimerManager().ClearTimer(InputTimerHandle);
 7796: 	GetWorldTimerManager().ClearTimer(RitualStartCountdownHandle);

 7824: FGameplayTag ARitualAltar::GetCurrentExpectedInput() const
 7825: {

 7837: FGameplayTag ARitualAltar::ConvertERitualInputToTag(ERitualInput Input)
 7838: {
 7839: 	const FWitchPTGameplayTags& WitchPtGameplayTags = FWitchPTGameplayTags::Get();
 7840: 
 7841: 	switch (Input)
 7842: 	{
 7843: 	case ERitualInput::Up:
 7844: 		return WitchPtGameplayTags.Ritual_Input_Up;
 7845: 	case ERitualInput::Down:
 7846: 		return WitchPtGameplayTags.Ritual_Input_Down;
 7847: 	case ERitualInput::Left:
 7848: 		return WitchPtGameplayTags.Ritual_Input_Left;
 7849: 	case ERitualInput::Right:
 7850: 		return WitchPtGameplayTags.Ritual_Input_Right;
 7851: 	default:
 7852: 		return FGameplayTag();
 7853: 	}
 7854: }
 7855: 
 7856: ERitualInput ARitualAltar::ConvertTagToERitualInput(const FGameplayTag& Tag)
 7857: {
 7858: 	const FWitchPTGameplayTags& WitchPtGameplayTags = FWitchPTGameplayTags::Get();
 7859: 
 7860: 	if (Tag == WitchPtGameplayTags.Ritual_Input_Up)
 7861: 		return ERitualInput::Up;
 7862: 	if (Tag == WitchPtGameplayTags.Ritual_Input_Down)
 7863: 		return ERitualInput::Down;
 7864: 	if (Tag == WitchPtGameplayTags.Ritual_Input_Left)
 7865: 		return ERitualInput::Left;
 7866: 	if (Tag == WitchPtGameplayTags.Ritual_Input_Right)
 7867: 		return ERitualInput::Right;
 7868: 
 7869: 	return ERitualInput::None;
 7870: }

 7901: void ARitualAltar::OccupyPosition(ACharacter* Player, ABaseInteractionPosition* Position)
 7902: {
 7903: 	// Print the local role por the RitualAltar and the Player
 7904: 	UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("[RitualAltar] Player LocalRole Role: %s"), *UEnum::GetValueAsString(Player->GetLocalRole()));
 7905: 	UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("[RitualAltar] Player RemoteRole Role: %s"), *UEnum::GetValueAsString(Player->GetRemoteRole()));
 7906: 	if (Player->IsLocallyControlled())
 7907: 	{
 7908: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("[RitualAltar] Player is locally controlled"));
 7909: 	}
 7910: 	else
 7911: 	{
 7912: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("[RitualAltar] Player is NOT locally controlled"));
 7913: 	}
 7914: 
 7915: 	if (!Player || !Position || !HasAuthority())
 7916: 	{
 7917: 		return;
 7918: 	}
 7919: 
 7920: 
 7921: 	if (Position->IsOccupied())
 7922: 	{
 7923: 		//broadcast
 7924: 		return;
 7925: 	}
 7926: 	Position->SetOccupied(Player);
 7927: 
 7928: 	bool bFound = false;
 7929: 	for (FPlayerPositionTagEntry& Entry : PlayerPositionTags)
 7930: 	{
 7931: 		if (Entry.Player == Player)
 7932: 		{
 7933: 			Entry.PositionTag = Position->GetPositionTag();
 7934: 			bFound = true;
 7935: 			break;
 7936: 		}
 7937: 	}
 7938: 	if (!bFound)
 7939: 	{
 7940: 		FPlayerPositionTagEntry NewEntry;
 7941: 		NewEntry.Player = Player;
 7942: 		NewEntry.PositionTag = Position->GetPositionTag();
 7943: 		PlayerPositionTags.Add(NewEntry);
 7944: 	}
 7945: 
 7946: 	// Add to participating players if not already there
 7947: 	if (!ParticipatingPlayers.Contains(Player))
 7948: 	{
 7949: 		ParticipatingPlayers.Add(Player);
 7950: 	}
 7951: 	CurrentRitualState = EInteractionState::WaitingForPlayers;
 7952: 
 7953: 	// Broadcast state change on server for local UI updates (OnRep will handle clients)
 7954: 	if (HasAuthority())
 7955: 	{
 7956: 		BroadcastRitualStateChanged();
 7957: 	}
 7958: 
 7959: 	// Update ready players data
 7960: 	UpdateReadyPlayersData();
 7961: 
 7962: 	// Show ritual widget for the player
 7963: 	AWitchPTPlayerController* PC = Cast<AWitchPTPlayerController>(Player->GetController());
 7964: 	if (PC)
 7965: 	{
 7966: 		if (Player->IsLocallyControlled())
 7967: 		{
 7968: 			// TODO: Remove this method of UI Initialization
 7969: 			// PC->LocalShowRitualWidget(this);
 7970: 		}
 7971: 		else
 7972: 		{
 7973: 			// TODO: Remove this method of UI Initialization
 7974: 			// PC->Client_ShowRitualWidget(this);
 7975: 
 7976: 		}
 7977: 
 7978: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[RitualAltar] Showing ritual widget for player %s"), *Player->GetName());
 7979: 	}
 7980: }

 7982: void ARitualAltar::Multicast_OnRitualSucceeded_Implementation()
 7983: {
 7984: 	// Client-side feedback for ritual success
 7985: 	// This would typically play sounds, particle effects, etc.
 7986: 
 7987: 	// Example: Play celebratory effects at altar location
 7988: 	// UGameplayStatics::PlaySoundAtLocation(this, SuccessSound, GetActorLocation());
 7989: 	// UGameplayStatics::SpawnEmitterAtLocation(GetWorld(), SuccessParticles, GetActorTransform());
 7990: 
 7991: 	// Set completion status for replication
 7992: 	bRitualCompleted = true;
 7993: 	bRitualWasSuccessful = true;
 7994: 
 7995: 	// Hide ritual widgets for all players (since this is multicast, each client handles their own widget)
 7996: 	if (HasAuthority())
 7997: 	{
 7998: 		HideRitualWidgetForAllPlayers();
 7999: 	}
 8000: 
 8001: 	DestroyAltarPositions();
 8002: 
 8003: 	UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[RitualAltar] Ritual succeeded feedback and widgets hidden"));
 8004: }

 8038: void ARitualAltar::HideRitualWidgetForAllPlayers()
 8039: {
 8040: 	// Hide ritual widget for all participating players
 8041: 	for (ACharacter* Player : ParticipatingPlayers)
 8042: 	{
 8043: 		if (Player)
 8044: 		{
 8045: 			AWitchPTPlayerController* PC = Cast<AWitchPTPlayerController>(Player->GetController());
 8046: 			if (PC)
 8047: 			{
 8048: 							// Hide widget based on player's network role
 8049: 			if (Player->IsLocallyControlled())
 8050: 			{
 8051: 				// Local player (either Listen Server or Client)
 8052: 				PC->LocalHideRitualWidget();
 8053: 			}
 8054: 			else
 8055: 			{
 8056: 				// Remote player - use RPC
 8057: 				PC->Client_HideRitualWidget();
 8058: 			}
 8059: 
 8060: 				UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[RitualAltar] Hidden ritual widget for player %s"), *Player->GetName());
 8061: 			}
 8062: 		}
 8063: 	}
 8064: }
 8065: 
 8066: void ARitualAltar::UnoccupyPosition(ACharacter* Player, ABaseInteractionPosition* Position)
 8067: {
 8068: 	if (!Player || !HasAuthority())
 8069: 	{
 8070: 		return;
 8071: 	}
 8072: 
 8073: 	// Hide the ritual widget for this specific player
 8074: 	AWitchPTPlayerController* PC = Cast<AWitchPTPlayerController>(Player->GetController());
 8075: 	if (PC)
 8076: 	{
 8077: 		// Always try to hide the widget - no need to check visibility since it's not replicated
 8078: 		if (Player->IsLocallyControlled())
 8079: 		{
 8080: 			// Local player (either Listen Server or Client)
 8081: 			PC->LocalHideRitualWidget();
 8082: 		}
 8083: 		else
 8084: 		{
 8085: 			// Remote player - use RPC
 8086: 			PC->Client_HideRitualWidget();
 8087: 		}
 8088: 
 8089: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[RitualAltar] Hidden ritual widget for leaving player %s"), *Player->GetName());
 8090: 	}
 8091: 
 8092: 	// Call parent implementation to handle the actual position logic
 8093: 	Super::UnoccupyPosition(Player, Position);
 8094: 
 8095: 	// Update ready players data if needed
 8096: 	ReadyPlayers.Remove(Player);
 8097: 	UpdateReadyPlayersData();
 8098: 
 8099: 	// Check if we should change ritual state
 8100: 	if (ParticipatingPlayers.Num() == 0)
 8101: 	{
 8102: 		// No players left, reset to inactive
 8103: 		CurrentRitualState = EInteractionState::Inactive;
 8104: 		BroadcastRitualStateChanged();
 8105: 
 8106: 		// Clear any ongoing ritual data
 8107: 		CurrentSequenceIndex = 0;
 8108: 		InputSequence.Empty();
 8109: 		CurrentActivePlayer = nullptr;
 8110: 		ReadyPlayers.Empty();
 8111: 		UpdateReadyPlayersData();
 8112: 
 8113: 		// Clear timers
 8114: 		GetWorldTimerManager().ClearTimer(RitualStartCountdownHandle);
 8115: 		GetWorldTimerManager().ClearTimer(InputTimerHandle);
 8116: 	}
 8117: }
 8118: </file>

 8394: {

 8397: 	{

 8406: void AWitchPTPlayerController::LocalShowRitualWidget(ABaseInteractableAltar* Altar)
 8407: {
 8408: 	if (!Altar || !IsLocalController())
 8409: 	{
 8410: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("LocalShowRitualWidget: Invalid altar or not local controller!"));
 8411: 		return;
 8412: 	}
 8413: 
 8414: 	if (Altar->IsA<ARitualAltar>())
 8415: 	{
 8416: 		// Cast the altar to a ritual altar
 8417: 		ARitualAltar* RitualAltar = Cast<ARitualAltar>(Altar);
 8418: 
 8419: 		// Get the HUD and show the ritual widget
 8420: 		AWitchPTHUD* WitchPTHUD = Cast<AWitchPTHUD>(GetHUD());
 8421: 		if (WitchPTHUD)
 8422: 		{
 8423: 			WitchPTHUD->ShowRitualWidget(RitualAltar);
 8424: 			bRitualWidgetVisible = true;
 8425: 			UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("LocalShowRitualWidget: Ritual widget shown for altar %s"), *RitualAltar->GetName());
 8426: 		}
 8427: 		else
 8428: 		{
 8429: 			UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("LocalShowRitualWidget: Failed to get WitchPTHUD!"));
 8430: 		}
 8431: 	}
 8432: }

 8439: 		return;
 8440: 	}
 8441: 
 8442: 	// Get the HUD and hide the ritual widget
 8443: 	AWitchPTHUD* WitchPTHUD = Cast<AWitchPTHUD>(GetHUD());
 8444: 	if (WitchPTHUD)
 8445: 	{
 8446: 		WitchPTHUD->HideRitualWidget();
 8447: 		bRitualWidgetVisible = false;

 8449: 	}
 8450: 	else

 8507: void AWitchPTPlayerController::BeginPlay()
 8508: {
 8509: 	Super::BeginPlay();
 8510: 	check(WitchPtiInputMappingContext)
 8511: 	UEnhancedInputLocalPlayerSubsystem* Subsystem = ULocalPlayer::GetSubsystem<UEnhancedInputLocalPlayerSubsystem>(GetLocalPlayer());
 8512: 	if (Subsystem)
 8513: 	{
 8514: 		Subsystem->AddMappingContext(WitchPtiInputMappingContext, 1);
 8515: 	}
 8516: 	CreateHUDWidget();
 8517: 
 8518: 	if (ULocalPlayer* LocalPlayer = GetLocalPlayer())
 8519: 	{
 8520: 		if (UUIManagerSubsystem* UIManagerSubsystem = GetGameInstance()->GetSubsystem<UUIManagerSubsystem>())

 8527: void AWitchPTPlayerController::SetupInputComponent()
 8528: {
 8529: 	Super::SetupInputComponent();
 8530: 	UWitchPTInputComponent* WitchPtInputComponent = CastChecked<UWitchPTInputComponent>(InputComponent);
 8531: 	WitchPtInputComponent->BindAction(MoveAction, ETriggerEvent::Triggered, this, &AWitchPTPlayerController::Move);
 8532: 	WitchPtInputComponent->BindAction(LookAction, ETriggerEvent::Triggered, this, &AWitchPTPlayerController::Look);
 8533: 	WitchPtInputComponent->BindAbilityActions(InputConfig, this, &ThisClass::AbilityInputTagPressed, &ThisClass::AbilityInputTagReleased, &ThisClass::AbilityInputTagHeld);

 8537: void AWitchPTPlayerController::Move(const FInputActionValue& InputActionValue)
 8538: {
 8539: 	const FVector2D InputAxisVector = InputActionValue.Get<FVector2D>();
 8540: 	const FRotator Rotation = GetControlRotation();
 8541: 	const FRotator YawRotation(0.f, Rotation.Yaw, 0.f);
 8542: 
 8543: 	const FVector ForwardDirection = FRotationMatrix(YawRotation).GetUnitAxis(EAxis::X);
 8544: 	const FVector RightDirection = FRotationMatrix(YawRotation).GetUnitAxis(EAxis::Y);
 8545: 
 8546: 	if (APawn* ControlledPawn = GetPawn<APawn>())
 8547: 	{
 8548: 		ControlledPawn->AddMovementInput(ForwardDirection, InputAxisVector.Y);
 8549: 		ControlledPawn->AddMovementInput(RightDirection, InputAxisVector.X);
 8550: 	}
 8551: 
 8552: }
 8553: 
 8554: void AWitchPTPlayerController::Look(const FInputActionValue& Value)
 8555: {
 8556: 	// input is a Vector2D
 8557: 	FVector2D LookAxisVector = Value.Get<FVector2D>();
 8558: 
 8559: 	if (APawn* ControlledPawn = GetPawn<APawn>())
 8560: 	{
 8561: 		// add yaw and pitch input to controller
 8562: 		ControlledPawn->AddControllerYawInput(LookAxisVector.X);
 8563: 		ControlledPawn->AddControllerPitchInput(LookAxisVector.Y);
 8564: 	}
 8565: }

 8818: void UUIManagerSubsystem::FocusModal(APlayerController* PlayerController, UUserWidget* WidgetToFocus, bool bShowCursor, bool bUIOnlyInput)
 8819: {
 8820: 	if (PlayerController)
 8821: 	{
 8822: 		// Check if the widget is valid before trying to focus it
 8823: 		if (!IsValid(WidgetToFocus))
 8824: 		{
 8825: 			UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("FocusModal: WidgetToFocus is invalid or null"));
 8826: 			return;
 8827: 		}
 8828: 
 8829: 		if(bUIOnlyInput)
 8830: 		{
 8831: 			FInputModeUIOnly InputMode;
 8832: 			InputMode.SetWidgetToFocus(WidgetToFocus->TakeWidget());
 8833: 			PlayerController->SetInputMode(InputMode);
 8834: 			bShowCursor ? PlayerController->bShowMouseCursor = true : PlayerController->bShowMouseCursor = false;
 8835: 		}
 8836: 		else
 8837: 		{
 8838: 			FInputModeGameAndUI InputMode;
 8839: 			InputMode.SetWidgetToFocus(WidgetToFocus->TakeWidget());
 8840: 			InputMode.SetLockMouseToViewportBehavior(EMouseLockMode::DoNotLock);
 8841: 			bShowCursor ? PlayerController->bShowMouseCursor = true : PlayerController->bShowMouseCursor = false;
 8842: 			PlayerController->SetInputMode(InputMode);
 8843: 		}
 8844: 	}
 8845: }

 8907: TMap<TSubclassOf<UWitchPTWidgetController>, UWitchPTWidgetController*> AWitchPTHUD::CreateWidgetsControllers(
 8908: 	const TArray<TSubclassOf<UWitchPTWidgetController>>& ControllerClasses, const FWidgetControllerParams& WCParams,
 8909: 	UObject* ContextObject)
 8910: {
 8911: 	TMap<TSubclassOf<UWitchPTWidgetController>, UWitchPTWidgetController*> ResultPackage;
 8912: 	for (TSubclassOf ControllerClass : ControllerClasses)
 8913: 	{
 8914: 		if (!ControllerClass) continue;
 8915: 
 8916: 		TObjectPtr<UWitchPTWidgetController>* FoundController = ControllerCache.Find(ControllerClass);
 8917: 		UWitchPTWidgetController* ControllerInstance = nullptr;
 8918: 
 8919: 		if (FoundController && *FoundController)
 8920: 		{
 8921: 			ControllerInstance = *FoundController;
 8922: 		}
 8923: 		else
 8924: 		{
 8925: 			ControllerInstance = NewObject<UWitchPTWidgetController>(this, ControllerClass);
 8926: 			ControllerCache.Add(ControllerClass, ControllerInstance);
 8927: 		}
 8928: 
 8929: 		ControllerInstance->SetWidgetControllerParams(WCParams);
 8930: 		ControllerInstance->SetContextualObject(ContextObject);
 8931: 
 8932: 		ResultPackage.Add(ControllerClass, ControllerInstance);
 8933: 	}
 8934: 
 8935: 	return ResultPackage;
 8936: }

 8948: 		}

 8989: 	for (auto& ViewModelClass : ViewModelClasses)
 8990: 	{
 8991: 		UWitchPT_MVVMViewModelBase* ViewModelInstance = NewObject<UWitchPT_MVVMViewModelBase>(this, ViewModelClass.Key);
 8992: 		ViewModelInstance->SetViewModelParams(FViewModelParams(PC, PS, ASC, AS));
 8993: 		ViewModelInstance->BindCallbacksToDependencies();
 8994: 		ViewModelInstance->BroadcastInitialValues();
 8995: 
 8996: 		if (UMVVMGameSubsystem* MVVMSubsystem = GetGameInstance()->GetSubsystem<UMVVMGameSubsystem>())
 8997: 		{
 8998: 			if (UMVVMViewModelCollectionObject* MVVM_Collection = MVVMSubsystem->GetViewModelCollection())
 8999: 			{
 9000: 				FMVVMViewModelContext MVVM_Context(ViewModelClass.Key, ViewModelClass.Value);
 9001: 				MVVM_Collection->AddViewModelInstance(MVVM_Context, ViewModelInstance);
 9002: 			}
 9003: 		}
 9004: 	}
 9005: }

 9105: void AWitchPTHUD::ToggleGameMenu(TSubclassOf<UWitchPTUserWidget> WidgetClass)
 9106: {
 9107: 	// Find the widget by class
 9108: 	if (WidgetClass)
 9109: 	{
 9110: 		UWitchPTUserWidget* WidgetToToggle = nullptr;
 9111: 		for (UUserWidget* Widget : GameMenuWidgets)
 9112: 		{
 9113: 			if (Widget->IsA(WidgetClass))
 9114: 			{
 9115: 				WidgetToToggle = Cast<UWitchPTUserWidget>(Widget);
 9116: 				break;
 9117: 			}
 9118: 		}
 9119: 		if (!WidgetToToggle) return;
 9120: 		const bool bIsTargetWidgetAlreadyVisible = WidgetToToggle->IsVisible();
 9121: 		// Hide all game menu widgets first
 9122: 		for (auto& MenuWidget : GameMenuWidgets)
 9123: 		{
 9124: 			if (MenuWidget && MenuWidget->IsVisible())
 9125: 			{
 9126: 				MenuWidget->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
 9127: 			}
 9128: 		}
 9129: 		APlayerController* PC = GetOwningPlayerController();
 9130: 
 9131: 		if (bIsTargetWidgetAlreadyVisible)
 9132: 		{
 9133: 			if (PC)
 9134: 			{
 9135: 				PC->SetInputMode(FInputModeGameOnly());
 9136: 				PC->bShowMouseCursor = false;
 9137: 			}
 9138: 		} else
 9139: 		{
 9140: 
 9141: 			WidgetToToggle->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Visible);
 9142: 			FInputModeGameAndUI InputMode;
 9143: 			InputMode.SetWidgetToFocus(WidgetToToggle->TakeWidget());
 9144: 			InputMode.SetLockMouseToViewportBehavior(EMouseLockMode::DoNotLock);
 9145: 			PC->SetInputMode(InputMode);
 9146: 			PC->SetShowMouseCursor(true);
 9147: 		}
 9148: 	}
 9149: 
 9150: 
 9151: }

 9154: void AWitchPTHUD::ShowRitualWidget(class ARitualAltar* RitualAltar)
 9155: {
 9156: 	if (RitualWidget && RitualWidgetController)
 9157: 	{
 9158: 		// Set the ritual altar reference in the controller
 9159: 		// Note: SetRitualAltar() already calls BindCallbacksToDependencies() and BroadcastInitialValues()
 9160: 		RitualWidgetController->SetRitualAltar(RitualAltar);
 9161: 
 9162: 		// Use enhanced widget show method if available
 9163: 		URitualUserWidget* RitualUserWidget = Cast<URitualUserWidget>(RitualWidget);
 9164: 		if (RitualUserWidget)
 9165: 		{
 9166: 			RitualUserWidget->ShowForRitual(RitualAltar);
 9167: 		}
 9168: 
 9169: 		// Show the widget
 9170: 		RitualWidget->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Visible);
 9171: 
 9172: 		// Set input mode to allow UI interaction
 9173: 		APlayerController* PC = GetOwningPlayerController();
 9174: 		if (PC)
 9175: 		{
 9176: 			FInputModeGameAndUI InputMode;
 9177: 			InputMode.SetLockMouseToViewportBehavior(EMouseLockMode::DoNotLock);
 9178: 			InputMode.SetHideCursorDuringCapture(false);
 9179: 			PC->SetInputMode(InputMode);
 9180: 			PC->bShowMouseCursor = true;
 9181: 		}
 9182: 	}
 9183: }
 9184: 
 9185: void AWitchPTHUD::HideRitualWidget()
 9186: {
 9187: 	if (RitualWidget)
 9188: 	{
 9189: 		// Use enhanced widget hide method if available
 9190: 		URitualUserWidget* RitualUserWidget = Cast<URitualUserWidget>(RitualWidget);
 9191: 		if (RitualUserWidget)
 9192: 		{
 9193: 			RitualUserWidget->HideFromRitual();
 9194: 		}
 9195: 
 9196: 		// Hide the widget
 9197: 		RitualWidget->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
 9198: 
 9199: 		// Clear the ritual altar reference in the controller
 9200: 		if (RitualWidgetController)
 9201: 		{
 9202: 			RitualWidgetController->SetRitualAltar(nullptr);
 9203: 		}
 9204: 
 9205: 		// Restore game-only input mode
 9206: 		APlayerController* PC = GetOwningPlayerController();
 9207: 		if (PC)
 9208: 		{
 9209: 			PC->SetInputMode(FInputModeGameOnly());
 9210: 			PC->bShowMouseCursor = false;
 9211: 		}
 9212: 	}
 9213: }

 9285: 			CauldronWidgetController->UnbindCallbacksFromDependencies();

 9288: 		// Restore game input mode
 9289: 		APlayerController* PC = GetOwningPlayerController();
 9290: 		if (PC)

 9293: 			PC->SetShowMouseCursor(false);

 9465: void UMVVM_InventoryViewModel::EquipItem(UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* ItemInstance)
 9466: {
 9467: 	if (ItemInstance)
 9468: 	{
 9469: 		if (ACharacter* OwningCharacter = Cast<ACharacter>(PlayerController->GetPawn()))
 9470: 		{
 9471: 			if (UWitchPTEquipmentManagerComponent* EquipmentManager = OwningCharacter->FindComponentByClass<UWitchPTEquipmentManagerComponent>())
 9472: 			{
 9473: 				if (UWitchPTEquipmentInstance* EquipmentInstance = EquipmentManager->FindEquipmentByInventoryItem(ItemInstance))
 9474: 				{
 9475: 					EquipmentManager->UnequipItem(EquipmentInstance);
 9476: 				}
 9477: 				else
 9478: 				{
 9479: 					const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment* BaseFragment = ItemInstance->FindFragmentByClass(UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_EquippableItem::StaticClass());
 9480: 					const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_EquippableItem* EquipableFragment = Cast<const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_EquippableItem>(BaseFragment);
 9481: 					EquipmentManager->EquipItem(EquipableFragment->EquipmentDefinition);
 9482: 				}
 9483: 			}
 9484: 		}
 9485: 	}
 9486: }
 9487: 
 9488: void UMVVM_InventoryViewModel::RemoveItemStack(UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* ItemInstance, int32 AmountToRemove)
 9489: {
 9490: 	if (!ItemInstance)
 9491: 	{
 9492: 		return;
 9493: 	}
 9494: 
 9495: 	if (AWitchPTPlayerController* WitchPtPlayerController = Cast<AWitchPTPlayerController>(PlayerController))
 9496: 	{
 9497: 		if (UWitchPTInventoryManagerComponent* InventoryManager = WitchPtPlayerController->GetInventoryManager())
 9498: 		{
 9499: 			const int32 CurrentStackCount = ItemInstance->GetTotalStackCount();
 9500: 
 9501: 			// If we only have 1 item left and trying to remove 1 or more, remove the item completely
 9502: 			if (CurrentStackCount <= 1 && AmountToRemove >= 1)
 9503: 			{
 9504: 				InventoryManager->Server_RemoveItemInstance(ItemInstance);
 9505: 			}
 9506: 			else
 9507: 			{
 9508: 				// Otherwise, reduce the stack count by the requested amount
 9509: 				InventoryManager->Server_RemoveItemStacks(ItemInstance, AmountToRemove);
 9510: 			}
 9511: 		}
 9512: 	}
 9513: }

 9997: void UInventoryWidgetController::BindCallbacksToDependencies()
 9998: {
 9999: 	AWitchPTPlayerController* WitchPtPlayerController = Cast<AWitchPTPlayerController>(PlayerController);
10000: 	if (WitchPtPlayerController)
10001: 	{
10002: 		UWitchPTInventoryManagerComponent* InventoryManager = WitchPtPlayerController->GetInventoryManager();
10003: 		if (InventoryManager)
10004: 		{
10005: 			InventoryManager->OnItemAdded.AddLambda([this](UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* ItemAdded)
10006: 			{
10007: 				OnItemAddedDelegate.Broadcast(ItemAdded);
10008: 			});
10009: 			InventoryManager->OnItemStackChanged.AddLambda([this](UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* ItemAdded)
10010: 			{

10012: 			});

10026: 		{
10027: 			InventoryManager->OnItemAdded.RemoveAll(this);
10028: 			InventoryManager->OnItemStackChanged.RemoveAll(this);

10030: 		}

10035: void UInventoryWidgetController::RemoveItemStack(UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* ItemInstance, int32 AmountToRemove)
10036: {
10037: 	if (!ItemInstance)
10038: 	{
10039: 		return;
10040: 	}
10041: 
10042: 	AWitchPTPlayerController* WitchPtPlayerController = Cast<AWitchPTPlayerController>(PlayerController);
10043: 	if (!WitchPtPlayerController)
10044: 	{
10045: 		return;
10046: 	}
10047: 
10048: 	UWitchPTInventoryManagerComponent* InventoryManager = WitchPtPlayerController->GetInventoryManager();
10049: 	if (!InventoryManager)
10050: 	{
10051: 		return;
10052: 	}
10053: 
10054: 	const int32 CurrentStackCount = ItemInstance->GetTotalStackCount();
10055: 
10056: 	// If we only have 1 item left and trying to remove 1 or more, remove the item completely
10057: 	if (CurrentStackCount <= 1 && AmountToRemove >= 1)
10058: 	{
10059: 		InventoryManager->Server_RemoveItemInstance(ItemInstance);
10060: 	}
10061: 	else
10062: 	{
10063: 		// Otherwise, reduce the stack count by the requested amount
10064: 		InventoryManager->Server_RemoveItemStacks(ItemInstance, AmountToRemove);
10065: 	}
10066: }

10068: void UInventoryWidgetController::OnItemDragStart(UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* ItemInstance)
10069: {
10070: 
10071: 	if (ULocalPlayer* LocalPlayer = PlayerController->GetLocalPlayer())
10072: 	{
10073: 		if (UWidgetCommunicatorSubsystem* WidgetCommunicator = LocalPlayer->GetSubsystem<UWidgetCommunicatorSubsystem>())
10074: 		{
10075: 			WidgetCommunicator->OnItemDragged(ItemInstance);
10076: 		}
10077: 	}
10078: 	else
10079: 	{
10080: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("WidgetCommunicatorSubsystem not found in the world!"));
10081: 	}
10082: }

10084: void UInventoryWidgetController::EquipItem(UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* ItemInstance)
10085: {
10086: 	if (ItemInstance)
10087: 	{
10088: 		ACharacter* OwningCharacter = Cast<ACharacter>(PlayerController->GetPawn());
10089: 		if (OwningCharacter)
10090: 		{
10091: 			UWitchPTEquipmentManagerComponent* EquipmentManager = OwningCharacter->FindComponentByClass<UWitchPTEquipmentManagerComponent>();
10092: 			if (EquipmentManager)
10093: 			{
10094: 				UWitchPTEquipmentInstance* EquipmentInstance = EquipmentManager->FindEquipmentByInventoryItem(ItemInstance);
10095: 				if (EquipmentInstance)
10096: 				{
10097: 					EquipmentManager->UnequipItem(EquipmentInstance);
10098: 				}
10099: 				else
10100: 				{
10101: 					const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment* BaseFragment = ItemInstance->FindFragmentByClass(UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_EquippableItem::StaticClass());
10102: 					const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_EquippableItem* EquippableFragment = Cast<const UWitchPTInventoryItemFragment_EquippableItem>(BaseFragment);
10103: 					EquipmentManager->EquipItem(EquippableFragment->EquipmentDefinition);
10104: 				}
10105: 			}
10106: 		}
10107: 		else
10108: 		{
10109: 			UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("Owning character is not a valid ACharacter instance."));
10110: 		}
10111: 	}
10112: }
10113: </file>

10136: void UOverlayWidgetController::BindCallbacksToDependencies()
10137: {

10139: 
10140: 	AbilitySystemComponent->GetGameplayAttributeValueChangeDelegate(WitchPT_AS->GetHealthAttribute()).AddLambda([this](const FOnAttributeChangeData& Data)

10151: 	{

10154: 
10155: 	AbilitySystemComponent->GetGameplayAttributeValueChangeDelegate(WitchPT_AS->GetMaxStaminaAttribute()).AddLambda([this](const FOnAttributeChangeData& Data)
10156: 	{
10157: 		OnMaxStaminaChanged.Broadcast(Data.NewValue);
10158: 	});
10159: 
10160: 	AbilitySystemComponent->GetGameplayAttributeValueChangeDelegate(WitchPT_AS->GetAgeAttribute()).AddLambda([this](const FOnAttributeChangeData& Data)
10161: 	{
10162: 		OnAgeChanged.Broadcast(Data.NewValue);

10166: 	{
10167: 		OnMaxAgeChanged.Broadcast(Data.NewValue);
10168: 	});
10169: 
10170: 	UWitchPTAbilitySystemComponent* WitchPTAbilitySystemComponent = Cast<UWitchPTAbilitySystemComponent>(AbilitySystemComponent);
10171: 
10172: 	WitchPTAbilitySystemComponent->OnEffectAssetTags.AddUObject(this, &UOverlayWidgetController::OnAssetTagReceivedFromGE);
10173: 
10174: 	// Lambda for message delegates
10175: 	WitchPTAbilitySystemComponent->OnEffectAssetTags.AddLambda(
10176: 		// [this] is the capture list, in the case of this lambda, we want to capture this (OverlayWidgetController)
10177: 		[this](const FGameplayTagContainer& AssetTags)
10178: 	{
10179: 		for (const auto& Tag : AssetTags)
10180: 		{
10181: 			// Declare the tag we want to check. In our case "MessageTag"
10182: 			FGameplayTag ParentMessageGameplayTag = FGameplayTag::RequestGameplayTag(FName("Communication.Message"));
10183: 			if (Tag.MatchesTag(ParentMessageGameplayTag))
10184: 			{
10185: 
10186: 
10187: 				const FUIWidgetRow* Row = GetDataTableRowByTag<FUIWidgetRow>(MessageWidgetDataTable, Tag);
10188: 				OnMessageWidgetRow.Broadcast(*Row);
10189: 
10190: 			}
10191: 
10192: 		}
10193: 	});
10194: 
10195: 
10196:

10312: void URitualWidgetController::BroadcastInitialValues()
10313: {
10314:     // Enhanced null safety - only broadcast if we have a valid altar
10315:     if (!IsValid(RitualAltar))
10316:     {
10317:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("[RitualWidgetController] BroadcastInitialValues called with invalid altar"));
10318:         return;
10319:     }
10320: 
10321:     // Broadcast current state
10322:     OnRitualStateChanged.Broadcast(RitualAltar->GetCurrentRitualState());
10323: 
10324:     // Broadcast ready players data
10325:     FRitualReadyPlayersData ReadyPlayersData;
10326:     ReadyPlayersData.TotalPlayers = RitualAltar->GetNumberOfTotalPlayers();
10327:     ReadyPlayersData.ReadyPlayers = RitualAltar->GetNumberOfReadyPlayers();
10328:     OnReadyPlayersChanged.Broadcast(ReadyPlayersData);
10329: 
10330:     // Broadcast current turn data (processed for local player)
10331:     FUIRitualData CurrentTurnData = RitualAltar->GetCurrentTurnData();
10332:     FUIRitualData ProcessedTurnData = ProcessTurnDataForLocalPlayer(CurrentTurnData);
10333:     OnTurnDataChanged.Broadcast(ProcessedTurnData);
10334: 
10335:     // Broadcast corruption
10336:     OnRitualCorruptionChanged.Broadcast(RitualAltar->GetCorruptionPercentage());
10337: 
10338:     // Broadcast sequence progress
10339:     OnRitualSequenceProgressChanged.Broadcast(RitualAltar->GetCurrentSequenceProgress());
10340: 
10341:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[RitualWidgetController] Initial values broadcasted"));
10342: }
10343: 
10344: void URitualWidgetController::BindCallbacksToDependencies()
10345: {
10346:     // Enhanced null safety - only bind if we have a valid altar
10347:     if (!IsValid(RitualAltar))
10348:     {
10349:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("[RitualWidgetController] BindCallbacksToDependencies called with invalid altar"));
10350:         return;
10351:     }
10352: 
10353:     // Bind to all the dynamic multicast delegates
10354:     RitualAltar->OnRitualStateChangedEvent.AddDynamic(this, &URitualWidgetController::HandleRitualStateChanged);
10355:     RitualAltar->OnReadyPlayersChangedEvent.AddDynamic(this, &URitualWidgetController::HandleReadyPlayersChanged);
10356:     RitualAltar->OnCountdownTickEvent.AddDynamic(this, &URitualWidgetController::HandleCountdownTick);
10357:     RitualAltar->OnTurnDataChangedEvent.AddDynamic(this, &URitualWidgetController::HandleTurnDataChanged);
10358:     RitualAltar->OnCorruptionChangedEvent.AddDynamic(this, &URitualWidgetController::HandleCorruptionChanged);
10359:     RitualAltar->OnSequenceProgressChangedEvent.AddDynamic(this, &URitualWidgetController::HandleSequenceProgressChanged);
10360:     RitualAltar->OnRitualCompletedEvent.AddDynamic(this, &URitualWidgetController::HandleRitualCompleted);
10361: 
10362:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[RitualWidgetController] Callbacks bound to dependencies"));
10363: }
10364: 
10365: void URitualWidgetController::SetContextualObject(UObject* ContextualObject)
10366: {
10367:     if (ContextualObject)
10368:     {
10369:         if (ARitualAltar* InRitualAltar = Cast<ARitualAltar>(ContextualObject))
10370:         {
10371:             SetRitualAltar(InRitualAltar);
10372:         }
10373:     }
10374: }
10375: 
10376: void URitualWidgetController::SetRitualAltar(ARitualAltar* InRitualAltar)
10377: {
10378:     // Enhanced null safety and cleanup
10379: 
10380:     // Unbind any existing callbacks first
10381:     if (IsValid(RitualAltar))
10382:     {
10383:         RitualAltar->OnRitualStateChangedEvent.RemoveAll(this);
10384:         RitualAltar->OnReadyPlayersChangedEvent.RemoveAll(this);
10385:         RitualAltar->OnCountdownTickEvent.RemoveAll(this);
10386:         RitualAltar->OnTurnDataChangedEvent.RemoveAll(this);
10387:         RitualAltar->OnCorruptionChangedEvent.RemoveAll(this);
10388:         RitualAltar->OnSequenceProgressChangedEvent.RemoveAll(this);
10389:         RitualAltar->OnRitualCompletedEvent.RemoveAll(this);
10390: 
10391:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[RitualWidgetController] Unbound callbacks from previous altar"));
10392:     }
10393: 
10394:     // Assign the new altar
10395:     RitualAltar = InRitualAltar;
10396: 
10397: }
10398: 
10399: bool URitualWidgetController::IsLocalPlayerActive() const
10400: {
10401:     // Enhanced null safety checks
10402:     if (!IsValid(RitualAltar) || !IsValid(PlayerController))
10403:     {
10404:         return false;
10405:     }
10406: 
10407:     // Get the local character
10408:     ACharacter* LocalCharacter = Cast<ACharacter>(PlayerController->GetPawn());
10409:     if (!IsValid(LocalCharacter))
10410:     {
10411:         return false;
10412:     }
10413: 
10414:     // Check if this character is the active player
10415:     ACharacter* ActivePlayer = RitualAltar->GetCurrentActivePlayer();
10416:     return IsValid(ActivePlayer) && ActivePlayer == LocalCharacter;
10417: }
10418: 
10419: FUIRitualData URitualWidgetController::ProcessTurnDataForLocalPlayer(const FUIRitualData& InTurnData) const
10420: {
10421:     FUIRitualData ProcessedData = InTurnData;
10422: 
10423:     // Determine if it's the local player's turn
10424:     ProcessedData.bIsMyTurn = IsLocalPlayerActive();
10425: 
10426:     // If it's not the local player's turn, clear sensitive data
10427:     if (!ProcessedData.bIsMyTurn)
10428:     {
10429:         ProcessedData.ExpectedInput = FGameplayTag::EmptyTag;
10430:         ProcessedData.CurrentInputTimeRemaining = 0.0f;
10431:     }
10432: 
10433:     return ProcessedData;
10434: }
10435:

10437: 
10438: void URitualWidgetController::HandleRitualStateChanged(EInteractionState NewState)

10453: void URitualWidgetController::HandleTurnDataChanged(FUIRitualData TurnData)
10454: {
10455:     // Process the turn data for the local player before broadcasting
10456:     FUIRitualData ProcessedTurnData = ProcessTurnDataForLocalPlayer(TurnData);
10457:     OnTurnDataChanged.Broadcast(ProcessedTurnData);
10458: 
10459:     // Also broadcast the expected input separately for backward compatibility
10460:     if (ProcessedTurnData.bIsMyTurn)
10461:     {
10462:         OnRitualExpectedInputChanged.Broadcast(ProcessedTurnData.ExpectedInput);
10463:     }
10464:     else
10465:     {
10466:         OnRitualExpectedInputChanged.Broadcast(FGameplayTag::EmptyTag);
10467:     }
10468: }

10470: void URitualWidgetController::HandleCorruptionChanged(float CorruptionPercentage)
10471: {

10473: }

10475: void URitualWidgetController::HandleSequenceProgressChanged(float ProgressPercentage)
10476: {
10477:     OnRitualSequenceProgressChanged.Broadcast(ProgressPercentage);
10478: }
10479: 
10480: void URitualWidgetController::HandleRitualCompleted(bool bWasSuccessful)
10481: {
10482:     OnRitualCompleted.Broadcast(bWasSuccessful);
10483: 
10484:     // Enhanced cleanup: Unbind all delegates when ritual is completed to prevent memory leaks
10485:     if (IsValid(RitualAltar))
10486:     {
10487:         RitualAltar->OnRitualStateChangedEvent.RemoveAll(this);
10488:         RitualAltar->OnReadyPlayersChangedEvent.RemoveAll(this);
10489:         RitualAltar->OnCountdownTickEvent.RemoveAll(this);
10490:         RitualAltar->OnTurnDataChangedEvent.RemoveAll(this);
10491:         RitualAltar->OnCorruptionChangedEvent.RemoveAll(this);
10492:         RitualAltar->OnSequenceProgressChangedEvent.RemoveAll(this);
10493:         RitualAltar->OnRitualCompletedEvent.RemoveAll(this);
10494: 
10495:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[RitualWidgetController] Unbound all delegates after ritual completion"));
10496:     }
10497: 
10498:     // Clear the altar reference
10499:     RitualAltar = nullptr;
10500: }
10501: </file>

10609: void URitualUserWidget::ShowForRitual(ARitualAltar* Altar)
10610: {
10611:     if (!Altar)
10612:     {
10613:         UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("[RitualUserWidget] ShowForRitual called with null altar"));
10614:         return;
10615:     }
10616: 
10617:     // If we're already active for a different ritual, reset first
10618:     if (bIsActiveForRitual && CurrentRitualAltar != Altar)
10619:     {
10620:         ResetWidgetState();
10621:     }
10622: 
10623:     // Set up for the new ritual
10624:     CurrentRitualAltar = Altar;
10625:     bIsActiveForRitual = true;
10626: 
10627:     // Call Blueprint implementable event
10628:     OnShownForRitual(Altar);
10629: 
10630:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[RitualUserWidget] Shown for ritual altar"));
10631: }
10632: 
10633: void URitualUserWidget::HideFromRitual()
10634: {
10635:     if (!bIsActiveForRitual)
10636:     {
10637:         return; // Already hidden
10638:     }
10639: 
10640:     // Clear state
10641:     bIsActiveForRitual = false;
10642:     ARitualAltar* PreviousAltar = CurrentRitualAltar;
10643:     CurrentRitualAltar = nullptr;
10644: 
10645:     // Call Blueprint implementable event
10646:     OnHiddenFromRitual();
10647: 
10648:     // Reset widget state
10649:     ResetWidgetState();
10650: 
10651:     UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[RitualUserWidget] Hidden from ritual"));
10652: }

10684: UUserWidget* UWitchPTUILayer::PushContent(TSubclassOf<UUserWidget> WidgetClass)
10685: {
10686: 	if (!WidgetClass)
10687: 	{
10688: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("PushContent: WidgetClass is null"));
10689: 		return nullptr;
10690: 	}
10691: 
10692: 	if (!GetWorld())
10693: 	{
10694: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("PushContent: GetWorld() returned null"));
10695: 		return nullptr;
10696: 	}
10697: 
10698: 	if (UUserWidget* UserWidgetInstance = WidgetPool.GetOrCreateInstance<UUserWidget>(WidgetClass))
10699: 	{
10700: 		// TODO: Check the creation of this widget by this tutorial: https://unreal-garden.com/tutorials/userwidget-pool/
10701: 		CollapseTop();
10702: 		Border->ClearChildren();
10703: 		Stack.Add(UserWidgetInstance);
10704: 		Border->AddChild(UserWidgetInstance);
10705: 		ShowTop();
10706: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("Pushing widget: %s"), *UserWidgetInstance->GetName());
10707: 		return UserWidgetInstance;
10708: 	}
10709: 	else
10710: 	{
10711: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("PushContent: Failed to create widget instance for class: %s"), WidgetClass ? *WidgetClass->GetName() : TEXT("NULL"));
10712: 	}
10713: 	return nullptr;
10714: }

10723: void UWitchPTUILayer::PopContent()
10724: {
10725: 	if (!Stack.IsEmpty())
10726: 	{
10727: 		if (UUserWidget* WidgetToRelease = Stack.Last())
10728: 		{
10729: 			WidgetToRelease->RemoveFromParent();
10730: 			Stack.Pop();
10731: 			WidgetPool.Release(WidgetToRelease);
10732: 		}
10733: 
10734: 		if (UUserWidget* NewTopWidget = GetTopScreen())
10735: 		{
10736: 			NewTopWidget->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Visible);
10737: 			Border->AddChild(NewTopWidget);
10738: 		}
10739: 	}
10740: }
10741: 
10742: UUserWidget* UWitchPTUILayer::GetTopScreen() const
10743: {
10744: 	if (!Stack.IsEmpty())
10745: 	{
10746: 		return Stack.Last();
10747: 	}
10748: 	return nullptr;
10749: }

10751: FText UWitchPTUILayer::GetStackListNames()
10752: {
10753: 	// Return a list of the names but in reverse order
10754: 	FString ListNames;
10755: 	for (int i = Stack.Num() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
10756: 	{
10757: 		ListNames += Stack[i]->GetName() + "\n";
10758: 	}
10759: 	return FText::FromString(ListNames);
10760: }
10761: 
10762: FText UWitchPTUILayer::GetStackWidgetControllerName()
10763: {
10764: 	FString ListNames;
10765: 	for (int i = Stack.Num() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
10766: 	{
10767: 		UWitchPTUserWidget* WitchWidget = Cast<UWitchPTUserWidget>(Stack[i]);
10768: 		// also print his WidgetController name
10769: 		if (WitchWidget && WitchWidget->WidgetController)
10770: 		{
10771: 			ListNames += WitchWidget->WidgetController->GetClass()->GetName() + " - ";
10772: 
10773: 		}
10774: 
10775: 	}
10776: 	return FText::FromString(ListNames);
10777: }

10779: void UWitchPTUILayer::ClearStack()
10780: {
10781: 	for (auto & Widget : Stack)
10782: 	{
10783: 		if (Widget)
10784: 		{
10785: 			Widget->RemoveFromParent();
10786: 		}
10787: 	}
10788: 	Stack.Empty();
10789: 	Border->ClearChildren();
10790: 
10791:

10848: bool UWitchPTPrimaryLayout::RegisterLayer(FGameplayTag LayerTag, UWitchPTUILayer* InLayer)
10849: {
10850: 
10851: 	if (InLayer != nullptr && LayerTag.IsValid())
10852: 	{
10853: 		if (Layers.Contains(LayerTag))
10854: 		{
10855: 			UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("Layer %s is already registered!"), *LayerTag.ToString());
10856: 			return false;
10857: 		}
10858: 
10859: 		// Register the layer
10860: 		Layers.Add(LayerTag, InLayer);
10861: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("Registered layer: %s"), *LayerTag.ToString());
10862: 
10863: 		return true;
10864: 	}
10865: 	return false;

10869: {

10873: 		{
10874: 			LayerToRemove->RemoveFromParent();
10875: 			Layers.Remove(LayerTag);
10876: 			UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("Unregistered layer: %s"), *LayerTag.ToString());
10877: 			return true;
10878: 		}
10879: 	}
10880: 	return false;

11008: void UWitchPT_GameUIPolicy::CreateLayoutWidget(ULocalPlayer* LocalPlayer)
11009: {
11010: 	if (APlayerController* PlayerController = LocalPlayer->GetPlayerController(GetWorld()))
11011: 	{
11012: 		TSubclassOf<UWitchPTPrimaryLayout> LayoutWidgetClass = PrimaryLayoutClass.LoadSynchronous();
11013: 		if (ensure(LayoutWidgetClass && !LayoutWidgetClass->HasAnyClassFlags(CLASS_Abstract)))
11014: 		{
11015: 			UWitchPTPrimaryLayout* NewLayoutObject = CreateWidget<UWitchPTPrimaryLayout>(PlayerController, LayoutWidgetClass);
11016: 			RootViewportLayouts.Emplace(LocalPlayer, NewLayoutObject, true);
11017: 
11018: 			AddLayoutToViewport(LocalPlayer, NewLayoutObject);
11019: 		}
11020: 	}
11021: 
11022: }
11023: 
11024: void UWitchPT_GameUIPolicy::AddLayoutToViewport(ULocalPlayer* LocalPlayer, UWitchPTPrimaryLayout* Layout)
11025: {
11026: 	UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[%s] is adding player [%s]'s to the viewport"), *GetName(), *GetNameSafe(LocalPlayer));
11027: 	Layout->SetPlayerContext(LocalPlayer);
11028: 	Layout->AddToPlayerScreen(1000);
11029: }
11030: 
11031: void UWitchPT_GameUIPolicy::RemoveLayoutFromViewport(ULocalPlayer* LocalPlayer, UWitchPTPrimaryLayout* Layout)
11032: {
11033: 	TWeakPtr<SWidget> LayoutSlateWidget = Layout->GetCachedWidget();
11034: 	if (LayoutSlateWidget.IsValid())
11035: 	{
11036: 		UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("[%s] is removing player [%s]'s root layout [%s] from the viewport"), *GetName(), *GetNameSafe(LocalPlayer), *GetNameSafe(Layout));
11037: 
11038: 		Layout->RemoveFromParent();
11039: 		if (LayoutSlateWidget.IsValid())
11040: 		{
11041: 			UE_LOG(LogTemp, Log, TEXT("Player [%s]'s root layout [%s] has been removed from the viewport, but other references to its underlying Slate widget still exist. Noting in case we leak it."),
11042: 				   *GetNameSafe(LocalPlayer), *GetNameSafe(Layout));
11043: 		}
11044: 
11045: 
11046: 	}
11047: }
11048: 
11049: void UWitchPT_GameUIPolicy::NotifyPlayerAdded(ULocalPlayer* LocalPlayer)
11050: {
11051: 	NotifyPlayerRemoved(LocalPlayer);
11052: 
11053: 	if (FRootViewportLayoutInfo* LayoutInfo = RootViewportLayouts.FindByKey(LocalPlayer))
11054: 	{
11055: 		AddLayoutToViewport(LocalPlayer, LayoutInfo->RootLayout);
11056: 		LayoutInfo->bIsAddedToViewport = true;
11057: 	} else
11058: 	{
11059: 		CreateLayoutWidget(LocalPlayer);
11060: 	}
11061: }
11062: 
11063: void UWitchPT_GameUIPolicy::NotifyPlayerRemoved(ULocalPlayer* LocalPlayer)
11064: {
11065: 	if (FRootViewportLayoutInfo* LayoutInfo = RootViewportLayouts.FindByKey(LocalPlayer))
11066: 	{
11067: 		RemoveLayoutFromViewport(LocalPlayer, LayoutInfo->RootLayout);
11068: 		LayoutInfo->bIsAddedToViewport = false;
11069: 
11070: 	}
11071: }

11693: #pragma once

11696: #include "Abilities/GameplayAbility.h"
11697: #include "InteractionOption.generated.h"
11698: 
11699: class IInteractableTarget;
11700: // class UUserWidget;
11701: 
11702: /**  */
11703: USTRUCT(BlueprintType)
11704: struct FInteractionOption
11705: {
11706: 	GENERATED_BODY()
11707: 
11708: public:
11709: 	/** The interactable target */
11710: 	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite)
11711: 	TScriptInterface<IInteractableTarget> InteractableTarget;
11712: 
11713: 	/** Simple text the interaction might return */
11714: 	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite)
11715: 	FText Text;
11716: 
11717: 	/** Simple sub-text the interaction might return */
11718: 	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite)
11719: 	FText SubText;
11720: 
11721: 	// METHODS OF INTERACTION
11722: 	//--------------------------------------------------------------
11723: 
11724: 	// 1) Place an ability on the avatar that they can activate when they perform interaction.
11725: 
11726: 	/** The ability to grant the avatar when they get near interactable objects. */
11727: 	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly)
11728: 	TSubclassOf<UGameplayAbility> InteractionAbilityToGrant;
11729: 
11730: 	// - OR -
11731: 
11732: 	// 2) Allow the object we're interacting with to have its own ability system and interaction ability, that we can activate instead.
11733: 
11734: 	/** The ability system on the target that can be used for the TargetInteractionHandle and sending the event, if needed. */
11735: 	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadOnly)
11736: 	TObjectPtr<UAbilitySystemComponent> TargetAbilitySystem = nullptr;
11737: 
11738: 	/** The ability spec to activate on the object for this option. */
11739: 	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadOnly)
11740: 	FGameplayAbilitySpecHandle TargetInteractionAbilityHandle;
11741: 
11742: 	/** Indica si esta opción de interacción soporta interacción mantenida */
11743: 	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly)
11744: 	bool bSupportsHoldInteraction = false;
11745: 
11746: 	/** La habilidad a activar cuando se mantiene presionado el botón de interacción */
11747: 	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, meta = (EditCondition = "bSupportsHoldInteraction"))
11748: 	TSubclassOf<UGameplayAbility> HoldInteractionAbilityToGrant;
11749: 
11750: 	/** La habilidad para interacción mantenida en el objetivo */
11751: 	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadOnly)
11752: 	FGameplayAbilitySpecHandle TargetHoldInteractionAbilityHandle;
11753: 
11754: 	// UI
11755: 	//--------------------------------------------------------------
11756: 
11757: 	/** The widget to show for this kind of interaction. */
11758: 	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite)
11759: 	TSoftClassPtr<UUserWidget> InteractionWidgetClass;
11760: 
11761: 	//--------------------------------------------------------------
11762: 
11763: public:
11764: 	FORCEINLINE bool operator==(const FInteractionOption& Other) const
11765: 	{
11766: 		return InteractableTarget == Other.InteractableTarget &&
11767: 			InteractionAbilityToGrant == Other.InteractionAbilityToGrant&&
11768: 			TargetAbilitySystem == Other.TargetAbilitySystem &&
11769: 			TargetInteractionAbilityHandle == Other.TargetInteractionAbilityHandle &&
11770: 			bSupportsHoldInteraction == Other.bSupportsHoldInteraction &&
11771: 			HoldInteractionAbilityToGrant == Other.HoldInteractionAbilityToGrant &&
11772: 			TargetHoldInteractionAbilityHandle == Other.TargetHoldInteractionAbilityHandle &&
11773: 			// InteractionWidgetClass == Other.InteractionWidgetClass &&
11774: 			Text.IdenticalTo(Other.Text) &&
11775: 			SubText.IdenticalTo(Other.SubText);
11776: 	}
11777: 
11778: 	FORCEINLINE bool operator!=(const FInteractionOption& Other) const
11779: 	{
11780: 		return !operator==(Other);
11781: 	}
11782: 
11783: 	FORCEINLINE bool operator<(const FInteractionOption& Other) const
11784: 	{
11785: 		return InteractableTarget.GetInterface() < Other.InteractableTarget.GetInterface();
11786: 	}
11787: };
11788: </file>

13085:

13087: 
13088: 
13089: UCLASS()
13090: class WITCHPT_API UWitchPTInputComponent : public UEnhancedInputComponent
13091: {
13092: 	GENERATED_BODY()
13093: 
13094: public:
13095: 	template<class UserClass, typename PressedFuncType, typename ReleasedFuncType, typename HeldFuncType>
13096: 	void BindAbilityActions(const UWitchPTInputConfig* InputConfig, UserClass* Object, PressedFuncType PressedFunc, ReleasedFuncType ReleasedFunc, HeldFuncType HeldFunc);
13097: 
13098: };
13099: 
13100: template <class UserClass, typename PressedFuncType, typename ReleasedFuncType, typename HeldFuncType>
13101: void UWitchPTInputComponent::BindAbilityActions(const UWitchPTInputConfig* InputConfig, UserClass* Object,
13102: 	PressedFuncType PressedFunc, ReleasedFuncType ReleasedFunc, HeldFuncType HeldFunc)
13103: {
13104: 	check(InputConfig);
13105: 	for (const FWitchPTInputAction& Action: InputConfig->AbilityInputActions)
13106: 	{
13107: 		if (Action.InputAction && Action.InputTag.IsValid())
13108: 		{
13109: 			if (PressedFunc)
13110: 			{
13111: 				BindAction(Action.InputAction, ETriggerEvent::Started, Object, PressedFunc, Action.InputTag);
13112: 			}
13113: 			if (ReleasedFunc)
13114: 			{
13115: 				BindAction(Action.InputAction, ETriggerEvent::Completed, Object, ReleasedFunc, Action.InputTag);
13116: 			}
13117: 			if (HeldFunc)
13118: 			{
13119: 				BindAction(Action.InputAction, ETriggerEvent::Triggered, Object, HeldFunc, Action.InputTag);
13120: 			}
13121: 		}
13122: 	}
13123: 
13124: }
13125: </file>

13296: 	FWitchPTInventoryList(UActorComponent* InOwnerComponent)
13297: 		: OwnerComponent(InOwnerComponent)
13298: 	{
13299: 	}
13300: 
13301: 	/**
13302: 	 * Get all item instances in the inventory
13303: 	 * @return TArray<UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance*> - Array of all item instances
13304: 	 */
13305: 	TArray<UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance*> GetAllItems() const;
13306: 
13307: public:
13308: 	//~FFastArraySerializer contract
13309: 	/**
13310: 	 * Called before items are removed during replication
13311: 	 * Broadcasts the OnItemRemoved event for each removed item
13312: 	 */
13313: 	void PreReplicatedRemove(const TArrayView<int32> RemovedIndices, int32 FinalSize);
13314: 
13315: 	/**
13316: 	 * Called after items are added during replication
13317: 	 * Broadcasts the OnItemAdded event for each added item
13318: 	 */
13319: 	void PostReplicatedAdd(const TArrayView<int32> AddedIndices, int32 FinalSize);
13320: 
13321: 	/**
13322: 	 * Called after items are changed during replication
13323: 	 * Broadcasts the OnItemStackChanged event for each changed item
13324: 	 */
13325: 	void PostReplicatedChange(const TArrayView<int32> ChangedIndices, int32 FinalSize);
13326: 	//~End of FFastArraySerializer contract
13327: 
13328: 	/**
13329: 	 * Serializes the delta between two states of the array
13330: 	 * Required for FastArraySerializer functionality
13331: 	 */
13332: 	bool NetDeltaSerialize(FNetDeltaSerializeInfo& DeltaParms)
13333: 	{
13334: 		return FFastArraySerializer::FastArrayDeltaSerialize<FWitchPTInventoryEntry, FWitchPTInventoryList>(Entries, DeltaParms, *this);
13335: 	}
13336: 
13337: 	/**
13338: 	 * Create a new inventory entry with the specified item definition
13339: 	 * Initializes the item instance and sets up its stack count based on the definition
13340: 	 *
13341: 	 * @param ItemClass The class of the inventory item to add
13342: 	 * @return A pointer to the newly created inventory item instance
13343: 	 */
13344: 	UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* AddEntry(TSubclassOf<UWitchPTInventoryItemDefinition> ItemClass);
13345: 
13346: 	/**
13347: 	 * Adds an existing item instance to the inventory list
13348: 	 *
13349: 	 * @param Instance The inventory item instance to add
13350: 	 */
13351: 	void AddEntry(UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* Instance);
13352: 
13353: 	/**
13354: 	 * Removes an item instance from the inventory list
13355: 	 *
13356: 	 * @param Instance The inventory item instance to remove
13357: 	 */
13358: 	void RemoveEntry(UWitchPTInventoryItemInstance* Instance);
13359: 
13360: private:
13361: 	friend UWitchPTInventoryManagerComponent;
13362: 
13363: private:
13364: 	/** Replicated list of inventory entries */
13365: 	UPROPERTY()
13366: 	TArray<FWitchPTInventoryEntry> Entries;
13367: 
13368: 	/** Non-replicated reference to the owner component */
13369: 	UPROPERTY(NotReplicated)
13370: 	TObjectPtr<UActorComponent> OwnerComponent;
13371: };
