15712: <file path="WitchPT/Public/Systems/GameplayTagStack.cpp">
15713: // Copyright Epic Games, Inc. All Rights Reserved.
15714: 
15715: #include "Systems/GameplayTagStack.h"
15716: 
15717: #include "UObject/Stack.h"
15718: 
15719: #include UE_INLINE_GENERATED_CPP_BY_NAME(GameplayTagStack)
15720: 
15721: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
15722: // FGameplayTagStack
15723: 
15724: FString FGameplayTagStack::GetDebugString() const
15725: {
15726: 	return FString::Printf(TEXT("%sx%d"), *Tag.ToString(), StackCount);
15727: }
15728: 
15729: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
15730: // FGameplayTagStackContainer
15731: 
15732: void FGameplayTagStackContainer::AddStack(FGameplayTag Tag, int32 StackCount)
15733: {
15734: 	if (!Tag.IsValid())
15735: 	{
15736: 		FFrame::KismetExecutionMessage(TEXT("An invalid tag was passed to AddStack"), ELogVerbosity::Warning);
15737: 		return;
15738: 	}
15739: 
15740: 	if (StackCount > 0)
15741: 	{
15742: 		for (FGameplayTagStack& Stack : Stacks)
15743: 		{
15744: 			if (Stack.Tag == Tag)
15745: 			{
15746: 				const int32 NewCount = Stack.StackCount + StackCount;
15747: 				Stack.StackCount = NewCount;
15748: 				TagToCountMap[Tag] = NewCount;
15749: 				MarkItemDirty(Stack);
15750: 				return;
15751: 			}
15752: 		}
15753: 
15754: 		FGameplayTagStack& NewStack = Stacks.Emplace_GetRef(Tag, StackCount);
15755: 		MarkItemDirty(NewStack);
15756: 		TagToCountMap.Add(Tag, StackCount);
15757: 	}
15758: }
15759: 
15760: void FGameplayTagStackContainer::RemoveStack(FGameplayTag Tag, int32 StackCount)
15761: {
15762: 	if (!Tag.IsValid())
15763: 	{
15764: 		FFrame::KismetExecutionMessage(TEXT("An invalid tag was passed to RemoveStack"), ELogVerbosity::Warning);
15765: 		return;
15766: 	}
15767: 
15768: 	//@TODO: Should we error if you try to remove a stack that doesn't exist or has a smaller count?
15769: 	if (StackCount > 0)
15770: 	{
15771: 		for (auto It = Stacks.CreateIterator(); It; ++It)
15772: 		{
15773: 			FGameplayTagStack& Stack = *It;
15774: 			if (Stack.Tag == Tag)
15775: 			{
15776: 				if (Stack.StackCount <= StackCount)
15777: 				{
15778: 					It.RemoveCurrent();
15779: 					TagToCountMap.Remove(Tag);
15780: 					MarkArrayDirty();
15781: 				}
15782: 				else
15783: 				{
15784: 					const int32 NewCount = Stack.StackCount - StackCount;
15785: 					Stack.StackCount = NewCount;
15786: 					TagToCountMap[Tag] = NewCount;
15787: 					MarkItemDirty(Stack);
15788: 				}
15789: 				return;
15790: 			}
15791: 		}
15792: 	}
15793: }
15794: 
15795: void FGameplayTagStackContainer::PreReplicatedRemove(const TArrayView<int32> RemovedIndices, int32 FinalSize)
15796: {
15797: 	for (int32 Index : RemovedIndices)
15798: 	{
15799: 		const FGameplayTag Tag = Stacks[Index].Tag;
15800: 		TagToCountMap.Remove(Tag);
15801: 	}
15802: }
15803: 
15804: void FGameplayTagStackContainer::PostReplicatedAdd(const TArrayView<int32> AddedIndices, int32 FinalSize)
15805: {
15806: 	for (int32 Index : AddedIndices)
15807: 	{
15808: 		const FGameplayTagStack& Stack = Stacks[Index];
15809: 		TagToCountMap.Add(Stack.Tag, Stack.StackCount);
15810: 	}
15811: }
15812: 
15813: void FGameplayTagStackContainer::PostReplicatedChange(const TArrayView<int32> ChangedIndices, int32 FinalSize)
15814: {
15815: 	for (int32 Index : ChangedIndices)
15816: 	{
15817: 		const FGameplayTagStack& Stack = Stacks[Index];
15818: 		TagToCountMap[Stack.Tag] = Stack.StackCount;
15819: 	}
15820: }
15821: </file>

15836: /**

15839: USTRUCT(BlueprintType)
15840: struct FGameplayTagStack : public FFastArraySerializerItem
15841: {

15845: 	{}
15846:

15849: 		, StackCount(InStackCount)

15851: 	}

15864: 
15865: /** Container of gameplay tag stacks */
15866: USTRUCT(BlueprintType)
15867: struct FGameplayTagStackContainer : public FFastArraySerializer
15868: {
15869: 	GENERATED_BODY()
15870: 
15871: 	FGameplayTagStackContainer()
15872: 	//	: Owner(nullptr)
15873: 	{
15874: 	}
15875: 
15876: public:
15877: 	// Adds a specified number of stacks to the tag (does nothing if StackCount is below 1)
15878: 	void AddStack(FGameplayTag Tag, int32 StackCount);
15879: 
15880: 	// Removes a specified number of stacks from the tag (does nothing if StackCount is below 1)
15881: 	void RemoveStack(FGameplayTag Tag, int32 StackCount);
15882: 
15883: 	// Returns the stack count of the specified tag (or 0 if the tag is not present)
15884: 	int32 GetStackCount(FGameplayTag Tag) const
15885: 	{
15886: 		return TagToCountMap.FindRef(Tag);
15887: 	}
15888: 
15889: 	// Returns true if there is at least one stack of the specified tag
15890: 	bool ContainsTag(FGameplayTag Tag) const
15891: 	{
15892: 		return TagToCountMap.Contains(Tag);
15893: 	}
15894: 
15895: 	//~FFastArraySerializer contract
15896: 	void PreReplicatedRemove(const TArrayView<int32> RemovedIndices, int32 FinalSize);
15897: 	void PostReplicatedAdd(const TArrayView<int32> AddedIndices, int32 FinalSize);
15898: 	void PostReplicatedChange(const TArrayView<int32> ChangedIndices, int32 FinalSize);
15899: 	//~End of FFastArraySerializer contract
15900: 
15901: 	bool NetDeltaSerialize(FNetDeltaSerializeInfo& DeltaParms)
15902: 	{
15903: 		return FFastArraySerializer::FastArrayDeltaSerialize<FGameplayTagStack, FGameplayTagStackContainer>(Stacks, DeltaParms, *this);
15904: 	}
15905: 
15906: private:
15907: 	// Replicated list of gameplay tag stacks
15908: 	UPROPERTY()
15909: 	TArray<FGameplayTagStack> Stacks;
15910: 
15911: 	// Accelerated list of tag stacks for queries
15912: 	TMap<FGameplayTag, int32> TagToCountMap;
15913: };
15914:

15918: 	enum
15919: 	{
15920: 		WithNetDeltaSerializer = true,
15921: 	};
15922: };

16923: /**
16924:  * @struct FWidgetControllerParams
16925:  * @brief A structure that encapsulates parameters required to initialize a widget controller.
16926:  *
16927:  * This structure is designed to pass necessary references into widget controllers for proper functionality,
16928:  * primarily used in player-related widgets to access player-specific systems and attributes.
16929:  *
16930:  * It includes references to the Player Controller, Player State, Ability System Component,
16931:  * and an Attribute Set. These references allow the widget controller to interact with the gameplay systems
16932:  * linked to a player.
16933:  *
16934:  * @note Each of the parameters is a nullable pointer to account for scenarios where specific components
16935:  * may not be initialized or required.
16936:  */
16937: USTRUCT(BlueprintType)
16938: struct FWidgetControllerParams
16939: {
16940: 	GENERATED_BODY()
16941: 	FWidgetControllerParams() {};
16942: 	FWidgetControllerParams(APlayerController* PC, APlayerState* PS, UAbilitySystemComponent* ASC, UAttributeSet* AS)
16943: 	:
16944: 	PlayerController(PC),
16945: 	PlayerState(PS),
16946: 	AbilitySystemComponent(ASC),
16947: 	AttributeSet(AS)
16948: 	{}
16949: 
16950: 	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite)
16951: 	TObjectPtr<APlayerController> PlayerController = nullptr;
16952: 
16953: 	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite)
16954: 	TObjectPtr<APlayerState> PlayerState = nullptr;
16955: 
16956: 	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite)
16957: 	TObjectPtr<UAbilitySystemComponent> AbilitySystemComponent = nullptr;
16958: 
16959: 	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite)
16960: 	TObjectPtr<UAttributeSet> AttributeSet = nullptr;
16961: 
16962: };
16963: UCLASS()
16964: class WITCHPT_API UWitchPTWidgetController : public UObject, public ISetContextualObjectInterface
16965: {
16966: 	GENERATED_BODY()
16967: public:
16968: 	void Activate();
16969: 	void Deactivate();
16970: 
16971: 	virtual void SetContextualObject(UObject* ContextualObject) override;
16972: 
16973: 	void SetWidgetControllerParams(const FWidgetControllerParams& WCParams);
16974: 
16975: 
16976: protected:
16977: 	virtual void BroadcastInitialValues();
16978: 	virtual void BindCallbacksToDependencies();
16979: 	virtual void UnbindCallbacksFromDependencies();
16980: 
16981: 	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadOnly, Category= "WidgetController")
16982: 	TObjectPtr<APlayerController> PlayerController;
16983:
